title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

Note: We welcome applicants at every stage of their career. Your drive and willingness to learn are far more important to us than strict experience requirements.

title: Anthropic Fellows Program, The Anthropic Institute (Economics & Policy)
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

Submit your application to the Economics & Policy workstream at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research 
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers 
  • Weekly stipend of 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Substantial funding for compute and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. We may ask for references later in the process as well.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

The Anthropic Institute Fellows (Economics & Policy)

Mentors, research areas, & past projects

Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential research areas and mentors include:

  • Economics
    • Maxim Massenkoff
    • Peter McCrory
  • Policy, Security, and Society
    • Jack Clark
    • Marina Favaro
    • Jim Baker

Projects in this workstream may include:

  • Designing and conducting empirical research on AI's economic effects, drawing on external data sources
  • Developing new methodological approaches for studying AI's impact on labor markets, the future of work, and society
  • Analysing the offense–defense balance for AI-enabled cyber and bio capabilities as models scale
  • Measuring the extent to which model performance increases with custom harnesses
  • Identifying market driven mechanisms that could improve societal resilience to anticipated threats from AI systems
  • Identifying which metrics relating to AI R&D could serve as early warning signals for recursive self-improvement

For past project examples, see:

  • How AI Impacts Skill Formation: Judy Shen and Alex Tamkin
  • Stress-Testing Model Specs Reveals Character Differences among Language Models: Jifan Zhang, Henry Sleight, Andi Peng, John Schulman, and Esin Durmus

Unique candidate criteria

You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you:

  • Have an interest in economics or policy research; prior experience in this area is a plus but not required
  • Are adaptable and collaborative, able to take direction and contribute to team priorities rather than needing to pursue a predetermined research agenda
  • Are skilled at writing up and communicating your results, even when they're null or unexpected
  • Are passionate about translating research insights into actionable recommendations for improving AI systems and informing policy

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole
  • Are excited to transition into AI research and would be interested in a full-time role at Anthropic
  • Strong track record of empirical research
  • Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments
  • Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly

Candidates must be:

  • Fluent in Python programming
  • Available to work full-time on the Fellows program

Logistics - Fellows Program

Submit your application to the Anthropic Institute Fellows at the bottom of this page.

Logistics Requirements: To participate in the Fellows program, you must have work authorization in the US, UK, or Canada and be located in that country during the program.

Workspace Locations: We have designated shared workspaces in SF. We are also open to remote fellows in the UK, US, or Canada. 

Visa Sponsorship: We are not currently able to sponsor visas for fellows. To participate in the Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the UK, the US, or Canada.

Program Duration: The program runs for 4 months, full-time. If you can't commit to the full duration, please still apply and note your constraints in the application. We review these requests on a case-by-case basis.

The below are Anthropic's policies for full time roles. These do NOT apply to the Fellows Program.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Dich erwartet ein spannendes Umfeld, in dem du deine technischen Fähigkeiten einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und den Aufbau eines neuen Teams aktiv mitgestalten kannst.

Hauptaufgaben:

  • Verantwortung für die Neu- und Weiterentwicklung unserer selbst entwickelten Services sowie deren Betrieb im DevOps-Team

  • Einführung, gezielter Einsatz und nachhaltige Etablierung von Camunda 8 im Team sowie Unterstützung beim Kompetenzaufbau und Upskilling der Kolleginnen und Kollegen

  • Verifikation der entwickelten Lösungen gemäss internen und externen Sicherheitsstandards sowie Sicherstellung einer hohen Softwarequalität

  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung der Betriebsprozesse gemeinsam mit dem Team

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der Konzeption, Architektur und Weiterentwicklung unserer Services

  • Beratung des Fachbereichs hinsichtlich technischer Machbarkeit, Lösungsvarianten, Auswirkungen und Anforderungen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern, Business Engineers und Architektur zur Erarbeitung optimaler und nachhaltiger Lösungen


Anforderungen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik oder gleichwertige Qualifikation durch Berufserfahrung

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Bankenumfeld

  • Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb der letzten drei Jahre in Client Onboarding, digitalen Produktabschlüssen oder Client Lifecycle Management

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Camunda 8, insbesondere im Design und in der Implementierung von Prozessen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Java- und Angular-Entwicklung sowie mit Spring, JPA/Hibernate, Maven und SQL (idealerweise PostgreSQL)

  • Kenntnisse in Kotlin sowie Cloud- und Container-Technologien wie Kubernetes/AKS und Docker sind von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Git, IntelliJ IDEA, Jenkins, Sonar und JIRA

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban sowie ein ausgeprägtes DevOps-Mindset

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Teamorientierung

  • Lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • Freude am Wissensaustausch und an der aktiven Mitgestaltung eines neu aufgebauten DevOps-Teams

title: Associate Consultant - Financial Services / Data & AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. The work is hard. The bar is high.Partner in 7-9 years possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform. 

Stop reading if any of these describe you: 

  • Drive. You need someone to fire the starting gun → We only hire people who can prove they are intrinsically driven and execute. 
  • Ownership. You spot the problem and walk it to your boss → We fall in love with problems. Own them. Solve them. Ship solutions. 
  • Speed. Slow is your default → Speed compounds. Be smart and brave enough to select 80/20 in the right way. 
  • Mindset. "Not possible" is part of your vocabulary → We hire people who always find a way. 

Still there? Then ALAIKA might be for you. 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply. 

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else. 
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. 
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that. 

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck.  

Join the movement — apply now. 

The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber. In the room with decision-makers from day one. 
  • Own. Own your deliverables end-to-end. You are not support staff for the partnership. 
  • Lead. Run workstreams and projects from day one — with real responsibility, not just preparation for it. Multiply the output of everyone around you — not just your own. 
  • Sell. Drive business development from day one — no waiting for seniority, no permission needed. At ALAIKA, building the business is not a privilege reserved for managers and partners. It is an expectation. 
  • Grow. Become the rare profile the market is short on — analytical mastermind, financial services expert, entrepreneurial dealmaker. Partner-track from day one. 
  • Build. We are scaling, with real building left to do — IP, processes, go-to-market, strategy. You do not just deliver client work; you co-build the firm. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 

When you are a fit 

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management". 

Your goal is to make it to the top: at ALAIKA itself, at a leading investment or financial services firm, or in a company you build yourself — ALAIKA can help with that too. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. Self-confident achiever. Act first, apologise later — speed is everything. Take full ownership of work normally reserved for far more senior profiles. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Top 10–20% of your class at a top-tier university. Analytical field — CS, Math, Physics, Finance, or equivalent rigour. 
  • Experience. 6-12 months in a high-pressure, results-driven environment — top strategy consultancy, PE/VC-backed company, fast-growing tech, or demanding corporate financial services role. Hands-on Data & AI experience is a plus.  
  • Leadership. You have led — a team, a club, a project, a cause. We hire people who make things happen. 
  • Analytical edge. Data-driven by default. Leverage data to drive decisions, not just decorate slides. 
  • Languages. Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus. 

Why join ALAIKA 

  • Partner track from day one. Seven years from early careers to partner possible. 
  • Compensation. Above market with very entrepreneurial-driven bonus structures. 
  • Stellar Network. Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders + investors building tomorrow’s. 
  • Offices. Munich and Barcelona. More coming. 

Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more. 

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services. 

Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. Let’s see if you are the one. 


Equal Opportunities for all (f/m/d)

ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space

title: Associate Director, Implementation Planning, UK
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

771 - Associate Director Implementational Planning - UK

Role Summary and Impact

As an Implementational Planning Associate Director, you drive day-to-day excellence in cross-channel media planning and activation. Translating client strategies (from Strategists/Comms Planners) into detailed implementational plans across all media (digital, audio, VOD, AV), you ensure seamless execution and measurable brand/performance outcomes. You collaborate deeply with specialist teams, acting as a key client contact on media performance, aligning with OASIS (objective, audience, strategy, Implementation & scoring) framework within WPP Open. Responsibilities include cross-channel optimisation, media testing, leveraging WPP Open Intelligence for data, and coordinating PCA insights for future strategies.

Reporting Structure: Reports to Implementational Planning Business Director.

Key Responsibilities

  • Line Management: Provide direct line management, mentorship, and development for junior team members.
  • Client Delivery & Management: Act as the primary day-to-day client connection, delivering integrated planning and activation, developing and presenting implementational responses, and building strong client and partner relationships.
  • Cross-Channel Planning: Collaborate with Strategists and Comms Planners to translate overarching media strategies into detailed tactical plans across all channels, creating integrated roadmaps aligned with brand and performance goals. This process is aligned with OASIS framework.
  • Optimisation & Performance: Lead cross-channel optimisation, implement advanced measurement (including media testing frameworks), refine plans based on data and audience insights, and coordinate insights for PCAs.
  • Innovation & Capability: Implement and test new tools, technologies (e.g., AI-driven optimisation) within client campaigns, utilising WPP Open and WPP Open Intelligence for data opportunities and testing initiatives, all within the context of the DPAM framework.
  • Team Collaboration: Foster cross-functional collaboration with Comms Planners, Strategists, and activation specialists, presenting a unified approach aligned with the OASIS framework within the WPP Open ecosystem.

Skills and Experience

  • Extensive experience in media planning, digital activation, or implementational planning, managing complex accounts and orchestrating integrated media strategies.
  • Expertise in cross-channel planning (digital, audio, VOD, AV), strong data analysis, integrated media testing knowledge, and client relationship management.
  • Ability to translate high-level brand and performance strategies, in partnership with Comms Planners and Strategists, into detailed, actionable tactical plans across the entire media mix, directly contributing to wider client media strategy, following the OASIS framework.
  • Advanced knowledge of the full media landscape and core media buying platforms, with an understanding of how they intersect and integrate.
  • Strong understanding of audience insights, advanced analytics, data validation, and the ability to leverage performance data for optimisation, including robust media testing frameworks and WPP Open Intelligence.
  • Proficiency in planning and optimisation tools (including WPP Open) and integrating AI-driven tools.
  • Proven ability to build trusted client relationships, present confidently, and manage expectations.
  • Highly collaborative, fostering productive working relationships across internal teams and partners.
  • Agile, innovative, and pioneering mindset, focused on continuous improvement, problem-solving, and passion for media testing.

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment.

WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Associate Director, Regulatory Strategy
descriptionHtml:
The Associate Director of Regulatory Affairs Strategy will serve as an EU Regional Lead for our mid/late-stage CNS programs and may have the opportunity to be the Regulatory Program Lead for early programs in Alnylam pipeline.  The will work on assigned programs with the respective Global Regulatory Portfolio Lead, Global Regulatory Lead and cross-functional team to lead the EU regulatory strategy and facilitate submission of data packages to the EMA.  The role is responsible for planning and coordinating all aspects of regulatory submissions necessary to support product development, clinical trials and product registration. The role will represent RA on multidisciplinary product development subteams and Global Regulatory Team. Additional responsibilities include involvement in the writing and oversight of regulatory submissions, coordinating all aspects of paper and electronic regulatory submissions, proactively keeping updated on EU regulatory requirements, and interpreting regulatory intelligence for the internal teams.

Summary of Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as EU Regional Lead for assigned program (s); additional responsibilities may include serving as as Regulatory Program Lead (leading the Global Regulatory Team), for one of the early programs in the Alnylam pipeline.
  • Work with the Global Regulatory Lead and Regulatory Affairs management to lead and define regulatory strategy and to compile and submit, in a timely manner, regulatory documents according to regulatory requirements and lead EU HA interactions. Regulatory documents may include the relevant forms, meeting requests, Briefing Documents for HA meetings, new Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs), Marketing Applications, Paediatric Plans, Orphan Designation and Expedited Pathway Applications (e.g. PRIME), and any amendments.
  • Develop detailed regulatory strategy and project plans and support regulatory activities relating to specific portfolio of products/projects.
  • Serve as member of the Global Regulatory Team, may serve as Regulatory representative in multidisciplinary product subteams or core team for assigned programs and participate as an active team member to provide strategic regulatory advice in relation to EU regulatory activities.
  • Coordinate responses to regulatory authorities’ questions with strict adherence to deadlines.
  • Serve as a liaison within internal departments at Alnylam, with CROs and with regulatory program managers at HAs.
  • Maintain regulatory files in a format consistent with internal requirements.
  • Facilitate as necessary the review of technical regulatory documentation and recommend changes to documentation or processes, including SOPs for regulatory compliance.
  • Provide EU specific regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders as appropriate.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 6 or more years of experience in a Regulatory Affairs role; minimum of 8 years’ experience working in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry. Higher degree would be a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Solid understanding of regulations and experience in interpretation of guidelines.
  • Ability to think strategically and to proactively identify issues and mitigation strategies in various aspects of the drug development process.
  • Experience with regulatory filings, including electronic submissions, e.g., CTAs, post-marketing variations, safety reporting, paediatric plans, PRIME etc.
    • MAA filing and Type II variation experience is preferred.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills; demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple projects.
  • Ability to work in a team environment, possessing interpersonal skills to work effectively with other departments at various levels and with CROs and external consultants.
  • Technical system skills (e.g. word processing, spreadsheets, databases, online research) including submission-ready formatting.
  • Clear alignment with Alnylam Core Values including:
    • Commitment to People,
    • Fiercely Innovative,
    • Purposeful Urgency,
    • Open Culture, and
    • Passion for Excellence.

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Associate (Education)
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.


About the role

As an Associate at Faculty, you will join a collaborative team scoping, building, and delivering impactful AI projects across education and public services. You will support work streams alongside assessment bodies, educational platforms, and government partners to ensure bespoke AI solutions are safe, evidence-backed, and practical.

We will look to you to nurture trusted client relationships, translate operational needs into clear delivery plans, and partner with technical teams to deploy tools that genuinely improve learning outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to build your career at the forefront of safe, purposeful AI innovation.

What you'll be doing:

  • Managing individual work streams to support the smooth delivery and deployment of bespoke AI tools across education and public service organisations.

  • Working side-by-side with education leaders, publishers, and assessment partners to understand user needs and core learning challenges.

  • Translating operational requirements and pedagogical goals into clear, actionable user stories for data science and engineering squads.

  • Partnering with AI safety and evaluation specialists to test workflows and ensure solutions uphold rigorous standards of fairness, validity, and evidence.

  • Collaborating closely with multidisciplinary project teams to keep delivery on track and maintain exceptional delivery quality.

  • Contributing to problem-led proposals, client workshops, and internal thought leadership on the positive impact of technology in learning.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring strong analytical thinking and curiosity, with a talent for synthesising complex information and communicating ideas with clarity.

  • You have foundational experience working on data, software, or AI-oriented projects, ideally with exposure to public services or educational platforms.

  • You demonstrate client-facing experience and take pride in building empathetic, collaborative partnerships that help projects succeed.

title: Associate Principal/Pricing & Market Access (Life Sciences practice) - m/w/d
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. 

Position Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 3-6 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);
  • Occasional travel required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Über Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet.

Stellenübersicht

Die Life Sciences Practice von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen.

Associate Principals bei CRA arbeiten gemeinsam mit erfahrenen und jüngeren Consultants in Projektteams an einer Vielzahl von Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Branchen. Sie führen anspruchsvolle strategische Analysen durch und unterstützen bei der Steuerung von Beratungsprojekten. Dabei übernehmen sie die Projektleitung, koordinieren die Arbeit anderer Teammitglieder, verantworten Analysen, betreuen Kundenbeziehungen auf mittlerer Ebene und/oder kommunizieren Projektergebnisse. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie weitgehend selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich.

Für eine erfolgreiche Tätigkeit in dieser Position sollten Sie in der Lage sein, kleinere Projekte oder wesentliche Teilaufgaben größerer und komplexerer Projekte effektiv zu planen und zu steuern, Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und zu analysieren sowie ein breites Spektrum analytischer Aufgaben selbst durchzuführen oder anzuleiten. Darüber hinaus legen wir großen Wert auf eine ausgeprägte Arbeitsethik, Kreativität, eine positive Einstellung und ein hohes Maß an Engagement.

Aktuell suchen wir insbesondere Consultants mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Pricing- und Market-Access-Systeme in Europa und weltweit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie identifizieren und konzipieren eigenständig die erforderlichen Analysen und wirken an der Entwicklung des übergreifenden analytischen Ansatzes für Beratungsprojekte mit.
  • Sie stehen im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, informieren sie über den Projektfortschritt und präsentieren Ergebnisse.
  • Sie erstellen Berichte und Präsentationen oder übernehmen die Ausarbeitung einzelner Abschnitte.
  • Sie wirken bei der Projektplanung und der Steuerung von Projektbudgets mit.
  • Sie unterstützen weniger erfahrene Teammitglieder bei ihrer fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, prüfen deren Analysen und geben ihnen fachliche Anleitung und Feedback.
  • Sie bringen sich in die Geschäftsentwicklung ein und wirken bei der Erstellung von Angeboten für Kunden mit.

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Life Sciences, z. B. in Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Pharmakologie oder Chemie, oder in einem relevanten Studiengang mit analytischem Schwerpunkt sowie einschlägige Berufserfahrung;
  • 5 bis 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Beratung;
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Anwendung quantitativer und qualitativer Analysemethoden;
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung und im Projektmanagement;
  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt, in der Moderation und Präsentation sowie in der Budget- und Projektplanung;
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Pricing und Market Access in europäischen und internationalen Märkten;
  • Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil;
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen.

Bewerbung

Um für diese Position berücksichtigt zu werden, reichen Sie bitte die folgenden Unterlagen ein:

  • Lebenslauf – bitte geben Sie Ihre aktuelle Adresse, eprsönliche E-Mail-Adresse und Telefonnummer an;
  • Anschreiben – Bitte beschreiben Sie Ihr Interesse an CRA und wie diese Rolle zu Ihren Zielen passt.

Karriereentwicklung und Benefits

  • CRA bietet Ihnen vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dazu gehören jährliche formelle und informelle Weiterbildungsangebote, die Ihre individuelle Entwicklung ebenso fördern wie Ihre Zusammenarbeit im Team. Das Angebot reicht von Trainings zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen über Präsentationstrainings und interne Seminare bis hin zu individuellem Karriere-Mentoring und Performance-Coaching durch eine erfahrene Kollegin oder einen erfahrenen Kollegen. Darüber hinaus bieten interne Initiativen die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von CRA einzubringen.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen ein umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket mit attraktiven Zusatzleistungen. Dazu gehören Angebote zur Förderung Ihres körperlichen, mentalen, emotionalen und finanziellen Wohlbefindens sowie interne Unterstützung bei Einwanderungs- und Visaangelegenheiten für internationale Mitarbeitende und Geschäftsreisende.

Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz

CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben.

Unser Engagement für Vielfalt

Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert.

title: Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics.

The role

Large, high-volume contracts mean our factories need to run around the clock. Overnight shifts can bridge the gap, but the long-term answer is automated machine tending. The market is crowded, with billet, vice, pallet and bar feed systems and many more, so rather than designing our own we work with external system integrators.

You will own machine tending across our factories: choose the right solutions, manage the integrators who deploy them, and keep the cells running. You won't be designing and building cells yourself. Your job is to make sure the ones we buy deliver, and see them running on a live factory floor. The package includes equity.

  • Scope automation projects and choose the right machine tending setup for each cell.

  • Manage external system integrators through procurement, installation and commissioning.

  • Own the performance and uptime of automated cells once they're live.

  • Build a long-term procurement plan for automation as we add machines and sites.

  • Work with operators on the floor so automation fits how the factory runs.

What you bring

  • Automation, controls or system integration experience in manufacturing, whether at an integrator, an OEM machine builder, a larger manufacturer with its own automation team, or a machine shop with serious machine tending.

title: Avionics System Engineer
descriptionHtml:

We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and test avionics subsystems (power distribution, data buses, sensor interfaces, flight computer integration) to meet requirements set by the avionics architecture lead.
  • Support development and upkeep of avionics requirements, interface control documents (ICDs), and verification & validation (V&V) test plans.
  • Execute avionics AIT (assembly, integration & test) activities: write and run test procedures, capture data, and support anomaly investigation and root-cause analysis.
  • Support supplier and vendor coordination for avionics components (flight computers, sensors, actuators, harnessing) — including incoming inspection, qualification testing, and non-conformance tracking.
  • Contribute to flight readiness reviews and perform post-test/post-flight data analysis and reporting.
  • Maintain avionics design and test documentation in line with applicable export control classifications and configuration management practices.
  • Collaborate day-to-day with GNC, propulsion, and structures engineers to resolve interface and integration issues.

Who You Are 
  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic/Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Hands-on experience with avionics system design or integration on complex vehicles (aerospace, defence, automotive, or comparable high-reliability domain)
  • Working knowledge of avionics architectures: power distribution, data buses (e.g. CAN, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet), sensor integration, flight computers.
  • Experience with electronics lab test equipment, test procedure execution, and data capture/analysis.
  • Comfortable working in a cross-functional, fast-paced hardware development environment.
  • Strong written communication for technical documentation (ICDs, test reports, non-conformance records)

    • What we offer 

    • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe's most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

    • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

    • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

    • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

    • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

    • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


    Security and Eligibility Requirement 

    Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/NATO/German citizen and eligible for Security Clearance.

    At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Branch Support Manager - Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Rain for Rent International

Rain for Rent International provides innovative tank systems for liquid management applications. As an internationally operating rental and service company, expertise centers on rental, logistics, and services around the tank, focusing on the core competencies of renting storage tanks, containment systems, pumps, and filtration units.

Your role

We are looking for a hands-on Branch Support Manager ( m/f/d ) to help our teams across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France get the best from our business systems, processes and support functions.

This is not a traditional IT Manager position.

It is a highly business-facing role combining business systems, operational processes, user support, training, continuous improvement and team leadership. You will work closely with our branches and Shared Services teams to understand how people work, where they encounter challenges and how technology and better processes can make their jobs easier and our business more effective.

What you will do

Become a Business Systems Expert

You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users.

A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as:

  • Purchasing and purchase orders

  • Goods and invoice receipt

  • Rental contracts

  • Equipment on-hire and off-hire

  • Recurring and final billing

  • Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing

  • Customer, supplier and item master data

You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications.

Experience with inspHire, Zoho or Twinfield would be advantageous, but previous knowledge of our specific applications is not essential if you have strong ERP/business systems experience and learn quickly.

Help People Get the Best From Technology

You will work directly with colleagues across our branches to understand challenges, answer questions and identify better ways of working.

That includes:

  • Providing practical systems and process support

  • Training new and existing users

  • Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials

  • Creating screen recordings and short training videos

  • Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library

  • Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes

Most importantly, you will explain the why, not only the how.

Connect Systems With Business Reality

Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly.

You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data.

You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business.

Listen, Challenge and Improve

Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements.

Your job is not simply to say yes.

You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else.

For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership.

Lead a Small Team

You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities.

This remains a hands-on role. You will lead the team while actively participating in support, training, problem solving and improvement initiatives yourself.

Stay Curious

Technology is changing quickly and we want to take advantage of it.

You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about tools such as Microsoft Copilot, automation and new ways technology can help colleagues work more effectively.

The Person We Are Looking For

Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much.

You are someone who:

  • Listens before proposing a solution

  • Is patient and enjoys explaining things

  • Can train and support colleagues with different levels of systems experience

  • Builds credibility and strong working relationships

  • Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy

  • Is comfortable constructively challenging a request

  • Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs

  • Learns new business processes quickly

  • Enjoys solving problems

  • Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business

  • Is curious about technology and AI

You should be equally comfortable discussing a process with a branch administrator, working through a systems problem with IT, understanding a commercial requirement from Sales or presenting a recommendation to leadership.

European Scope

The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France.

Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations, build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice.

Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk.

You will have the opportunity to influence:

  • How we use our business systems

  • How we support and train users

  • How processes are standardised across countries

  • How knowledge is documented and shared

  • How new technology and AI are adopted

  • How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves

If you enjoy bringing together people, processes and technology and want a role where you can see the practical impact of your work across the business, we would like to hear from you.

Rain for Rent International is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Business Development & Sales Intern (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann.

Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben.

Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden.

Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Als Praktikant:in im Business Development & Sales sorgst Du dafür, dass unser Vertriebsteam seine Zeit mit den richtigen Kliniken verbringt. Du findest und qualifizierst die Accounts, eröffnest die ersten Gespräche und buchst die Demos, die dann unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen wahrnehmen. Gleichzeitig baust Du den Motor dahinter mit auf: saubere Daten in unserem CRM Tool, Outreach-Sequenzen, die laufen, Dashboards, die zeigen, wo wir stehen, und KI-Automatisierungen, die unserem Team jede Woche Stunden sparen.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du direkt anhand der gebuchten Termine, einer aufgebauten Pipeline und Prozessen, die weiterlaufen, lange nachdem Du sie aufgesetzt hast.

Du sitzt nicht in der zweiten Reihe und schaust zu. Du baust den Vertriebsmotor mit auf, der Valova in Kliniken in ganz Deutschland bringt.

Deine Rolle im Team

Du berichtest an unseren VP Sales und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Regional Sales Manager:innen im Norden und Süden zusammen. Für viele Kliniken bist Du der erste Kontakt: Du recherchierst Accounts, gehst Inbound Leads nach, sprichst Entscheider:innen per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an und übergibst qualifizierte Termine an die Regional Sales Manager:innen, die sie bis zur Unterschrift bringen. Neben dem Outreach unterstützt du RevOps & Enablement, einen Bereich, den aktuell unser VP Sales selbst führt und gestaltest so von innen mit, wie unser Vertrieb arbeitet. Eng zusammen arbeitest Du außerdem mit unserem Marketing bei Kampagnen und Events sowie mit unseren Kodierexpert:innen und dem medizinischen Team, um zu verstehen, worauf es Kliniken wirklich ankommt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Türen zu Kliniken öffnen: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Kliniken, von privaten Klinikgruppen über kommunale und ländliche Häuser bis zu Unikliniken, recherchierst die richtigen Entscheider:innen in Geschäftsführung, Finanzen, Medizincontrolling und Kodierung und gehst Inbound Leads schnell nach.

  • Gespräche starten, die zählen: Du sprichst Kliniken per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an, mit Sequenzen, die auf den jeweiligen Kliniktyp und seine Herausforderungen zugeschnitten sind.

  • Qualifizieren und Demos buchen: Du findest heraus, ob echter Bedarf besteht, wer entscheidet und wann und buchst Demos für unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen mit sauberer Übergabe.

  • Unsere Pipeline up-to-date halten: Du hältst unser CRM sauber, baust Dashboards und bereitest Pipeline- und Forecast-Reportings für unseren VP Sales vor.

  • Mit KI automatisieren: Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen für Recherche, Datenanreicherung und Outreach, damit unser Team weniger Zeit mit Routine und mehr Zeit mit Kliniken verbringt.

  • Unseren Vertrieb mitgestalten: Du schreibst SOPs, schärfst Sequenzen und Playbook, unterstützt den Deal Desk bei Angeboten und Business Cases und recherchierst den Klinikmarkt und unseren Wettbewerb.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Studium: Du studierst BWL, VWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Gesundheitsökonomie, Medizin oder ein anderes relevantes Feld und suchst ein Vollzeitpraktikum über mindestens sechs Monate.

  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits durch ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in Vertrieb, Business Development, Beratung oder einem Start-up praktische Erfahrung gesammelt.

  • Keine Scheu vorm Telefon: Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu, auch auf erfahrene Entscheider:innen, und bleibst nach einem „Nein“ freundlich und hartnäckig.

  • Strukturiert und datenaffin: Du bist sicher in Excel und hältst Daten gern sauber. CRM-Erfahrung, idealerweise mit Pipedrive, ist ein Plus.

  • KI-nativ: Du nutzt KI-Tools täglich und hast Lust, Automatisierungen zu bauen. Erfahrung mit Tools wie n8n, Make oder Zapier ist ein Plus.

  • Neugier aufs Gesundheitswesen: Du willst verstehen, wie Krankenhäuser funktionieren. Erste Kenntnisse in DRG-Systematik oder ICD/OPS-Kodierung sind ein Plus, kein Muss.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch verhandlungssicher oder als Muttersprache und Englisch fließend.

  • Arbeitsort: Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin oder München

Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ownership ab Tag eins: Du verantwortest Deine eigene Pipeline und treibst den Erfolg von Valova in Deine Vertriebsregion maßgeblich voran.

  • Direkter Draht zur Vertriebsleitung. Du arbeitest täglich eng mit Stephan zusammen, unserem VP Sales und erfahrenen Scale-up-Executive. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Lernen im Start-up-Tempo. Du erlebst hier in einem Jahr mehr als anderswo in drei.

  • Ein Team, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort im WeWork am Odeonsplatz in München und im WeWork in Berlin-Mitte. Dich erwarten voll ausgestattete Büros mit Kaffee, Meetingräumen und Phone Booths, eine zentrale Lage und gute Lunch-Spots direkt um die Ecke.

  • Ein Team mit großen Zielen. Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Entwickler:innen und Kolleg:innen aus Vertrieb und Operations, die sich ehrgeizige Ziele setzen und alles daransetzen, sie gemeinsam zu übertreffen.

  • Team-Events, die München und Berlin zusammenbringen, denn die Menschen, mit denen Du baust, sollten auch die sein, mit denen Du feierst.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Nach 1 Monat kennst Du unser Produkt, unsere Zielkliniken und Pipedrive in- und auswendig, und Deine ersten Outreach-Sequenzen laufen.

  • Nach 3 Monaten buchst Du regelmäßig qualifizierte Demos für unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen, unsere Pipedrive-Daten sind sauber und Deine ersten Dashboards und Automatisierungen sind live.

  • Zum Ende deines Praktikums hast Du eine messbare Pipeline aufgebaut, die SOPs und Sequenzen, die Du geschrieben hast, sind Teil unseres Playbooks und Deine Automatisierungen sparen dem Team jede Woche Zeit.

  • Die ganze Zeit über hat das, was Du in Gesprächen hörst, unsere Botschaften mitgeprägt und uns geholfen, den Markt besser zu verstehen.

So läuft Dein Bewerbungsprozess

Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf samt Gehaltsvorstellung mit deiner Bewerbung hoch. Für die nächsten Schritte melden wir uns zeitnah bei dir:

  1. Kennenlernen (30 Min.): Wir lernen uns kennen, sprechen über deinen Werdegang und beantworten deine ersten Fragen.

  2. Gespräch mit unserem VP Sales (30 Min.): Wir sprechen über Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und Deine Ideen für Valova und Deine Vorstellungen für das Praktikum.

  3. Case: Du führst mit uns ein kurzes Discovery-Gespräch oder einen Pitch anhand eines realistischen Klinikszenarios. Hier zeigst Du uns, wie du verkaufst.

  4. Referenzen: Wir sprechen mit zwei oder drei Personen, mit denen Du zusammengearbeitet hast, zum Beispiel ehemaligen Vorgesetzten, Kolleg:innen oder Kund:innen.

  5. Angebot: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, hörst Du schnell von uns.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Identität.

descriptionHtml:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Many management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds, yet they struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren’t built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so our clients can launch and run ETFs at scale, helping broaden the access to the market beyond a small group of dominant, US-based providers.

𝘕𝘢𝘳𝘰𝘐𝘘 𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘎𝘋𝘗 𝘰𝘧 𝘌𝘶𝘳𝘰𝘱𝘦.

You will own end-to-end responsibility for the ETFs we run: smooth product launches, day-to-day execution and oversight, as well as continuous platform evolution in collaboration with our product team. This is a strongly hands-on role combining investment expertise, market microstructure understanding, operational excellence and cross-functional execution.

You will gain 𝘥𝘦𝘦𝘱 𝘦𝘹𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘧𝘶𝘭𝘭 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘪𝘯, from investment implementation and market mechanics to operational and technology execution. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂’𝗹𝗹 𝗗𝗼

  • Manage creation/redemptions and associated cash flows; oversee daily ETF operations from a portfolio perspective

  • Support larger secondary market transactions, produce/interpret trade reporting and support ETF launches

Portfolio Management

  • Take investment ownership for assigned ETFs, actively optimizing portfolio construction, risk and execution to enhance tracking and liquidity

  • Execute portfolio replication and rebalancing

Clients and Ecosystem

Working with Product

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
department: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
descriptionHtml:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning.

Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects.


Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research.

Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations.

Starting date: Fall 2026
