descriptionHtml:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

  • Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system.

  • Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency.

  • Assess and benchmark the energy, performance, and accuracy trade-offs of ternary IMC against binary CMOS and binary NVM-based IMC reference implementations, using both synthetic benchmarks and real application workloads.

  • Contribute to the definition of a design methodology for ternary ferroelectric circuits, including EDA tool flows, cell library characterization guidelines, and design rules, with the aim of enabling broader community adoption.


Required Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate holds a PhD in microelectronics, computer architecture, or a closely related field, and demonstrates at least one of the following hard skills:

  • Circuit and architecture design: Strong expertise in digital circuit design flows and computer architecture, with hands-on experience using industrial EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Synopsys). Experience with standard-cell library characterization is a plus.

  • Emerging memory technologies: Solid knowledge of non-volatile memory devices, preferably including ferroelectric materials (FeFET, FeCap) or resistive memories (RRAM, PCM). Familiarity with compact modeling is an asset.

  • System-level design and simulation: Experience with architecture-level simulation frameworks and hardware/software co-design methodologies. Knowledge of RISC-V ecosystems is a plus.

  • Application domains: Familiarity with deep neural network inference workloads and/or digital signal processing pipelines, particularly in the context of approximate or energy-constrained computing.

  • Programming: Proficiency in HDL (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A) and scripting languages (Python, Shell) for design automation and simulation.

Soft skills: Scientific leadership, ability to coordinate with PhD students and international partners, strong publication record consistent with career stage, and excellent written and oral communication in English.

Language: Fluent scientific English is mandatory. French is not required but is welcome.

title: Chef.fe de Projet numérique en santé / Project Manager Healthtech
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations

L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.

En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

  • Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

  • Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

  • Coordonner Business Development, Ops Manager et R&D.

  • Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

  • Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

  • Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

  • Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

  • Des bases en interopérabilité et en flux de données.

  • La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

  • Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

  • Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

  • L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

  • Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

Soft skills

Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.

Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.

Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.

👥 Process de recrutement

  1. Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste.

  2. Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés.

  3. Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. Lors de la restitution, tu présenteras ton raisonnement et la façon dont tu cadres un déploiement sur le plan fonctionnel. L’objectif est d’évaluer ta capacité à structurer un plan de déploiement, prioriser les actions et les risques, coordonner les parties prenantes et communiquer avec le client.

  4. Entretien Cultural Alignement avec Raphaël, VP ops - 30 min. Cet échange permet de discuter de ta façon de travailler, de ta collaboration avec les autres équipes et de revenir sur d’éventuels sujets à approfondir après les premières étapes.

    Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour dans les 72 heures suivant chaque étape.

Compensation: €44K – €49K

title: Chief Information Security Officer
descriptionHtml:
Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

What you'll do

You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

  • Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

  • Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

  • Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

  • Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

  • Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

  • Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

  • Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

  • Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

  • Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

  • Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

Who you work with

You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM.


What you bring

You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who:

• Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar.

• Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits.

• Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM.

• Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs.

• Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed.

• Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer.

• Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes.

• Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage.

Will be a plus:

• CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.

• Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs.

• Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators.

• Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000.

• Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets.

• Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment.

What you get

You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto.

• Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us.

• A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk.

• Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions.

• Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work.

• Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance.

Ockto also offers:

• A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience

• Room and budget for personal and professional development

• A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice

• Phone and travel allowance

• Great home and remote working facilities

• Lunch fee

• Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings

You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.

About Ockto

Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time.

Ockto. Built for trust.

Ready to join?

Do you see yourself as our new CISO? Then apply directly. After you apply, we'll contact you within five working days to discuss the role and answer your questions.

Want to know more first? Contact us at company culture, core values and recruitment process, or our other vacancies? Take a look at ockto.recruitee.com.

Your data is safe

At Ockto, we only use your CV and motivation letter during the application process to assess your application. If we don't proceed, we keep your application data for four weeks.

title: Chief of Staff (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

TACTILIA is entering a new chapter as an independent company, following its spin-off from SCHUNK. As Chief of Staff, you will work closely with the leadership team as a key operational and strategic partner, helping shape and drive the company’s next phase of growth.

This is a high-ownership role, you will operate across strategy, technology, product, business and operations, taking on the TACTILIA’s most important and ambiguous problems and driving them from idea to outcome.

You will help build the operating infrastructure that allows TACTILIA to scale without losing its speed, ambition or quality.

What you will do:

  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the leadership and help drive the company’s highest-priority initiatives.

  • Own the leadership´s operating rhythm, including strategic planning, leadership meetings, company priorities.

  • Take ownership of complex cross-functional problems where no obvious owner exists from defining the problem through to execution.

  • Build the processes, tools and systems that help TACTILIA operate more effectively as the team grows.

  • Drive strategic and operational initiatives across technology, product, commercial, hiring and organisational development.

  • Build and maintain a clear view of company performance, translating data into insights, priorities and actions.

  • Partner with the leadership on headcount planning, resource allocation, partnerships, fundraising and other critical company decisions.

  • Identify bottlenecks and opportunities before they become problems, and design pragmatic solutions.

What you bring:

  • Several years of experience in a highly demanding and fast-paced environment, such as a startup, scale-up, consulting, investment, strategy, operations, or another relevant leadership environment.

  • Tool stack fluency/requirements Project management, collaboration and productivity tools?

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and strong presentation skills in PowerPoint/Google Slides.

  • Excellent project and stakeholder management skills.

  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders and diverse teams.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.

  • A high level of ownership, initiative, and personal accountability.

  • Comfortable working in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

  • The ability to move seamlessly between high-level strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Bonus:

  • Exposure to a corporate spin-off or carve-out process — understanding how a new entity separates from and continues to work with a parent company

  • Experience working in or with a startup or scale-up in robotics, deep-tech, or another hardware-intensive industry

As Chief of Staff, you will work closely with the leadership team, gain broad exposure across the organization, and have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the company's strategy, execution, and development.

You will join an ambitious team working on meaningful challenges and will have significant ownership from day one.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Chief of Staff to the CTO (gn)
descriptionHtml:
Nah an den Entscheidungen: die rechte Hand des CTO in einer europaweiten KI-Transformation

Arbeitsort: Metropolregion Rhein-Ruhr, hybrid. Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort im Team, aber nicht jeden Tag. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei rund 5 bis 10 Prozent.

​

Das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte, europäisch aufgestellte Dienstleistungsgruppe mit Landesgesellschaften in einem guten Dutzend Ländern, mehr als 10.000 Beschäftigten und über einer halben Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Das Geschäft lebt von Daten, Prozessen und schnellen Entscheidungen, also genau dort, wo KI den größten Hebel hat. Deshalb baut sich die Gruppe gerade von Grund auf neu: kein Pilot in einer Abteilung, sondern ein Umbau von Organisation, Produkt und Arbeitsweise über alle Länder hinweg. Das große Transformationsprogramm startet jetzt, und du bist von Anfang an dabei. Dahinter stehen ein neu aufgestelltes Leadership-Team, ein CTO, der selbst aus der Top-Beratung kommt, und ein langfristig denkender Eigentümer. Ein eigenes Plattformteam entwickelt bereits die KI-Anwendung und erste Agenten, und mit dem neuen Innovation Hub bekommt die Transformation ihren eigenen Ort.

Bei so vielen parallelen Vorhaben wird schnell zur entscheidenden Frage, wer alles zusammenhält und Entscheidungen rechtzeitig reif macht. Genau dafür entsteht jetzt direkt beim CTO die Rolle des Chief of Staff.

​

Deine Aufgaben

Als rechte Hand des CTO bist du Dreh- und Angelpunkt zwischen Vorstand, Führungskräften und Engineering und koordinierst übergreifende Projektteams.

  • Du bringst die wichtigsten Vorhaben des CTO ins Ziel.

  • Du entwickelst mit, wie die Technologieorganisation aufgebaut ist und gesteuert wird (Operating Model).

  • Du prägst mit, wie KI die Arbeit verändert, von der Softwareentwicklung bis zum Alltag in den Ländern.

  • Du bereitest Entscheidungen für den Vorstand vor und vertrittst dabei eine eigene Meinung.

  • Du sorgst für eine belastbare Faktenbasis: Was kosten Technologie, Partner und Anwendungen, und wer arbeitet woran?

  • Mit HR entwickelst du Rollen, Skills und Talente im Technologiebereich.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.”

What that looks like day to day

As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs.

You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features.

We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters.

We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster.

Who you are

  • You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine.

  • You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production.

  • You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature.

  • You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer.

  • You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it.

  • You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it.

  • Bonus: Go or Postgres security, policy-as-code, supply chain security, or securing AI/LLM-powered products.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £110K – £200K • Offers Equity

title: CMM Programmer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Own dimensional inspection at our Hamburg factory, from CMM programming and first article inspection to non-conformance root cause and audit readiness.

You will build the metrology function rather than inherit one: inspection programmes, probing and datum strategy, gauge calibration, and how quality data flows back into machining and MasonOS. You program it, you measure it, you sign it off.

What you'll do

  • Program and optimise CMM inspection routines in PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso or equivalent for complex, tight-tolerance parts.

  • Run first article inspection (EN 9102), in-process inspection and final sign-off for aerospace, defence and energy work.

  • Set probing strategy, fixturing and datum schemes, and build inspection fixtures where needed.

  • Find the root cause of non-conformances and take the corrective action back to the machine with our machinists and CAM programmers.

  • Own calibration of all measuring equipment and keep records to EN 9100 standard, ready for customer and certification audits.

What we're looking for

  • Several years of hands-on CMM programming in precision manufacturing, aerospace or a machine shop.

  • Strong practical command of PC-DMIS and/or Zeiss Calypso.

  • Deep working knowledge of GD&T and ISO GPS, and confident with customer 3D CAD models.

  • Aerospace inspection documentation: FAI, AS9102 or EN 9102.

  • Able to measure and verify tolerances of ±0.01 mm and tighter.

Nice to have

  • Building a quality function from scratch, or taking a site through EN 9100 or AS9100.

  • GD&T certification or a quality management qualification.

  • In-process probing on 5-axis machines with closed-loop correction.

  • SPC and process capability analysis.

  • Some English, for working with our UK and US teams.

Why Isembard

  • Own the quality function of a new factory from day one.

  • Work on mission-critical aerospace and defence components.

  • Set inspection standards that our network will use.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Hamburg factory.

Applications in German or English are welcome. Lieber auf Deutsch? Hier bewerben.

Isembard is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Collections & Recoveries Advisor
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Collections & Recoveries Advisor

This is an early arrears collections role. You'll spend your day speaking with business customers who have fallen behind on their loan repayments — having direct, sometimes difficult conversations to understand why a payment has been missed and discussing options to recover what's owed. It's commercial and target-driven, but done the iwoca way: we don't use a dialler, because we'd rather give you time to have meaningful conversations and find the right outcome for each account.

The team

The Collections & Recoveries team at iwoca is responsible for supporting customers who have fallen behind on repayments, with a focus on achieving fair, sustainable outcomes for both the customer and the business.

The team takes a customer-first, solutions-oriented approach, working closely with small to medium business owners to understand their financial situation and discuss forbearance options available to customer. They balance empathy with commercial awareness, ensuring regulatory compliance while protecting iwoca’s loan portfolio.

Where you’ll work

This is a hybrid role based in Leeds. For your first month you'll be in the office every day for training, with the expectation dropping to once or twice a week thereafter.

The role

Our advisors keep customers on track and step in when repayments don't go to plan. Through regular contact, you'll build relationships with customers in early arrears — understanding why payments have been missed, agreeing how to resolve them, and scheduling the next steps.

iwoca's advisors handle high levels of inbound and outbound calls, and sending emails and WhatsApp messages with the greatest level of care, in a diligent, professional and efficient manner and nare able to Negotiate, implement and monitor feasible repayment solutions that take into account the customersclient’s circumstances while balancing the best interests of the business

A day in the life:

  • Working through your assigned portfolio of accounts in early arrears, managing outbound and inbound calls alongside email and WhatsApp correspondence

  • Understanding each customers unique circumstances you’ll discuss the options available to them

  • Whether it’s agreeing a little extra time for payment, or gathering supporting information to consider reduced payments, managing customer expectations is essential

  • Following up when an arrangement is broken and deciding the right next course of action. We empower you to own decisions on your portfolio.

  • Keeping clear, accurate notes and staying on top of your follow-ups and emails each day

Requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential/You'll need:

  • Resilience, and the ability to stay calm and professional in difficult or confrontational conversations

  • Comfortable working towards individual targets and KPIs

  • A patient, empathetic and professional manner, especially in difficult conversations

  • Strong communication skills on both phone and email

  • High levels of accuracy and attention to detail

  • The ability to deal with a variety of challenges, innovate and think on your feet

Desirable / Nice to have

  • Proven experience in debt recovery, ideally in the commercial/business sector in a call based environment

  • Experience collecting business debt

  • Insolvency or litigation experience

  • A track record of managing a large portfolio of debts

  • Business acumen, entrepreneurial spirit with real enthusiasm for helping SMEs

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

The salary

Our base salary range in Leeds is £28,500 - £33,000. We want to pay all of our employees fairly, so that’s why we regularly benchmark salaries based on market rates and to recognise your increasing value to our business.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

title: Commercial Senior Manager, Expansion Markets
descriptionHtml:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the Role

We’re looking for a sharp, commercially-minded finance leader to own our Germany Expansion Market's financial strategy and lay the foundations for European expansion.

You'll act as the central voice on performance, forecasting, and financial decision-making. From CAC and contribution margin to free cash flow and scenario planning, you’ll be responsible for turning financial insight into action.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional leaders across growth, operations, product, and care to shape the our Germany and AMEA Expansion Market's financial trajectory, while ensuring the business runs efficiently and invests wisely. This is a high-trust, high-impact role where the stakes, and the pace, are high.

While this role is DE and Expansion market focused today, it has clear runway to grow into a broader European leadership role as we expand across new markets and business lines.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Own the Germany and AMEA Expansion Market financial model — Build and manage end-to-end models for revenue, CAC, LTV, margin, and free cash flow. Your outputs will guide day-to-day decisions and long-term bets.
  • Lead the planning process — Drive monthly re-forecasting, annual planning, and scenario modelling in close collaboration with Group FP&A.
  • Be the commercial partner to growth and ops — Set CAC and payback targets, assess performance by cohort, and guide spend allocation to maximise ROI.
  • Run commercial analysis that unlocks growth — Lead deep dives into pricing, retention, margin, and expansion levers to identify opportunities and recommend trade-offs.
  • Make the numbers visible — Build dashboards and trackers for key DE performance metrics (e.g. contribution margin, CAC, LTV, cash flow), keeping the business tightly aligned.
  • Ensure clean, accurate financial operations — Partner with Group Finance on reconciliations, cost allocation, and timely month-end closes.
  • Build for scale — Design financial systems and insights that don’t just serve the German markets, but become the blueprint for future markets.

About You

Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years in strategic finance, FP&A, consulting, or banking, with experience in high-growth or tech-enabled businesses.
  • Proven experience owning P&L and end-to-end planning processes — ideally in a business with both consumer and operational complexity.
  • Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, payback, cash flow dynamics, and how these fuel long-term value creation.
  • Highly proficient in Google Sheets / Excel (bonus points for SQL, Looker, NetSuite, or similar tools).
  • Strong commercial instincts — you're as comfortable in the numbers as you are helping teams make smart, trade-off decisions.

Behaviours & Attitudes

  • You move fast and bias toward action, even without perfect information.
  • You bring a strong point of view, but you’re open to challenge and new ideas.
  • You get energy from messy, complex problems and know how to bring structure and clarity.
  • You own outcomes, not just analysis — you want to see your insights drive performance.
  • You’re calm under pressure, confident with ambiguity, and committed to delivering impact.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

  • What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
  • Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
  • Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
  • Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
  • Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in the UK

  • Invest in your growth – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave
  • Work flexibly – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration
  • Support your well-being – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you
  • Take time off – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year
  • Join a connected team – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

descriptionHtml:

ALMMA, c'est la rencontre de deux pépites de l'agroalimentaire français : Foo Seng (spécialiste des snacks asiatiques) et Varachaux (expert des produits élaborés viande & végétal). Notre ADN ! L'énergie d'une start-up, la solidité d'un outil industriel. Pas de contradiction ici : on avance à la vitesse d'une équipe qui construit, avec la rigueur d'un groupe qui pilote des volumes, des flux et des échéances réelles.

Le poste

Au sein d'une équipe finance nouvellement créée et en plein déploiement, vous êtes le/la partenaire privilégié(e) de nos usines. C'est une création de poste clé, conçue pour un profil qui aime faire parler la donnée au cœur des ateliers de fabrication ! Rattaché(e) directement au CFO Groupe

En clair : une feuille blanche, un vrai mandat de builder. Vous ne reprenez pas un système existant, vous le créez, vous le modernisez, vous le simplifiez.

Vos missions

Envie de faire parler la donnée sur le terrain ALMMA !

Véritable chef d'orchestre de la performance industrielle, vous co-construisez nos indicateurs et accompagnez nos équipes de production pour maximiser la création de valeur :

Vos Missions :

  1. Calcul & Analyse Fine des Coûts de Revient :
  • Établir, suivre et auditer les coûts de revient standards et réels de l'ensemble de nos gammes (matières premières, emballages, main-d'œuvre directe, fluides et énergies).
  • Décomposer les nomenclatures (BOM) et valider les gammes opératoires avec la R&D et la production.
  1. Pilotage des Écarts & Performance des Ateliers :
  • Analyser au quotidien et à la semaine les écarts de fabrication : rendements matières, freintes, taux de rebuts/pertes et surconsommations.

  1. Proximité & Business Partnering Usine :
  • Travailler en immersion auprès des directeurs de site, chefs d'atelier et responsables Supply Chain.
  • Animer des routines de performance visuelle et accompagner les opérationnels dans la mise en œuvre de plans d'actions correctifs chiffrés.
  1. Processus Budgétaire & Suivi des Investissements (CAPEX) :
  • Participer activement à la construction du budget industriel et aux révisions budgétaires périodiques.
  • Modéliser le ROI de nos projets d'investissements machines/automatisation et suivre la réalisation des enveloppes CAPEX.
  1. Gestion & Valorisation des Stocks :
  • Garantir la justesse et la valeur des stocks (matières, emballages, produits finis et en-cours).
  • Superviser les inventaires physiques, analyser les écarts d'inventaire et piloter les provisions pour dépréciations / péremptions (DLC).
  1. Amélioration Continue & Outillage :
  • Automatiser les reportings industriels et créer des tableaux de bord dynamiques en lien avec l'équipe finance.
  • Effectuer des simulations financières pour le lancement de nouvelles recettes ou la rationalisation de nos formats produits.

Vos compétences

  • 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion industriel, idéalement en agroalimentaire ou industrie manufacturière
  • Maîtrise de la comptabilité analytique, des méthodes de calcul de coûts de revient et des ERP industriels ;
  • Niveau expert Excel, appétence pour les outils BI
  • Français & Anglais courant, ecrit comme à l'oral !

  • Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop.

  • Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen.
  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

Aufgaben

Performance Creatives

  • Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter.
  • Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein.

Social Media & Organic Content

  • Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform.
  • Du entwickelst Templates, die dem Content-Team schnelle, markenkonforme Veröffentlichungen ermöglichen.

Shop, Amazon & Brand

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für alle Bannerbilder, Kampagnen-Visuals und Shopbilder – von Landingpage-Headern.
  • Du hältst unser visuelles Erscheinungsbild über alle Kanäle konsistent und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

Produktion & Workflow

  • Du integrierst KI-Tools in deinen Workflow – für Ideation, Bildvarianten, Freisteller, Übersetzungen oder Schnitt-Unterstützung – und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Schnitterfahrung: Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher – Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbar – und lieferst aus Rohmaterial eigenständig fertige, plattformgerechte Video-Creatives inklusive Schnittrhythmus, Text-Overlays, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Grafik: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma oder vergleichbare Tools sind dein Handwerkszeug. Freisteller, Retusche, Composings, Layouts und saubere Exportformate für Web, Social und Amazon gehen dir leicht von der Hand.
  • Ein Portfolio, das beides zeigt – Video und Static.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Grafik-, Motion- oder Creative Designer:in, idealerweise im E-Commerce, D2C oder in einer Performance-Agentur.
  • Ein Verständnis dafür, was Performance Creatives von schönen Grafiken unterscheidet: Hook, Klarheit, Tempo, Lesbarkeit auf dem Handy.
  • Gespür für Social-Plattformen: Du weißt, wie Content auf TikTok, Instagram und Pinterest aussehen muss, um nicht weggewischt zu werden.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du jonglierst mehrere Aufträge parallel, hältst Deadlines und behältst den Überblick über Formate, Versionen und Assets.

Das zählt für uns am meisten

  • Lust darauf, wirklich das ganze visuelle Spektrum zu bespielen, Neugier auf neue Tools und die Motivation, mit der Rolle und dem Team zu wachsen. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus – für alles darüber hinaus ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in der Bild- oder Videoproduktion (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs).
  • Fotografie- oder Kamera-Erfahrung für Shootings.
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify (Bildformate, Theme-Assets) oder Amazon-Bildrichtlinien.
  • Erfahrung im Fitness- oder Sport-Umfeld.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt unter „außerdem wichtig“? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert dein Portfolio und wie du denkst – nicht, ob du jede Zeile abhaken kannst.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Zu Shootings triffst du das Team vor Ort – der Rest läuft von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware und den Tools, die du brauchst, erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst das visuelle Erscheinungsbild einer wachsenden Marke und gestaltest den Aufbau unserer Inhouse-Creative-Produktion aktiv mit – inklusive KI-basierter Workflows.
  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – und darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Kontakt: Josephine Steuer

Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Bei uns gibt es keinen Dresscode und wir duzen uns einfach. Der Einfachheit halber verwenden wir im Text eine Sprachform, schließen damit aber ausdrücklich alle Menschen ein.

title: Creative Lead
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Creative Lead to help shape how tem shows up in the world. This is a senior, hands-on creative role sitting within our Brand & Credibility team, working closely with Product and Growth to turn strategy into work that's bold, sharp, and unmistakably tem. You'll report into the Senior Brand Lead and work closely together to build strong brand foundations and multi-channel campaigns that compound on each other for outsized impact. You won't just be setting direction from the sidelines. You'll be in the work daily, building alongside our existing creative team, low ego, high craft, always moving fast without dropping the bar.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Establish a clear creative system for tem's brand, from visual identity to campaign storytelling, that makes our work instantly recognisable.

  • Ship standout creative across a major launch or campaign that builds real emotional connection with a specific audience.

  • Take ownership of our tem self-serve creative AI tool, driving adoption across the larger organisation to reduce rote work without sacrificing quality.

  • Set up metric tracking and reporting for the studio, establishing a baseline for speed of execution and reporting progress against it.

  • Define what "fast and high quality" looks like for the studio, and put the systems in place to make it repeatable.

  • Identify and close a skills gap on the team through collaboration, hands-on coaching or targeted training.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the creative system: Translate our strategy and positioning into a distinctive visual identity, storytelling, and campaigns that make tem culturally relevant and instantly recognisable.

  • Build with impact: Deliver standout creative across launches, campaigns, web, and product moments that captures attention and builds emotional connection with specific audiences.

  • Lead an AI-first practice: Use modern AI tools and workflows to accelerate concepting, iteration, and production, and take ownership of our internal self-serve creative AI tool.

  • Lead without dictating: Put the systems and standards in place that everyone works to, and remove the blockers that get in the way of great work. You won't be across every project or act as gatekeeper - leadership here means levelling people up, not creative dictatorship.

  • Maintain high standards: Establish strong creative standards and help everyone produce work that feels bold, coherent, and world-class.

  • Balance pace and quality: Move fast without sacrificing craft, and bring the same energy to a scrappy project as to a major activation.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Brand, Product, and Growth to make sure creative work drives real business outcomes, from brand awareness to product adoption.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • In-house experience shaping or evolving a strong brand, having played a key role in building a brand identity, campaign platform, or creative system that meaningfully changed how a company was perceived.

  • Practical, proactive experience bringing AI-driven tools into a business, with a track record of accelerating concepting, design, storytelling, or production.

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative craft, with bold, memorable work across brand, campaigns, and digital experiences.

  • Startup or scale-up experience, shipping quickly in a fast-moving environment while holding a high bar for quality.

  • Experience working across channels and with a range of budgets, from scrappy to significant, with equal commitment to both.

  • Leadership experience, paired with a genuine willingness to stay hands-on and do the work rather than only direct it.

Desirable

  • Experience in energy, fintech, or another highly regulated industry.

  • Experience working in a remote-first organisation.

  • Motion design experience.

Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team (30 mins).

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins).

  • Practical Interview with the Team (45 mins).

  • Bar Raiser Interview with a Business Leader (45 mins).

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Creative Strategist - Social Ads
descriptionHtml:

Notre mission est de permettre à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs de croissance via des stratégies en Social ads & Search (SEA/SEO/GEO).

Basés à Bordeaux et lancés à la fin de l'année 2022, l'équipe atteindra bientôt 20 collaborateurs.

Vos missions

En tant que Creative Strategist, vous aurez à votre charge un portefeuille de clients pour lesquels vous devrez proposer des idées créatives pour leurs publicités sur les réseaux sociaux (concept & copywriting), en fonction de leurs objectifs, de leur industrie, de leurs cibles et des tendances sur les réseaux.

Les missions dans le détail :

  • Définition de la stratégie et roadmap créative de nos clients.
  • Veille concurrentielle des tendances sur les réseaux sociaux.

Avantages

Du verantwortest Kampagnen und automatisierte Kommunikation entlang des gesamten Customer Lifecycles – datenbasiert, kreativ und mit klarem kommerziellem Fokus.

Das wirst du meistern

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

An den übrigen Tagen kannst du von zuhause aus arbeiten - zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr aus Ländern innerhalb der EU zu arbeiten. Außerdem profitierst du von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich an deine individuellen Bedürfnisse anpassen.

Ob Online-Training, Massagen oder Stretching am Arbeitsplatz – es ist für jeden etwas dabei. Außerdem kannst du zu einem vergünstigten Mitgliedspreis ein Abo bei Urban Sports Club oder Wellhub abschließen.

title: Customer Director
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Retail and Consumer team is dedicated to helping clients deliver their strategic objectives through the successful application of Data Science and Frontier AI.

Our work spans the full spectrum of AI capabilities from machine learning to computer vision, simulation, optimisation, generative AI, agentic systems, and bringing these capabilities together in decision intelligence applications. Our solutions help clients understand and better engage with customers, improve commercial and trading decisions, improve the efficiency of end to end operations, and improve colleague experience.

About the role

As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts and shape our go-to-market strategy in order to achieve our ambitious growth targets.

You will act as a strategic partner to our Retail clients, helping them reinvent the way they engage with customers, and the way they operate across commercial, supply chain, stores, online and support functions with AI. You will build enduring relationships with senior stakeholders, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact.

This is an opportunity to help build a distinctive practice inside a company with world-class technical depth and the ambition to set the standard for AI in the Retail sector.

The ideal candidate will be T-shaped: broad enough to advise across AI for a range of firms including adjacent consumer facing sectors, with deep experience in Grocery and/or Fashion & Apparel sectors. We are particularly interested in candidates who have delivered enterprise AI solutions that have enabled real world impact.

What you'll be doing:

  • Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and identifying new clients within the Retail sector (specifically Grocery and Fashion & Apparel)

  • Leading complex AI transformation programmes for major Retail clients, moving from strategic thinking to production-grade software delivery

  • Building trusted, long-term relationships with C-suite leaders and partners, acting as a strategic advisor on how AI can automate knowledge work and drive operational efficiency

  • Generating high-value growth for Faculty by shaping compelling commercial pitches and demos that showcase our technical depth and ability to solve sector-specific challenges

  • Elevating Faculty’s industry profile by articulating differentiated propositions and points of view through thought leadership, media engagement, and industry forums

  • Ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality client work by guiding multidisciplinary teams and helping them navigate the ambiguity and pace of the sector

  • Managing a practice within a practice - leading cross-functional teams of delivery experts, PhD-calibre engineers and data scientists to further consolidate Faculty’s reputation for pioneering technical and delivery excellence.

Who we're looking for:

  • You’ve managed C-level, complex stakeholder relationships in the Retail industry, with a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships and navigating strategic commercial conversations with confidence

  • You’re commercially driven - energised by hitting growth targets with a proven track record of shaping opportunities, winning work, and owning meaningful revenue responsibility

  • You are delivery-focused and technically credible, with a track record of translating complex AI concepts with clarity to technical and non-technical audiences

  • You are comfortable working alongside deeply technical teams and possess the curiosity to master and discuss AI applications.

  • You exhibit a leadership mindset that balances executive-level strategy with a hands-on approach to unblocking teams, challenging work constructively, and maintaining high quality

  • Some experience in consulting preferred

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Commercial Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Customer Operations Specialist - London
descriptionHtml:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

Customer Experience

Plasma is scaling its customer-facing operations across international markets, and we’re growing the Customer Experience Team to match. You’ll join an established team and take ownership of coverage for the CET time zone, making sure our customers get great support when they need it most.

You’ll work across the full customer journey, from first contact through to resolution. Because we’re still building out our playbook, your input will directly shape the processes, standards, and team culture as we grow. You won’t just follow the process; you’ll help refine it.

Some flexibility in working hours & weekend shifts will be needed to support coverage and the occasional busy period. We’re looking for a hard-working self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment and is committed to the mission alongside the rest of the team.

The role

  • Own the customer experience day-to-day: Be the first person our customers reach when something goes wrong or they need help. You will handle inbound queries across chat, email, and support tooling, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response.

  • Be the right hand of the Ops lead: Work directly alongside the Head of Operations to build out processes, identify gaps, and support decisions as we scale the team internationally. This is not a back-office support role. You will be involved in how we think about operations.

  • Build the foundations: We are early. Many of the processes, templates, and escalation paths do not exist yet. You will create them. From response frameworks to internal guides, you will help lay the groundwork the team will rely on as we grow.

  • Support international team scaling: As we hire Ops team members in new markets, you will help onboard them, share knowledge, and maintain consistency in how we deliver for customers across regions.

  • Spot problems before they become patterns: Track issues across the customer base, flag recurring themes to Product and Engineering, and help prioritise fixes that actually move the needle for customers.

  • Work across teams: Collaborate with Compliance, KYC, and Product to make sure the customer experience is joined up, especially during onboarding and verification flows where things can go wrong quickly.

  • Represent the customer internally: Your proximity to customer feedback is valuable. Use it. Bring customer insight into internal conversations and push for improvements that matter.

  • Be Flexible with Shift Rotation: Most weeks you’ll work the normal Mon-Fri, however team members currently rotate weekend shifts which means that you may be required to work a weekend shift once every 6 weeks. You’ll then be able to take those days worked off the following week.

The Bar

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in customer operations, customer success, or a support role, ideally within fintech, payments, or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right.

title: Customer Success Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

As Customer Success Team Lead, you’ll lead a team of approximately five Customer Success Executives. Together, you’ll help qualified SME prospects move through their onboarding journey, converting leads into open, funded and actively used Allica business current accounts.

You’ll coach your team to have confident, consultative conversations with business owners and decision-makers—understanding their existing banking challenges, explaining Allica’s value proposition and supporting them as they switch to Allica.

You’ll be accountable for team performance across the full onboarding journey, while ensuring every prospective customer receives a consistently excellent experience and a strong first impression of Allica Bank.

This is a highly collaborative role. You’ll work closely with Relationship Management, Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, Customer Due Diligence and Operations to improve the onboarding experience, remove friction and create better outcomes for customers.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Working closely with the Sales Managers of Customer Success, The Customer Success Team Leader will provide line management, capacity planning, pipeline management, coaching and development to support a team of Customer Success Executives.

  • Coach team members to engage SME decision-makers confidently by telephone and email, using a consultative approach to understand their needs and banking pain points.

  • Through close collaboration with our Customer Due Diligence, operations leaders and product teams, the Customer Success Team Leader will work to support reducing friction and improving the experience in the customer onboarding journey.

  • Understanding our onboarding process and requirements and supporting customers and prospects through this process to open current accounts and deliver a great customer experience.

  • Gaining feedback from customers and prospects on potential future features they need and want from their bank and bank account and feeding these into the Product teams.

  • Working with our Growth, Marketing and Data teams to feedback your learnings from customer interactions, helping us to drive ever better customer outcomes, targeting, segmentation and messaging.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • You will have managed and led a team either in person or remotely to successfully achieve KPIs relating to customer and colleague experience.

  • You should have a general understanding of SME financial products (eg payments, lending, accounting, CRM), and ideally specific expertise in business current accounts.

  • You will have a proven track record in telephone-based lead generation with established SMEs (typically 5-250 employee firms), including business development from cold prospects.

  • You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, together with evidence of outperformance in similar roles through earning customer and colleague trust.

  • You will demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively with specialist colleagues such as Relationship Managers, Operations, KYCB and underwriters, to deliver a positive outcome for our customers.

  • You’ll have a proven track record of exceeding targets, providing excellent customer service generating new income opportunities and always considering risk and reputation.

  • Experience working collaboratively with specialist teams such as Relationship Managers, Operations, KYC/CDD teams and underwriters.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Customer Support Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Customer Support Manager to lead our support team: six people across two desks, handling around 1,500 tickets a week. One desk helps the landowners and asset managers we work with; the other helps the drivers who park at their sites. This isn’t answering from an FAQ. Many tickets mean investigating across our systems, escalating to TechOps and following up until the problem is fixed.

It’s a role for someone who enjoys making a team better. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, the backing of our COO, and Client Success, TechOps and Product teams to work with on them. You’ll make the case for what the team needs and be hands-on with our helpdesk tools to get there. You’ll lead from the front too, getting stuck into tickets with the team when it’s busy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of six, with regular one-to-ones and clear standards for quality and output.

  • Run the day-to-day across both desks, keeping response times, resolution and the backlog on track.

  • Get stuck in on tickets when the queue is busy, and handle the trickier escalations yourself.

  • Spot what drivers and clients keep contacting us about, and work with other teams to fix the cause.

  • Get the most out of Zendesk, from macros and tagging to reporting.

  • Plan the rota, including Saturday cover, around leave and busy periods.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll need:

  • Experience leading a customer support or service team, ideally on an email or ticket-based desk with targets.

  • A track record of improving how a team performs.

  • Experience setting clear targets, holding people to them and coaching them to get there.

  • Comfortable with Zendesk or a similar tool, and with using data to see what’s going on.

  • Happy getting into the detail of a problem, across systems and teams, to find out what actually went wrong.

  • Curiosity about how automation and AI could make the team’s work easier.

  • Clear, calm writing, even when a customer isn’t, and confidence on the phone with an unhappy client.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service.

  • Experience setting up weekend cover.

  • Laptop and tech provided.

Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home.
