title: Member of Technical Staff (Platform Leaning)
descriptionHtml:
About Tessl

AI is transforming how software is built, and at Tessl, we're building the infrastructure for what comes next.

We're developing a platform that enables engineering teams to build and run AI-powered software factories, where coding agents take on real development work, from picking up engineering tickets to implementing changes and creating pull requests.

By combining structured context, reusable agent skills, automated workflows and evaluations, we're making AI-powered development more reliable, repeatable and scalable, while keeping humans in control. We're tackling some of the biggest challenges in autonomous software development, from code quality and security to helping organisations confidently adopt AI agents at scale.

Founded by Guy Podjarny, previously founder of Snyk, Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup backed by over $100 million in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart.

Joining Tessl means helping define an entirely new category of technology, solving ambitious technical challenges and shaping the future of software development.

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE

Join our engineering team to build real-time AI Native workflows, tooling, and interfaces that will reshape how developers create and maintain software.

This is a product engineering role with a platform twist. Most of your time, you'll do what every Tessl engineer does: design, prototype and ship product features end to end, collaborating closely with product, design and the wider engineering team in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment. What makes you different is that when the work goes below the application layer, you light up rather than back away: complex networking scenarios such as site-to-site VPN and private connectivity, multi-cloud and multi-region deployments, observability, and the machinery that makes Tessl straightforward to deploy, operate and support wherever it needs to run.

We expect you to be relentlessly AI native about it: instead of triaging alerts at 2 am, you'll build or deploy the agent that does it. Instead of reacting to scaling bottlenecks, you'll create systems that spot them before they happen. Deep expertise is the foundation, because you can't automate what you don't know, but your ambition should be to make agents do the bulk of the operational work, with you supervising and steering.

We're open on level for this role, from mid-level to senior: trajectory and appetite matter more to us than years.

What success looks like: Within your first year, you're shipping product features end to end like any Tessl engineer. When infrastructure work arises, from deployment architecture to networking to observability, you're the one who takes it on and lands it well, with support where you need it. Our deployment and operational practices are stronger because of you, agentic tooling handles a growing share of the toil, and the infrastructure work you touch is compliant by default, keeping our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 journey unblocked.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

No two days will be the same at Tessl! You'll have a high level of autonomy and be empowered to make decisions based on what you believe will help you deliver the most success. Here's an insight into just a few of the things you would be doing:

Product engineering (most of your time)

  • Design and implement new functionality end to end, from initial design and prototypes to fully scoped production implementations, reviewed with the product team

  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities to prove or disprove an idea, then develop a plan for a scalable implementation

  • Pair with designers and other engineers to make the experience intuitive and slick, and integrate third-party services so we can focus our cycles on Tessl's core capabilities

  • Gather requirements from customers and stakeholders, turn ambiguity into agreed plans, and deliver them

Platform & infrastructure

  • Lean into infrastructure work as it arises: our AWS estate (EKS/Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and our observability stack (Dash0/OpenTelemetry, Sentry, PostHog)

  • Contribute to the architecture & build of our more complex networking and deployment scenarios, such as private connectivity and multi-region setups

  • Improve developer experience and platform ergonomics so every engineer at Tessl ships faster

  • Partner with our Infosec team so that everything you build is compliant by default, contributing infrastructure controls and evidence towards ISO 27001 and SOC 2

AI-native automation

  • Build or deploy agentic tooling that picks up firing alerts and works through diagnostic steps autonomously, giving a human supervisor a detailed assessment with recommended actions

  • Build agents that keep our estate healthy without human toil: dependency upgrades that test and merge themselves, alerts that arrive pre-diagnosed, runbooks that execute instead of sitting in a wiki

  • Continuously spot repetitive manual work, across product, platform and on-call workflows, and convert it into agent-driven automation

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who is as excited as we are to be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of AI and software development. We're committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Must-haves

  • Proven experience as a Software Engineer (TypeScript/Node preferred): you care about code modularity, structure and aesthetics, and you're equally comfortable contributing to a mature codebase with strict CI criteria or hacking up a quick prototype to prove an assumption

  • A genuine pull towards platform and infrastructure work, backed by hands-on experience: you've deployed and operated real systems (Kubernetes, cloud environments, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD), and when the chance came to go deeper, you took it, whether that was owning platform or DevOps work in a previous role or picking up the infrastructure tasks nobody else wanted

  • Solid systems and networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, VPCs, firewalls; you can reason and debug below the application layer with confidence

  • Demonstrated use of AI coding tools and agents to accelerate your own work, and excitement about experimenting with new AI approaches to transform how engineering is done

  • Comfortable with fast-paced, high-autonomy environments: you turn loose requirements into plans and shipped work without waiting to be told

Nice-to-haves

  • You self-host things for fun: a homelab, your own services, a Kubernetes cluster nobody asked you to run

  • Production AWS/EKS experience, or hands-on work with private connectivity, VPNs, or multi-region architectures

  • Experience producing infrastructure evidence for certifications such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2

  • You've thrived in an early-stage startup before

  • Have a cool project to show us (GitHub links welcome!)

The kind of person you are

  • You're a product engineer first: you measure infrastructure by what it lets the team ship, and you see platform work as making every engineer faster, never a domain to guard

  • You're calm under pressure, including when production is misbehaving and the answer is three layers down the stack

  • You think big about how AI changes the job: the best engineers automate themselves out of the repetitive loop and operate at the scale of a team

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change, and you grab a shovel when something needs doing outside your lane

  • You communicate clearly and bring people along: product, security, engineers and customers all need to trust your judgement

Application Process

Here's an outline of what you can expect during our interview process:

  1. Introductory Call with one of our engineering leaders. A relaxed chat to learn about your background, interests, and career goals. We'll also share more about the role, Tessl's vision, and answer any questions you have.

  2. Take-Home Exercise. You'll receive a practical challenge based on real scenarios you might tackle at Tessl: an opportunity to showcase your approach to problem-solving on your own schedule.

  3. On-site Technical Session. You'll pair with two of our lead engineers to build on your take-home exercise. This session simulates working together on real problems and allows us to explore your technical expertise more deeply.

  4. Culture Conversation with our People Lead. A two-way dialogue about our values, team dynamic, and your motivations. Feel free to ask about life at Tessl, growth opportunities, or anything else you're curious about.

  5. Leadership Discussion with Maurilio (Head of Engineering), and potentially also with Guy (CEO) or Dru (Head of Product). Our final stage focuses on strategic alignment and long-term vision. You'll learn more about Tessl's roadmap and how you could contribute to our mission.

Throughout the process, if you have any specific requirements or need adjustments, please let us know: we're happy to accommodate.

Life at Tessl

We want Tessl to be a place where you can do meaningful work, keep learning and enjoy being part of the team. Alongside competitive compensation, we offer benefits designed to support you both inside and outside work.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity: Market-benchmarked salaries and EMI share options.

  • Time off: 25 days of annual leave, plus UK public holidays, and two paid volunteering days each year.

  • Private healthcare: Vitality medical insurance, including dental, optical and mental health support, with cover included for partners and dependants.

  • Pension: A 5% employer pension matched contribution through Smart Pension.

  • Life assurance: Company-paid life insurance with MetLife providing cover of four times your annual salary.

  • Family Leave: We offer enhanced Maternity, Parental and Adoption Leave from day one to support you and your growing family.

  • Learning and development: We support opportunities to continue developing your skills with a £1,000 per year to spend.

  • Commuting benefits: Financial support for eligible team members commuting from outside Greater London, plus a Cycle to Work scheme.

  • Summer & winter offsites: Twice a year, we bring the whole Tessl team together for a week-long offsite. It's a chance to step away from our usual routines, collaborate on big ideas, build stronger relationships and enjoy shared experiences together. And of course, we have a lot of fun along the way!

Our London HQ

Our office is in the heart of King's Cross, surrounded by London's growing AI and technology community.

We work together in person on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, giving us time to collaborate, exchange ideas and build relationships. You'll also enjoy catered lunches (Tuesday & Thursday), plenty of office snacks, regular team lunches and socials, plus a pet-friendly workplace.

How we work

Our operating principles shape how we collaborate and make decisions. We move quickly and learn by doing, build on ideas before challenging them, get stuck in wherever we can help, and give people real ownership. We encourage thoughtful debate, curiosity and a willingness to try things that haven't been done before. Read our five operating principles.

We're AI native

AI isn't just what we're building - it's central to how we work every day, across every function. We actively use AI to improve how we work, solve problems and challenge traditional ways of doing things.

You don't need to be an AI expert to thrive at Tessl, but you do need curiosity, an appetite for experimentation and a willingness to embrace new ways of working. We expect everyone to use AI regularly, invest time in learning how to get the most from it and keep experimenting when something doesn't work the first time, rather than defaulting to manual approaches.

We're also big believers in sharing what we learn. We encourage transparency about how we're using AI, what's working, what isn't and how we can help each other improve. Being AI native doesn't mean removing human judgement, it means using AI thoughtfully, while taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of our work.

Everyone is welcome at Tessl

We're committed to building an inclusive environment where people from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives can thrive.

We particularly welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in technology. If you're excited about the opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we'd still encourage you to apply.

If you need any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to make the process accessible and comfortable.

Come build with us

We're moving fast, experimenting boldly and figuring things out as we go. There's plenty to build, lots to learn and real opportunities to make your mark.

If you're excited by big ideas, enjoy getting stuck in and want to be part of something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Microsoft 365 Security Engineer*
descriptionHtml:
Über uns und die Rolle

Du suchst einen Job mit Zukunft? Bei der Energiebauern GmbH entwickeln, bauen und betreiben wir seit 2003 leistungsstarke Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien. Unser über 100-köpfiges Team deckt mit seinem breiten Know-how die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette ab – von der Projektentwicklung und Finanzierung über Planung, Bau und Inbetriebnahme bis hin zu Netzbetrieb, Energiewirtschaft und Instandhaltung. Neben Photovoltaik-Freiflächenanlagen umfasst unser Portfolio mittlerweile auch Umspannwerke, Batteriespeicher, Einspeisetrassen und Windenergieanlagen.

Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen legen wir Wert auf Teamgeist und bieten dir spannende Herausforderungen in einem dynamischen und zukunftssicheren Umfeld. Als Betreiber kritischer Infrastruktur tragen wir eine besondere Verantwortung für die Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Energieversorgung. Dabei spielt auch unsere IT-Infrastruktur eine entscheidende Rolle. Deshalb suchen wir Verstärkung, die unsere Microsoft-365-Umgebung eigenverantwortlich betreut, kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt und unsere IT-Sicherheit aktiv mitgestaltet.

Bewirb dich und werde Teil unseres Teams - Begleite den Bau der modernsten und innovativsten Wind- und PV-Projekte in Deutschland!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung, Administration und Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft-365-Umgebung auf technischer und konzeptioneller Ebene

  • Verwaltung von Benutzerkonten, Berechtigungen, Gruppen, Postfächern, Lizenzen, Rufnummern und Endgeräten sowie Begleitung von Mitarbeiterein- und -austritten

  • Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Microsoft-365-Sicherheit anhand des Microsoft Secure Score sowie technische Umsetzung der Anforderungen aus KRITIS und NIS-2

  • Administration von Microsoft Intune und Defender XDR sowie Überwachung und Analyse sicherheitsrelevanter Ereignisse, unter anderem mittels KQL

  • Vorbereitung der Microsoft-365-Umgebung auf den sicheren Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen, insbesondere durch Berechtigungsmanagement, Datenklassifizierung mit Microsoft Purview und kontrollierte Bereitstellung von Copilot, Apps und KI-Agenten

  • Automatisierung und Optimierung von IT-Prozessen mittels PowerShell und Microsoft Graph sowie Weiterentwicklung einer automatisierten und nachvollziehbaren Konfigurationsverwaltung

  • Fachliche Koordination und Steuerung externer IT-Dienstleister

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien - keine Konzernstrukturen

  • Keine externen Gutachter, Kunden oder Budgetplanung, da wir unser eigener Kunde sind

  • Exzellente bestehende technische und wirtschaftliche Expertise für deine Einarbeitung und Unterstützung

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Raum für Eigeninitiaitve bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung und IT-Sicherheit

  • Geschäftsführung mit klarem Fokus auf IT-Sicherheit und kurzen Entscheidungswegen bei der Umsetzung neuer Maßnahmen

  • Ausgezeichnete EDV-Ausstattung mit aktuellen Microsoft-Technologien, Lizenzen und Werkzeugen

  • Zukunftssichere Tätigkeit im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien

  • Gesunde und abwechslungsreiche Mittagsküche

  • Attraktive Benefits

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im IT-Bereich bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch entsprechende Berufserfahrung – entscheidend sind für uns deine fachlichen Kenntnisse und praktischen Fähigkeiten

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Administration und Absicherung von Microsoft 365 und Microsoft Entra ID

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Intune, Defender, Conditional Access und PowerShell

  • Kenntnisse moderner IT-Sicherheitskonzepte sowie Interesse an aktuellen Entwicklungen im Bereich Cloud Security

  • Idealerweise Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie SC-300, MS-102 oder SC-200

  • Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

title: MuleSoft Developer / Integration Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Für Deutschlands größtes unabhängiges Homecare-Unternehmen aus Ahrensburg bei Hamburg suche ich einen Integration Engineer, der Entwicklung und Konzeption verbindet. MuleSoft ist dort das Nervensystem: Es trägt die geschäftskritischen Datenflüsse zwischen Salesforce, SAP und weiteren Kernsystemen. Heute entstehen die Integrationen überwiegend mit externen Entwicklern, deine neu geschaffene Rolle holt dieses Know-how nach innen.

MuleSoft musst du dafür nicht schon aus dem Effeff können: Wer sauber entwickelt und Datenmodelle versteht, lernt die Plattform im Team. Die Rolle ist bewusst breiter geschnitten, etwa zur Hälfte Konzeption, zur Hälfte Hands-on. Wenn du Solution Designs selbst entwerfen willst, statt nur abzuarbeiten, ist das deine Bühne.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Integration & Entwicklung: Du entwickelst Schnittstellen auf MuleSoft Anypoint und bindest Salesforce, SAP und weitere Kernsysteme eigenständig an.

  • Konzeption & Solution Design: Du analysierst Systeme und Datenmodelle, übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in Schnittstellenkonzepte und schreibst Solution Designs selbst.

  • Betrieb & Monitoring: Du überwachst bestehende Schnittstellen, analysierst Fehler, erarbeitest Optimierungen und erkennst, wann ein Major Incident Vorrang hat.

  • Standards & Dokumentation: Du etablierst Integrationsstandards, Best Practices und Dokumentation gemeinsam mit dem Team und den externen Partnern.

Dein Profil

  • Entwicklung & Datenmodelle: Du bringst rund drei intensive Jahre Entwicklungserfahrung mit, bist sicher mit Datenbanken und hast richtig Lust auf Datenmodellierung.

  • Systemblick: Du verstehst komplexe Enterprise-Landschaften, analysierst sie und ziehst eigene Rückschlüsse. Erfahrung mit Integrationsplattformen hilft, MuleSoft ist ein Plus, kein Muss.

  • ITSM-Verständnis: Du kennst Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management aus der Praxis und denkst IT-Betrieb als Teil deiner Rolle mit. Eine ITIL-Zertifizierung brauchst du nicht.

  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest pragmatisch mit Kollegen und externen Partnern, kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch, der Arbeitssprache im Team, und erklärst deine Umsetzungen an konkreten Beispielen.

Das erwartet dich

  • Roadmap mit Substanz: eine neu geschaffene Rolle mit neuen Schnittstellen, gesetzlichen Anbindungen wie E-Rezept, KIM und TIM sowie KI-Use-Cases, MuleSoft Vibes ist bereits im Einsatz.

title: Network Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Network Engineer

 

Location: Belfast

Salary: Competitive

 

Join our team of expert engineers in the Options Networks Team!

 

Working for Options

 

Developing and engaging our people is a strategic priority for our business. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team and contribute to Options’ future growth and success. We want to hear from candidates that are motivated, self-driven and have a passion to learn and develop their skills in the world of financial technology.

 

Who are we?

 

Options is the largest global financial technology company headquartered in Belfast. We are at the forefront of banking and trading infrastructure, serving clients globally with offices in New York, Chicago, Toronto, London, Cambridge, Paris, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, and Auckland. At Options, our services are woven into the hottest trends in global tech, including high-performance Networking, Cloud, Security, and AI (Artificial Intelligence).

 

Why Options?

Global travel: We have offices in New York, Chicago, Toronto, Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, Paris, London, Cambridge, Belfast and more.

 

Career Development: You will have access to professional skills development and technical training designed to help you grow throughout your career with us.

 

High-Performing, Autonomous Teams: Join a self-sufficient, successful team where your ideas can make a real impact.

 

Competitive Rewards: In addition to a competitive salary, we reward our employees with a range of bonus incentives and a comprehensive benefits package.

 

The Role

 

This position offers a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience with enterprise networking technologies across multi-vendor platforms, supporting high-availability, low-latency infrastructure in a global financial technology environment.

 

The successful candidate will work both collaboratively and independently, taking ownership of tasks and contributing to team success.

 

We’re looking for someone who has technical proficiency in:

 

  • A good knowledge of Routing & Switching to a CCNA level or higher.

  • A good attitude and strong work ethic with a willingness to learn in a fast pace working environment.

  • CCNA certification, Linux and Python skills are looked upon favourably.

 

Typical Job duties would include:

 

  • Implement, maintain, troubleshoot and support all aspects of network and security on the Options network infrastructure.

  • Work closely with the global network team (US and APAC).

  • Delivery of changes to the network environment to facilitate the onboarding of new clients, to deliver new features or service to the PIPE platform and to provide support for production issues.

We’re also looking for candidates with:

 

  • Strong research, writing and communication skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and changeable working environment.

  • Exceptional organisational skills and strong attention to detail.

  • Desire to travel and see the world.

  • Ability to work independently and manage your own projects in a professional manner.

  • A passion for innovation and the financial technology sector.

  • Strong interpersonal skills.

  • Project management skills and proven ability to manage own workload.

What We Offer

We provide a competitive benefits package tailored to the technology and financial services sector:

Health & Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare support, risk benefits and digital wellness resources.

Family Support: Enhanced family leave benefits.

Professional Growth: Access to professional learning platforms and internal development programs.

Retirement: Pension/retirement schemes to support your long-term financial planning.

 

How to apply

 

Please submit a CV and cover letter to the Network Engineer position. On your CV, please include a section on your Hobbies and Interests. On the covering letter please detail the role you are applying to, along with your availability.

 

We look forward to discussing how you can make an impact at Options Technology!

title: Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

The Operations Director (East) is fully responsible for end-to-end performance of HIVED's East London depot — currently based in Silvertown, relocating to Rainham.

This role combines the hands-on, day-to-day site leadership of a General Manager with director-level seniority. This is a hands-on leadership role — leading from the floor, owning local P&L levers, and acting as the primary link between central planning/tech and real operational execution. This includes:

  • Full P&L ownership for the site

  • Hiring and org-design authority for the site's team

  • A seat at the Ops Leadership table

The Operations Director (East) reports directly into the COO. A mirrored Operations Director (West) role owns HIVED's West London site on the same basis. This role includes leading the depot's relocation from Silvertown to Rainham.

 

Accountabilities

Accountable for end-to-end and day-to-day site performance, including:

  • All on-road activities & KPIs, including driver capacity, driver compliance, overall site performance (SLA, Delivery Success)

  • All in-depot day and night activities & KPIs, including people (labour pool, engagement, leadership succession planning), safety (auditing and near miss/incident reporting), quality (SLA, set-off/on-time dispatch), and cost (labour planning D+1/W+1/TPH)

  • Health and Safety on-site

  • Full site P&L ownership

  • Org design, headcount planning, and hiring decisions for the site's team

  • Successful delivery of the Silvertown → Rainham depot relocation: site readiness, continuity of operations through the move, and team transition

Responsibilities

  • On-the-road

    • Own DSP management and HIVED Partner Driver capacity & performance management

    • Handle driver issues, escalations & approvals

    • Own legal compliance (hours on road, breaks, safety checks) and driver incident support

    • Drive OTR KPIs: DPR, cost per route, vehicle utilisation, driver attendance, punctuality & reliability

  • Under-the-roof

    • Own labour planning for week-ahead & night

    • Own Sortation Handler hiring & performance management

    • Own inbound, processing, sortation, and dispatch performance, including set-off/on-time dispatch

    • Drive UTR KPIs: TPH and cost per parcel

  • Team

    • Lead and oversee all site operations, directly managing the site's Ops Managers and Senior Ops Managers (currently 4x, with the team growing to include more senior operations managers)

    • Hours must be flexible to manage Day and Night teams — may sometimes come in for set-off, or stay late to meet Night teams, to fully understand E2E performance and areas for improvement

    • Build a high-performing depot team — lead & inspire, develop and performance manage the team; ensure all levels receive training and are motivated; coach Managers to develop into company leaders

    • Own org design, staffing structure, and hiring for the site, including growing the Ops Manager layer into Senior Ops Manager roles; ensure absence cover arrangements are in place

    • Responsible for Health and Safety on site; work with the H&S Manager to drive continuous improvement and embed company processes

  • Overheads

    • Own full site P&L (CM2 & CM3), including budget vs. actuals; fully understand site performance and its cost drivers, contributing to central reporting as required

    • Drive continuous site improvement by proactively understanding levers, prioritising and embedding on an ongoing basis; identify CAPEX opportunities and pitch business cases

    • Own facilities, asset utilisation, and maintenance costs for the site

    • Lead the Silvertown → Rainham transition: site readiness planning, driving continuity of service and safety standards through the move, managing team communication and transition, and coordinating with central/Facilities/Property teams on the physical move

Requirements

  • 6+ years' experience leading operations teams. Direct last-mile experience is not required.

  • Proven ability to manage large frontline teams via managers, including managing managers of managers as the team grows more senior

  • Experience owning P&L

  • Experience with org design and hiring decisions, ideally including growing/restructuring a frontline management layer

  • Hands-on operator with a strong understanding of unit economics and cost drivers

  • Track record of high impact — able to ideate and implement new initiatives to drive impactful change

  • Track record of running safe, reliable, high-throughput operations

  • Experience leading a site move or major operational transition with minimal service disruption is highly valued, given the planned Silvertown → Rainham relocation

  • Comfortable working in fast-changing, high-growth environments

  • Strong people leader: clear, fair, and direct

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management skills

 

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Dynamic working environment with a diverse and driven team

  • Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans

  • Annual compensation review

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • Community volunteer days

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Dog friendly office and depots

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

🔍 Want to learn more?

  • HIVED is B Corporation certified

title: People Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

Join us as a People Data Analyst to help Qonto’s People team turn HR data into clear insights and better-informed decisions.

Reporting to Mélodie Moulin, you will work closely with your People Systems teammates, HRBPs, and partners across People and Finance. You’ll combine hands-on analysis with an understanding of HR topics to answer practical questions, improve dashboards and reporting, and help stakeholders make better use of People data.

➡️ What you’ll do

Keep People data reliable and usable. Validate data, document calculations, and contribute to mandatory reporting while following established access, confidentiality, and GDPR requirements.

  • Support HRBPs in their day-to-day decisions. Translate their questions into relevant analyses, discuss which KPIs are most useful, and help them become more autonomous through documentation and practical guidance.

  • Contribute to workforce and talent analyses. Prepare datasets, reports, and analytical inputs for topics such as headcount planning, compensation reviews, and talent reviews, in collaboration with the team.

  • Use AI to improve how you work. Apply AI to relevant analytical and reporting tasks, test practical ways to save time, and check the accuracy and reliability of outputs.

  • Relevant experience in People Analytics, HR reporting, or a data analytics role with substantial exposure to HR topics, ideally within a tech company or scale-up. A solid understanding of HR processes. Compensation reviews, talent reviews, and HRBP activities are familiar territory. You understand the questions behind a reporting request and can discuss whether a metric addresses them.

  • Hands-on analytical skills. You’re comfortable using SQL, Excel, and BI tools to combine datasets, check calculations, investigate trends, and build clear dashboards. Experience with HRIS reporting, particularly Workday, is a plus.

  • Clear communication and sound judgment. You can explain findings to non-technical stakeholders, ask useful questions, and distinguish what the data supports from what still needs investigating. Reliable delivery and collaborative working habits. You can progress independently on defined analyses, keep stakeholders informed, and flag blockers or competing priorities early.

  • Practical experience using AI. You already use AI in your work and can explain where it improves your efficiency or output quality, how you verify results, and how you protect sensitive information.

  • Professional fluency in English. French is a strong plus.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Meaningful analytical work that helps the People team understand workforce trends and make better-informed decisions.

  • Varied HR topics, from performance and attrition to compensation, workforce planning, and reporting.

  • Close collaboration within a growing team, with opportunities to deepen both your analytical skills and your understanding of People topics.

  • Room to improve how work gets done, through clearer dashboards, reusable analyses, better documentation, and practical applications of AI.

You’ll report to Mélodie Moulin, Head of People Systems at Qonto.

Mélodie has 10+ years in HR systems and people operations, including leading large-scale HR transformation programs at Doctolib and Pernod Ricard, notably a global Workday deployment across 80+ locations. She joined Qonto to build a People Systems team from the ground up, using data and AI to help HR operate at scale.

title: Performance Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role

We're hiring the first dedicated owner of Omnea's performance marketing.

You're not starting from scratch. Paid campaigns, the website and our social channels all exist (and are working to varying degrees). But nobody's job is to work out what actually produces pipeline and then make more of it. That's this role: take what's already running, find the ROI, and professionalise it into something we can be proud of.

In one week you might work out why a paid campaign is generating leads that never convert, rebuild the landing page that's losing them, build a new LinkedIn audience off the back of our closed-won data, and show the exec team what the pipeline picture looks like.

If you want to run one channel and hand-off the numbers, this might not be for you. If you want to own the loop from spend through to pipeline, and have the data to prove what worked, it is.

You'll work closely with our digital agency partners, the field marketers running events in the UK and US, and the sales team who rely on the pipeline you generate.

What you'll own

Pipeline and performance

You'll build the picture of what marketing is actually returning, and you'll be the person with the answer when someone asks whether a channel is worth the money.

  • Own the pipeline number for our digital channels: how much, from where, and at what cost

  • Build and maintain dashboards in Dreamdata using sources like HubSpot and GA4

  • Track campaigns from first touch through to closed won, and use what you find to change what we run next

  • Run a proper testing cadence. Set the test, call the result, and stop the things that aren't working

  • Report on what the numbers mean, not only what they are

Paid

You own paid. Our agency handles campaign build and optimisation, and you set the direction they work to.

  • Act as day-to-day partner to the agency: set the brief, shape audience strategy and funnel design, and decide together what to test next and how to deploy 6-figure annual ad spend.

  • Own LinkedIn as our primary paid channel: audiences, target account lists, retargeting and sequencing

  • Build audiences from our own data: closed-won patterns, target accounts, product signals - rather than off-the-shelf targeting

  • Work with content and design teammates to produce compelling content

  • Make the case for more budget when the numbers justify it

Website and conversion

  • Own conversion across the site: forms, journeys, page structure, and what happens after someone clicks an ad

  • Build and update pages using our existing component library and CMS

  • Run an ongoing testing programme on the pages that matter, and work with the in-house design team on what comes next

  • Ship landing pages for campaigns and product launches, including forms and tracking

  • Keep tracking and attribution clean, so the reporting can be trusted

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a B2B marketing role, in-house or agency. We care more about what you delivered than where you did it.

  • You're commercial. You think in pipeline and cost per opportunity, not clicks and impressions, and you can tell the difference between a campaign that's busy and one that's working.

  • You know paid mechanics properly. Audiences, match rates, attribution windows, frequency. LinkedIn Ads specifically.

  • You're comfortable with numbers. You can build a report from scratch, spot when something looks wrong, and explain a trend to someone who wasn't in the weeds with you.

  • You've built pages in a CMS. Not from scratch in code — assembling pages from components, keeping them consistent, and getting the tracking right.

  • You've worked with or inside an agency, so you know how to write a brief and how to tell good work from work that's merely on time.

Nice to have

  • Comfortable in tools like HubSpot, Dreamdata, Google Ads, Campaign Manager

  • B2B SaaS, ideally selling to finance, procurement, legal or risk

  • SEO fundamentals

  • Enough Figma to work sensibly with designers

What good looks like in six months

  • We know what every pound of adspend returns, and everyone trusts the number

  • Paid is producing pipeline we can attribute, at a cost we're happy to scale

  • Our LinkedIn audiences are built from our own data rather than off-the-shelf targeting

  • The pages that carry the most traffic have been tested and improved

  • You're the person the exec team asks when they want to know whether a channel is working

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Bei uns geht es leistungsorientiert zu, aber die Arbeit soll trotzdem Spaß machen. Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Vertriebsumfeld mit Kolleg:innen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen, Wissen teilen und gemeinsam Erfolge feiern.

Der Job ist anspruchsvoll. Du wirst mit Absagen umgehen müssen, brauchst Durchhaltevermögen und musst dich anstrengen. Dafür kannst du dir eine gut bezahlte Laufbahn aufbauen, im Vertrieb und in der Verhandlungsführung viel lernen und in weniger als zwei Jahren in eine Führungsrolle wachsen.

title: Ph.D. Position in Computer Science (Wearable Intelligence & Data Fusion)
descriptionHtml:
Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology

About the Position

The research group of Dr. Sari Sadiya at Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL), in collaboration with Constructor University (CU) and Constructor Technology (CT), invites applicants for Ph.D. student positions in Computer Science with a focus on wearable intelligence, multimodal data fusion, and edge AI.

The project investigates how wearable data streams can be transformed into structured knowledge and integrated into a knowledge-grounded digital avatar that supports bi-directional collaboration in education and research.

Ph.D. students will work in a highly interdisciplinary environment, combining AI/ML, edge computing, cognitive science, and human–computer interaction. In close collaboration with academia and industry, they will contribute to building privacy-preserving, real-time personalization frameworks while pursuing their doctoral dissertation.

About the Program

The PhD program is research-centered, emphasizing original contributions in:

  • Wearable data analytics and fusion methods
  • Biomedical data analytics
  • On-device processing and performance modeling
  • Personalization and adaptive reasoning systems
  • AI for Education

Doctoral students will also have access to specialized courses in:

  • Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Edge Computing
  • Advanced Computational Methods and Data Science
  • Cognitive Science and Human-Centered Computing

As part of the program, students will collaborate with Constructor Technology to gain first-hand industrial experience, contributing to real-world testbeds and prototypes.

Research Focus

This PhD position is part of the Wearable Intelligence Project, with two main research directions:

  • Data fusion of heterogeneous temporal streams
    • Designing algorithms to unify multimodal signals (physiological, cognitive, contextual, scheduling, and learning data).
    • Developing pipelines that produce structured insights powering the Agentic Personalization Engine (APE).
  • On-device data processing & performance modeling
    • Developing models balancing computation, energy, and data flows across wearable, edge, and cloud environments.
    • Exploring feasibility of running compact micro-LLMs directly on wearables.

The overarching goal is to create scalable, ethical, and transparent personalization systems that support education and research.

Funding

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

  • Monthly stipend of €1,650
  • Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
  • Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
  • Supplementary €603 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Constructor Knowledge Labs actively supports candidates in preparing applications for external funding — doctoral scholarships, foundations, or international mobility grants — and can provide institutional support and references

Applicant Profile

Mandatory requirements:

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Cognitive Science, or related disciplines.
  • Strong background in AI/ML, signal processing, or edge computing.
  • Hands-on experience with wearable or multimodal data (e.g., heart rate, EEG, activity, sleep, GPS).
  • Solid mathematical and computational modeling skills.
  • Proficiency in academic English writing (e.g., reports, papers, theses).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with LLMs, multimodal data fusion, or agent-based AI systems.
  • Familiarity with privacy-preserving ML, dynamic consent, and GDPR-compliant frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and collaborate across disciplines.
  • Interest in teaching, mentoring, and applied industrial research.

Application Details

  • Deadline: August 31, 2026

Required documents:

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV);
  • Academic transcripts;
  • Letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals;
  • 2 recommendation letters.

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

title: Post-doctorant·e en UnStrain : révéler les tensions de mobilité par apprentissage de représentations - CDD de 18 mois
descriptionHtml:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  1. Développer des modèles génératifs et d'apprentissage de représentations intégrant flux de mobilité, réseaux de transport, occupation des sols et données sociodémographiques dans un espace latent commun, afin d'identifier des tensions de mobilité interprétables et d'évaluer des interventions susceptibles de les réduire.

  2. Vérifier la cohérence des tensions détectées avec des indicateurs établis de déséquilibres territoriaux (précarité liée à la mobilité, déserts de transport collectif, déserts alimentaires, déséquilibre emplois-logements).

  3. Évaluer les apports de la méthode par rapport aux indicateurs fondés sur des définitions a priori (p. ex. seuils d'accessibilité ou de disponibilité de l'offre), en identifiant des configurations multifactorielles latentes dans plusieurs sources de données.

Activités

  • Acquérir, nettoyer, aligner et combiner les flux de mobilité, les réseaux de transport, les données d'occupation des sols et les données sociodémographiques.

  • Concevoir des représentations de données et des chaînes de prétraitement pour des sources de données spatiales hétérogènes.

  • Implémenter et entraîner des modèles génératifs et d'apprentissage de représentations.

  • Construire des représentations vectorielles des unités spatiales et développer des méthodes pour extraire et interpréter les tensions de mobilité latentes.

  • Analyser les relations entre la demande de mobilité, l’occupation des sols, l’offre de transport et la mobilité observée.

  • Comparer les tensions détectées à des indicateurs établis : précarité liée à la mobilité, déserts de transport collectif, déserts alimentaires et déséquilibre emplois-logements.

title: Praktikum - UI/UX Design mit Fokus Barrierefreiheit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Preventicus

Gesundheitslösungen von morgen machen wir schon heute. Bei Preventicus gestalten wir Mobile- und Webprodukte für die Herzgesundheit, genutzt von zahlreichen Krankenkassen. Unsere Nutzer:innen reichen von Gesundheitsbewussten ab 45 bis zu älteren Patient:innen, deshalb ist Barrierefreiheit für uns zentral. Als Praktikant:in arbeitest du eng mit unserer UX-Managerin, dem Product Owner und den Entwickler:innen zusammen.

ab sofort | 2-6 Monate | Jena/hybrid | Pflichtpraktikum im Rahmen des Studiums

Deine Tätigkeiten

  • Research: Du führst Interviews und Usability-Tests mit echten Nutzer:innen durch, analysierst Pain Points und leitest Anforderungen für Anpassungen und neue Feature-Ideen ab

  • Konzeption: Du erstellst User Flows und Szenarien für neue Produkt-Features

  • Design & Prototyping: Du gestaltest Wireframes, UI-Designs und klickbare Prototypen in Figma oder mit KI-Tools und dokumentierst, wie die Designs barrierefrei umgesetzt werden sollen

  • Design-System: Du hilfst mit, unsere Designvorgaben weiterzuentwickeln, mit Blick auf Barrierefreiheit von Anfang an

  • Design-QA & Barrierefreiheit: Du prüfst, ob unsere Designs in Apps und Webprodukten korrekt umgesetzt wurden, auch bei Kontrasten, Schriftgrößen, Screenreader-Tauglichkeit und Touch-Zielen

Das bringst du mit

  • Laufendes Designstudium mit Pflichtpraktikum, z. B. Interface Design, Digital Design, Mediendesign o.ä.

  • Erste UX/UI-Projekte und Erfahrung mit User Research, z. B. aus dem Studium

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma

  • Nutzerzentriertes Denken, Interesse an Gesundheitsthemen und ein Herz für Design, das niemanden ausschließt

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, denn unsere Nutzer:innen und Tests sind überwiegend deutschsprachig

Das bieten wir dir

  • Einblick in die spannende Welt der UI/UX Designentwicklung

  • Feste Mentorin und volle Integration ins Produktentwicklungsteam

  • Barrierefreies Design für Medizinprodukte live: vom Konzept bis zur fertigen App – seltenes Know-how für deinen Lebenslauf

  • Raum für eigene Ideen bis hin zu einem eigenen Projekt

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Onboarding in Jena, danach remote mit gelegentlichen Teamtagen vor Ort

  • Praktikum mit der Möglichkeit auf Abschlussarbeit oder Werkstudententätigkeit

  • ab sofort, für mindestens 2 Monate

Ein hochmotiviertes, international erfahrenes Team, dem unsere gemeinsame Vision am Herzen liegt, freut sich auf Dich!

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gern ein, zwei Projekte, die du gestaltet hast.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht – ein paar Sätze, warum dich das Thema reizt, reichen.

Bitte nenn auch deinen Wunschzeitraum und die geforderte Praktikumsdauer laut Studienordnung.

title: Principal AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

Key Responsibilities

•    Technical strategy and architecture. Define the AI/ML architecture and technical roadmap across the portfolio. Identify shared capabilities, establish clear interfaces, and guide build-versus-buy decisions while respecting product-specific requirements.

•    Predictive ML and optimization. Lead advances in prediction, targeting, ranking, bidding, pacing, and personalization. Guide feature development, training, calibration, and serving, addressing sparse signals, delayed outcomes, and changing data distributions.

•    Agentic frameworks and agents. Design reusable orchestration, tool integration, retrieval, state and memory, and multi-agent coordination. Build workflows for campaign planning, insights, recommendations, and execution, with explicit permissions, human approval where needed, and recoverable failure handling.

•    Portfolio integration. Partner with Predict, Agentic Frameworks, Email DSP/SSP, and agentic teams to connect models, data, and services through well-defined APIs and shared evaluation practices. Turn successful patterns into reusable components and practical migration paths.

•    Production engineering. Own critical designs and implementations across data pipelines, training, deployment, and inference. Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices for reproducibility, versioning, automated testing, observability, and safe rollouts and rollbacks.

•    Evaluation and business impact. Define offline benchmarks and online experiments tied to advertiser outcomes. Evaluate prediction quality, calibration, agent task completion, tool accuracy, latency, and cost; use A/B testing and incrementality methods where appropriate.

•    Reliability and responsible AI. Set standards for service performance, drift detection, data quality, and incident response. Build privacy-aware data access, auditability, and protection against prompt injection, data leakage, and unintended agent actions.

•    Technical leadership. Partner with engineering, data science, product, and business leaders to turn ambiguous needs into deliverable plans. Lead design and code reviews, mentor senior engineers, and resolve technical decisions across teams.

Required Qualifications

•    12+ years of relevant software engineering and applied ML experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including substantial ownership of production ML systems and technical leadership across multiple teams.

•    Deep expertise in predictive ML for ranking, recommendation, classification, or optimization, with strong foundations in statistics, experimentation, model evaluation, and the full model lifecycle.

•    Hands-on experience delivering LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and operational monitoring.

•    Proven ability to architect distributed, high-throughput, low-latency systems and make sound trade-offs across model quality, infrastructure cost, and operational complexity.

•    Strong Python skills and proficiency in Java, Go, or a comparable backend language; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, SQL, and large-scale data or streaming systems such as Spark and Kafka.

•    Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, containerization, CI/CD, model serving, and production observability; familiarity with relational, NoSQL, caching, and retrieval systems.

•    Ability to influence without direct authority, communicate architectural decisions clearly, mentor experienced engineers, and translate business objectives into measurable technical outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

•    AdTech experience across DSPs, SSPs, real-time bidding, audience modeling, identity, attribution, or measurement; relevant experience in recommendation systems or marketplaces is also valued.

•    Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, contextual bandits, constrained optimization, or online learning in production.

•    Experience with privacy-aware identity and audience systems, email advertising, or integrating ML capabilities across multiple products.

•    Experience optimizing model and LLM inference, selecting and adapting models, or building reusable ML and agent platforms adopted by multiple teams.

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. title: Principal Consultant - Financial Services (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich.  The work is hard. The bar is high. Partner in 3-4 years possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform. 

Stop reading if any of these describe you: 

  • Specialisation. You are a generalist with shallow expertise and a thin network → AI will eat your lunch. We bet on depth. 
  • Ownership. You would rather oversee than own → We fall in love with problems. Own them. Solve them. Ship solutions. 
  • Speed. Slow is your default → Speed compounds. Be smart and brave enough to select 80/20 in the right way. 
  • Mindset. "Not possible" is part of your vocabulary → We hire people who always find a way. 

Still there? Then ALAIKA might be for you. 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply. 

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else. 
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. 
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that. 

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck. 

Join the movement — apply now. 

 The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber, with deep financial services-domain expertise as your anchor. In the room with decision-makers as the expert your clients trust on the questions that matter most. 
  • Own. Take full ownership of significant accounts and the relationships and revenue inside them. The work, the team, the clients, the numbers. You do not own pieces; you own outcomes. 
  • Lead. Run project teams and large key initiatives. Set the standard for consultants, senior consultants, and managers — challenge them, develop them, raise their game. Multiply the output of everyone around you — not just your own. 
  • Sell. Open new doors inside existing accounts. Originate new mandates. At ALAIKA, business development is not a partner privilege — it is an expectation. 
  • Connect. Walk in with deep networks. Extend them. Lead C-level discussions in your area of responsibility. Be recognized as a market leader in your domain. Build trust deep enough that clients call you first. 
  • Grow. Sharpen the rare profile the market is short on — strategic thinker, financial services expert, entrepreneurial dealmaker. Partner-track within reach. 
  • Build. We are scaling, with real building left to do — IP, processes, go-to-market, strategy. You are a strategic partner in shaping what ALAIKA becomes. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 

When you are a fit 

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management". 

Your goal is to make it to the top: at ALAIKA itself, at a leading investment or financial services firm, or in a company you build yourself — ALAIKA can help with that too. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. Self-confident achiever. Act first, apologise later — speed is everything. You move. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Outstanding degree in an analytical field from a top-tier university, or a track record that speaks for itself. 
  • Experience. Minimum 5 years in a high-pressure, results-driven environment — top strategy consultancy, fast-growing tech, or demanding corporate financial services role. An established senior network across financial services is expected at this level. 
  • Industry Focus. You have worked inside or deeply alongside financial services institutions. Sub-sector expertise in insurance preferred, but we would consider experience in banking, asset management, or payments as well.    
  • Leadership. You have led teams that delivered. We hire managers who build businesses, not just project plans. 
  • Analytical edge. Data-driven by default. Leverage data to drive decisions, not just decorate slides. 
  • Languages. Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus. 

Why join ALAIKA 

  • Partner track from day one. Three years from principal to partner possible. 
  • Compensation. Above market with very entrepreneurial-driven bonus structures.  

“My biggest economic misunderstanding was that people got rich from high salary, but almost no one on Forbes got there through salary but only with equity.”  

— Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI  

  • Stellar Network. Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders + investors building tomorrow’s. 
  • Offices. Munich and Barcelona. More coming. 

Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more. 

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services. 

Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. Let’s see if you are the one. 

Equal Opportunities for all (f/m/d)

ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space

title: Principal Hardware Engineer I
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are looking to add a Principal Hardware Engineer I to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. At the Principal level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and hardware systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Principal level also includes technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for critical designs and teams of engineers developing new products and systems. At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Own end-to-end design of complex electronics modules and systems, from concept and architecture through schematic, layout, test, and production. Products may include high-speed digital, power electronics, and/or RF.
  • Lead teams of hardware engineers to develop new products with multiple electronics modules.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in support of hardware development across the company.
  • Develop hardware architecture and write hardware requirements for systems of high complexity.
  • Perform detailed and complete schematic design for complex boards, ranging from key components to supporting passives.
  • Perform detailed PCB layout in Altium Designer for complex boards, often working with a PCB Drafter.
  • Complete analysis such as worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity analysis, and power integrity analysis. Guide analysis methodology.
  • Develop bring-up plans and design verification plans for new hardware and complex systems.
  • Perform bring-up and key verification testing of modules and complex integrated systems, often working with a team to complete validation.
  • Release modules and assemblies to production, working with the Manufacturing and Test Engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior and senior engineers to build technical understanding and professional development.
  • Use strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, to streamline development of complex hardware systems.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 9 years of industry or university research experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.
  • Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics and small systems for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints.
  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics and small hardware systems, including architecture design, trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
  • Multiple experiences delivering hardware products through production and deployment.
  • Expertise in PCB layout and manufacturing, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design, IPC standards, and industry best practices.
  • Expertise derisking designs with board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
  • Strong understanding of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that contributes to judicious design of hardware system architectures.
  • Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware, based on in-depth understanding of specialized lab equipment.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Experience leading teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, and interconnects.
  • Design for space radiation environments.

title: Principal Product & Brand Designer (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Build something that truly matters

At Cortea, we envision a world where every audit is proactively managed by humans and AI agents collaboratively. Where auditing professionals have superhuman capabilities at their fingertips to strengthen the trust in the world's most critical systems.

We're not just improving auditing workflows, we're redefining how audits are done from the ground up. With a rapidly growing, global customer base and backing from world-class investors, the market is ready. What we ship next decides how big this gets.

This is your chance to join a team of sharp, ambitious and kind builders extremely early. Shape the company at its pivotal moment and build something that truly matters.

About the role

At Cortea, design earns trust, and we sell to an industry that exists to produce it. Auditors are paid to be skeptical, and people judge quality by what they can see: the product, the website, the deck a partner opens in a boardroom, the newsletter someone reads with their first coffee. All of it is Cortea.

This is a role for someone with great taste in designing software and AI systems. You'll find novel patterns for problems that haven't existed in software before, and you'll own how Cortea looks and feels to the outside world.

Roughly 70% product, 30% brand. The product work is deep, expert-facing and systems-heavy. As we are doubling down on design, you'll be working on taking the core flows to the next level. The brand work is yours to own outright: website, marketing and sales visuals, newsletter, event and content assets. It'll be on screen in a Big4 boardroom, in every customer's inbox, and on the wall at the events we host. A lot of surface for one designer, and all of it yours.

We're not looking for someone to ask whether the logo goes left or right. We're looking for someone with opinions.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with our founders, engineers, and customers to turn audit flows into intuitive, delightful interfaces

  • Work with Jonas on product design and design strategy overall

  • Own our brand designs and visuals

  • Evolve our visual identity and design system

  • Take increasing ownership of brand direction. Website, marketing and sales material, content and event assets

  • Help shape the product vision, roadmap, and user experience standards

  • Run usability tests, build user feedback loops, and bring a systems mindset to design decisions

You'll be great at this if you

  • Have product design experience in B2B / SaaS, ideally in fast-moving startups.

  • Think in experiences, not screens. With taste you can defend. Product and brand are one surface; you can explain why details work, and you call out when they don’t.

  • Want to create a unique brand, which auditors love. Identify, marketing, web should be a draw, not a tax. Taste and passion matter more than volume.

  • Can hold complexity without losing clarity. You turn configuration-heavy, expert workflows into clear systems.

  • Use AI without sacrificing quality. You've worked out which parts of the job benefit from automation and which need your judgment.

  • Work well in ambiguity. You take rough direction and deliver great work without handholding.

  • Have low ego. Best idea wins. You give and take feedback without making it about you.

Titles are fuzzy. If you're operating at principal level, or you're currently freelancing and curious rather than actively looking, talk to us anyway.

What you will get

  • Full brand ownership, shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry from Berlin, with AI at the core

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro on what we do with Liza

  • Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Jonas

  • Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Co-Founder Valentin

  • On-site Day — Meet our full team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.

As a senior individual contributor, you'll have significant ownership over your product area, from identifying the right problems to solve through delivering solutions and measuring their impact. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, and business stakeholders to make thoughtful tradeoffs, build alignment, and deliver outcomes that matter to both our customers and JOOR.

We're looking for a thoughtful, commercially minded product leader who combines strong product instincts with a collaborative approach and a passion for solving meaningful customer problems.

  • Shape product strategy. Identify opportunities to improve how brands and retailers conduct wholesale business, and translate those opportunities into a clear product direction and roadmap.

  • Champion customer understanding. Work directly with customers and cross-functional teams to uncover unmet needs, understand complex workflows, and identify opportunities to deliver greater value.

  • Turn insights into action. Combine quantitative and qualitative research to challenge assumptions, develop hypotheses, evaluate solutions, and make informed product decisions.

  • Drive measurable impact. Define success through customer and business outcomes, using data and insights to inform decisions and continuously improve the product experience.

  • Partner across disciplines. Collaborate closely with Engineering and Design to develop intuitive, scalable solutions, navigate technical tradeoffs, and balance new product development with platform reliability and modernization.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, ideally with complex B2B SaaS, commerce, retail technology, or marketplace platforms.

  • Proven track record of independently leading product initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

  • Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify high-value opportunities, challenge assumptions, and make informed tradeoffs across competing priorities.

  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Design to develop and deliver thoughtful, scalable product solutions.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership, build alignment, and make decisions in complex environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate product vision, strategy, recommendations, and results clearly and persuasively.
