Whilst most work takes place during standard business hours, flexibility will be required to support colleagues, clients, and projects across different time zones.

Why JOOR

At JOOR, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex, meaningful challenges with real-world impact, helping evolve an established platform while exploring new possibilities in commerce, data, and AI.

You'll join a collaborative, globally distributed team with substantial ownership over your product area, the opportunity to influence strategic decisions, and the autonomy to turn ideas into meaningful customer and business impact.

title: Product Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're expanding access to affordable credit by launching credit products that make a real difference to customers. We move quickly, often with leading fintech, consumer and e-commerce companies, so that we can offer affordable credit at the right point in the customer journey. We work in a highly regulated environment, so our products have to work end to end from day one: technically, operationally and commercially.

 

As a Product Associate, you'll work across product, data and commercials. You'll dig into how our products perform, from funnel conversion to loan-level unit economics, and turn what you find into ideas for how we scale, improve margins and grow. You'll work hands-on with data and code, alongside Product Managers, Engineering, Credit and Operations. You'll help decide where the product goes next, as well as how we ship it.

 

This role is for top-tier STEM or Economics graduates who think like analysts, build like engineers and care about the P&L like owners, and who want to progress to Product Manager at a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech.

 

What you'll be doing

 

Product analytics & insight

  • Own analysis of product performance across the full funnel: traffic, applications, approvals, conversion, originations, repayment and credit outcomes

  • Build and maintain the dashboards, metrics and data models that Product, Credit and Operations rely on

  • Form sharp hypotheses, design experiments (journey changes, pricing, A/B tests) and measure the impact rigorously

  • Get to the root cause of anomalies quickly, whether the cause is in the data, the code or the customer journey

Unit economics & commercial thinking

  • Model the economics of each product: acquisition cost, approval and take-up rates, pricing, funding cost, expected loss, servicing cost and lifetime value

  • Put numbers on the trade-offs behind product decisions, such as wider approval versus higher losses, or partner revenue share versus volume

  • Track contribution margin and cohort profitability by product, channel and partner, and show where we make or lose money

Growth & product strategy

  • Come up with ideas for scaling and growing from where we are today (new segments, channels, products and pricing) and estimate what each one is worth

  • Look across our products and partnerships for places where they reinforce each other: cross-sell, top-ups, repeat lending, shared customers and shared data

  • Help evaluate new partner opportunities and build the business case, covering volume, economics, integration effort and risk

  • Turn the strongest ideas into clear proposals and see them through to launch

Building & shipping

  • Use AI coding tools to build and ship product end to end, across both front-end and back-end, from quick prototypes to features that go live

  • Build internal tools, automations and data workflows that remove manual work and help the team move faster

  • Be proficient with our analytics stack: build dashboards in AWS QuickSight and track funnels, events and experiments in PostHog

  • Use SQL and Python every day to pull, model and analyse data

  • Learn how our APIs, decisioning flows and data pipelines work, and work directly with engineers on specs, testing and release validation

  • Support Product Managers with discovery, delivery and partner onboarding

Launch readiness & operations

  • Define success criteria for each launch and the metrics that show whether it's working

  • Design test scenarios, including edge cases and failure modes, and test the end-to-end customer journey before release

  • Work closely with QA to make sure production releases are stable

  • Monitor production performance after release, and pick up and triage related bugs with engineering

  • Make sure new products and journeys work at launch for customer support, collections and complaints teams

  • Use operational data to spot recurring issues, fix them at the source and make sure they're closed out, not just discussed

Who you are

  • A top-tier STEM or Economics graduate (computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, economics or similar)

  • 0–2 years of experience, including internships, placements or early-career roles with real responsibility

  • Strongly analytical and confident with SQL and Python, able to go from raw data to a clear recommendation

  • Able to build with AI. You use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to ship working front-end and back-end code, and you've built things, whether side projects, hackathons, internal tools or production apps

  • Hands-on with analytics tools such as AWS QuickSight, PostHog or similar BI and product analytics platforms

  • Commercially minded. You naturally ask how something makes money, and you enjoy modelling unit economics, pricing and P&L

  • Strong product sense. You have opinions on the products you use, why they work and how they could grow

  • A structured problem-solver who can break down messy, real-world problems

  • A clear communicator who can walk an engineer through a model and make a recommendation to leadership

Nice to have: an interest in consumer credit, lending, payments or fintech; experience with experimentation and statistics.

How you work (and what we value)

  • You think like an owner, of both the customer outcome and the commercial outcome

  • You'd rather build a quick prototype or run the numbers than debate in the abstract

  • You follow through until problems are actually solved

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't wait for perfect instructions

  • You speak up when something doesn't make sense, and you help fix it

  • You put in extra effort at key moments, such as launches and live incidents, knowing that's where the real learning happens

Progression & growth

This role is a stepping stone to Product Management, with a clear progression path. As a Product Associate, you'll be expected to:

  • Build deep knowledge of our products, data and commercials

  • Consistently own problems end to end and deliver measurable business and customer impact

  • Show strong judgement, data-driven thinking and stakeholder management

High performers will progress to Junior Product Manager as they begin to:

  • Own a product area or metric independently, including its commercial performance

  • Lead defined workstreams within launches or partner integrations

  • Originate growth ideas that make it onto the roadmap and deliver results

Progression is based on impact and ownership, not time served.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company: equity

  • Hybrid working, with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days' holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month's paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together: set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: Product Certification Engineer, Fuel Cell Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Adclear

At Adclear, we’re building the trust layer for how the world’s most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We’re turning the function that has always said “no” into infrastructure that says “yes, and here’s how.”

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we’re only at the beginning. The product you’ll help build is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we’ve already earned the trust of leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, NatWest, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise £2.6m in funding, and we’re now scaling fast. We’re building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role

This is a full-stack product engineering role for someone who has shipped real features and wants to take on more ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers and the founders on product slices from spec to production. Over time you’ll own them end-to-end. Here’s the kind of work you’ll contribute to:

  • A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. It was built with Monzo as the design partner and is public on the Chrome Web Store.

  • A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, and the action runs.

  • The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules.

  • Integrations that reach into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com, and Frame.io for video.

  • A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue.

Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day and tell us quickly when something’s wrong. That tight feedback loop is one of the best things about the job, and it’s a fast way to grow.

What you’ll do

  • Ship product features from spec to production. Most of the work is across the full stack, and integration work where needed. You’ll start with guidance and take on bigger slices as you grow.

  • Build the surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, and the moments where model output meets human judgement.

  • Work on features where AI is in the critical path. The model is genuinely part of the product, not bolted on.

  • Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first few weeks. We deploy continuously, so you’ll feel the pace immediately.

  • Bring your perspective to what we build and how we build it. We want to hear when something doesn’t make sense.

  • Learn from senior engineers through code review, pairing and design discussions, and help raise the bar yourself.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven delivery. Building production web applications, with features you’ve shipped that real users depend on.

  • Growing ownership. You can take a well-scoped feature and run with it. You know when to ask for input and when to unblock yourself. You want to grow towards owning larger, more ambiguous pieces of work.

  • Product sense. You care about the user experience, notice when something feels off, and aren’t afraid to say so. You’re learning to balance polish against shipping at pace.

  • Collaboration. You communicate clearly with engineers, designers and founders, ask good questions when something is underspecified, and are receptive to feedback.

  • AI literacy. You use modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents) day to day. You treat them as collaborators, check their output critically, and are curious about where they help and where they get in the way.

Technical skills

  • Solid TypeScript and React, with working experience on the backend.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in, building products where AI is in the critical path.

  • Familiarity with modern web tooling, including Node and Postgres.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Hono or Drizzle.

  • Exposure to regulated industries such as fintech, healthtech or legaltech.

The Stack

React, TypeScript and Tailwind on the frontend. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle and Postgres on the data layer.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary

  • Meaningful equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware budget

  • Monthly gym contribution

  • Professional development budget

descriptionHtml:
Product Manager - (Contact center as a service)

Localisation : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Niveau : confirmé
Équipe : Product Management – Customer Care Value Stream
Contrat : CDI
Rattachement : Head of Product

À noter : Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’intelligence énergétique qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée au quotidien.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que tu feras

Tu es responsable des résultats de ton produit et tu donnes aux équipes design et ingénierie une vision claire des priorités et du périmètre.

  • Travailler avec l’équipe qui construit notre solution de centre de contact et le Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE), au service d’ENGIE France

  • Définir la stratégie produit et la roadmap Customer Care pour les clients de Kaluza en France, en équilibrant réutilisation du Global Core et besoins de localisation

  • Construire notre suite d’outils pour le centre de contact, dont le CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) et le Case Management, pour des conversations efficaces et à forte valeur

  • Utiliser les dernières technologies d’IA pour automatiser et personnaliser l’expérience client, et porter les outils de productivité des agents

  • Être l’interlocuteur produit senior de nos clients (comme ENGIE) : animer des ateliers et traduire leurs besoins en capacités scalables

  • Piloter les équipes transverses (ingénierie, design, data, commercial) pour une livraison efficace, en levant les blocages et les dépendances

  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés du centre de contact (AHT, FCR, CSAT, NPS) pour obtenir des gains mesurables sur le coût du service

Ce que tu apportes

Idéalement, tu as :

  • Une solide expérience de leadership produit en SaaS entreprise, au sein d’organisations produit agiles

  • Une connaissance approfondie des opérations de centre de contact et des workflows des agents, et de l’enthousiasme pour l’automatisation par l’IA (voicebots, agent assist)

  • Une expérience avec des clients entreprise français et une bonne compréhension des enjeux de localisation (langue, réglementation)

  • De l’aisance avec les parties prenantes au niveau exécutif et la capacité d’arbitrer entre rapidité et valeur à long terme

  • Une approche orientée data : tu t’appuies sur les métriques opérationnelles pour évaluer la performance produit et progresser en continu

  • Un parcours dans la vente d’énergie ou les utilities (un vrai plus !)

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : Une fierté collective à décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Aller à l’essentiel dans la complexité pour viser des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer le résultat : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

  • Finance & assurances : Prime discrétionnaire, mutuelle santé Alan, prévoyance décès/invalidité x3 via Alan, et cotisations de Sécurité sociale standard (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

  • Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport, indemnité télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

title: Product manager - Firm management
descriptionHtml:
The role is 2-3 days a week hybrid at the office near which you’re based in London, Bath or Edinburgh.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand. If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a Product manager to own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our firm management problem space. You’ll take responsibility for how firms onboard with Seccl, manage their businesses and deal with performing compliance checks on end investors.

You’ll work as part of a cross-functional team, collaborating and partnering closely with engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, and our risk and compliance team to drive meaningful outcomes for our clients and their end users.

Working alongside the product leadership, you’ll define the long-term vision for your product, establish metrics, and use that to frame progress. Your role involves deeply understanding market dynamics, identifying pain points and opportunities, and translating these insights into demonstrable customer value.

With your Senior engineering manager, you’ll lead your squad through discovery, shaping, development, and delivery. Balancing strategic thinking with execution to shape the future of our platform. You’ll work closely with our customer and operation teams to gather insights and requirements, validate solutions, and problem solve while using quantitative and qualitative data to make evidence-based decisions.

You’ll work at the heart of your squad, prioritising and maintaining a consistent view across your team of what you should be building and why. You’ll balance competing priorities and technical initiatives against your own strategic view, aligning the resultant roadmap with risk and compliance to ensure a balance of product improvement, innovation and regulatory integrity.

What you’ll own...

You’ll be responsible for building with your squad, developing a broader strategic direction and coordinating with Product leadership in a domain that’s centred around how Seccl’s customers set-up and operate. You’ll parse information in your domain and develop that into a roadmap with associated discovery and shaping.

These are some of the main problem spaces that you’ll be working on:

  • Firm onboarding, set-up and branding: Ensuring that firms can start making the most of Seccl’s products. That starts early in the launch process and carries through to how companies with billions of pounds under management can run their businesses on our platform effectively.

  • KYC, AML and sanction screening: Working closely with our Risk team and customers to deliver products and workflows that keep all parties compliant and assured. As a regulated entity and organisation that cares about the longevity of our business, this is foundational.

  • Operational Products: Solving problems for ops users as they manage how end investors interact with our processes. Ensuring that Seccl can continue to scale smoothly.

  • Technical touch points: Improving how Seccl’s webhooks communicate events and how our technical documentation facilitates integration and feature adoption.

  • Lead discovery, shaping and delivery with your squad engineering manager, aligning teams on what to build and why

This role’s for you if...

  • You’ve worked in a Product role and understand how to turn problems into useful products in a B2B2C space

  • You’re a builder who cares about what existing and future customers actually need

  • You’re curious and empathetic, and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand problems and test solutions

  • You can balance competing priorities, make pragmatic trade-offs and explain your reasoning clearly

  • You partner effectively with engineering, operations, customers and risk or compliance stakeholders

  • You’re comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of a scaling business

  • You have experience in fintech, particularly in an early-stage or scaling business, and with regulated products.

  • Desired: You have a passion and track record in improving end user experience while maintaining flawless fraud-management regulatory compliance

Who you are...

  • A builder: The thing that you want to do is build what our customers, both existing and future, want to use. All the things that you do and how you approach the day-to-day are orientated around this.

  • Curious and empathetic: The best way to build things that people want to use is to understand the nature of the problems that afflict them. You’re someone who is both fascinated by those problems and can gather the data that defines and clarifies them.

  • Has experience in fintech and regulated environments: Ideally, you’ve worked in a company that will give you a head-start in understanding how to exceed at Seccl. That means a fintech, most likely at an early or scale stage – or you were part of the company at those stages. Bonus points for having worked on a product that’s regulated.

  • Able to handle scaling: Seccl is growing quickly and that means there’s a lot of context to understand and a growing world of possibilities to explore. That means engaging in trade-offs, pragmatically choosing between committing your team to work that holds an equally compelling argument. You’re able to articulate what assumptions you’re making and guide people through your reasoning.

  • Product or product-adjacent: You’ve worked in Product, or in a role that’s adjacent. Understanding the expectations of the role and the patterns that drive success will be key in getting you up-to-speed quickly.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You want a fixed brief: this domain is evolving, and you’ll be expected to question and shape its boundaries

  • You prefer delivery without discovery: understanding the problem and validating solutions are central to this role

  • You want to avoid regulatory complexity: compliance and customer outcomes need to work together

  • You prefer priorities to be decided for you: you’ll need to make and communicate trade-offs

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

💰 An annual salary between £65 000 and £80 000 reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days each year

🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

📖 Annual learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • Talent screen – 30 min with the Talent partner to explore your experience and fit to the role

  • First round – 45 min skill based interview with the Group product manager

  • Case study round – 60 min presentation with a Senior engineering manager and Group product manager

  • Bar raiser – 45 min with two Seccl culture champions focused on cultural alignment

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

title: Product Owner Data (Technico-Fonctionnel) H/F
descriptionHtml:
Lieu : Nantes sud (44)

Salaire : 50 K€ annuel brut

Rythme : 1 journée de télétravail par semaine

Nous recherchons pour notre client, un Product Owner Data Technico-Fonctionnel (H/F) dans le cadre d'une création de poste en CDI.

VOS MISSIONS :

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction des Systèmes d’Information, vous intégrez une DSI à taille humaine pour piloter la vision, la roadmap et la gouvernance Data de notre client.

Vos missions sont les suivantes :

Pilotage stratégique et orientation de la roadmap data

  • Piloter la trajectoire produit : Concevoir, ajuster et prioriser la feuille de route des différents actifs et de la plateforme data en fonction de la valeur métier apportée.
  • Gérer le cycle de vie de la plateforme : Animer et séquencer les différents chantiers d'évolution et de structuration de l'écosystème data, incluant son volet gouvernance.
  • Cadrer les besoins métiers : Écouter, qualifier et hiérarchiser les demandes émanant des différentes entités de l'entreprise (réseau, animation, marketing, finance et support).

Centralisation des données et unification des référentiels

  • Orchestrer le DataHub relationnel : Garantir la fiabilité du golden record (conseillers et clients), piloter l'identifiant pivot et centraliser la gestion des flux de leads entrants.
  • Alimenter l'écosystème CRM 360° : Centraliser l'historique des interactions et veiller au respect des niveaux de confidentialité pour les équipes du siège.
  • formaliser les contrats de données : Négocier et rédiger les data contracts avec les équipes en charge des applications et les éditeurs tiers.

Déploiement d'une gouvernance des données robuste

  • Instaurer le catalogue de données : Mettre en œuvre et administrer le référentiel documenté, clarifier les définitions métier et identifier les data owners.
  • Assurer la qualité des données : Définir et surveiller des indicateurs de contrôle stricts (fraîcheur, taux de complétude, déduplication).
  • Veiller à la conformité réglementaire : Travailler main dans la main avec le DPO pour appliquer le RGPD (politiques de rétention, automatisation des purges, tenue du registre).

Conception et mise en valeur des produits data

  • Industrialiser les flux : Concevoir les pipelines de données et superviser l'alimentation continue du datalake.
  • Moderniser la BI : Rationaliser et repenser les outils de reporting existants pour concevoir des tableaux de bord pertinents destinés au siège et au réseau.
  • Piloter la performance : Valider et certifier les indicateurs clés de pilotage, y compris ceux mesurant l'avancement de la trajectoire DSI.
  • Soutenir l'innovation IA : Préparer et structurer les jeux de données nécessaires aux cas d'usage portés par l'équipe IA Factory.

Pilotage du delivery et animation agile

  • Spécifier les besoins : Rédiger les user stories orientées data, formaliser les spécifications techniques de flux et définir les critères de recette.
  • Animer les rituels de livraison : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les data engineers et les intégrateurs, rythmer les cérémonies agiles et valider les mises en production.
  • Favoriser l'appropriation : Assurer la montée en compétences des utilisateurs finaux et encourager l'autonomie à travers des usages en self-service.

ENVIRONNEMENT TECHNIQUE :

Data & Gouvernance : Mise en place d’une plateforme Data moderne, gouvernance, qualité et observabilité des données.

Compétences techniques : SQL | Data : Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Metabase, DataHub.

Connaissance du RGPD et de son application aux données personnelles.

VOUS :

De formation supérieure au minimum Bac+5 types ingénieur ou commerce, vous justifiez d’au moins 6 années d’expérience dont 3 ans en tant de Product Owner ou Chef de Projet Data.

Au cours de votre parcours, vous avez déjà contribué activement au déploiement d'une plateforme data moderne ainsi qu'à la mise en place d'une démarche de gouvernance globale (incluant le catalogue, le datahub, la qualité et l'observabilité). Sur le plan technique, vous maîtrisez parfaitement le SQL et comprenez les technologies modernes de la data telles qu'Airflow, dbt, les entrepôts analytiques (Snowflake, ClickHouse), les outils de BI (Metabase) et de catalogage (DataHub).

Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse et soucieuse de la qualité des livrables, sans jamais perdre de vue l'usage final pour les utilisateurs. Vous faites preuve d'une excellente capacité d'analyse pour traduire des besoins métiers parfois flous en indicateurs clairs, précis et partagés. Doté(e) d'un sens de la pédagogie, vous savez évangéliser et diffuser la culture de la donnée auprès des équipes. Enfin, votre diplomatie vous permet d'aligner facilement plusieurs directions autour d'une vision et d'une définition communes.

PROCESS :

Après un premier échange en visio avec un membre de notre équipe, vous rencontrerez :

  • Le Responsable des Systèmes d’information en visio
  • Puis un entretien final sur site avec la direction

Une décision rapide est prise à l’issue des entretiens.

title: Produktmanager:in Freeflow – IoT-Hardware und Software (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind Smart City System, ein innovatives KMU, das sich auf nachhaltige Mobilitätslösungen spezialisiert hat. Wir machen Parkflächen schrankenlos. Kameras erfassen das Kennzeichen bei der Ein- und Ausfahrt, bezahlt wird digital, kontrolliert wird über unsere Software. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2017 ist unser Team auf 43 engagierte Mitarbeiter:innen gewachsen. Gemeinsam haben wir bereits über 94.500 Parkflächen in der DACH-Region sowie in Italien und Polen erfolgreich digitalisiert.

Was uns auszeichnet? Wir bieten eine ganzheitliche IT-Infrastruktur - von individuell entwickelter Hardware bis hin zu leistungsstarker Software.

Unsere Vision: Parken neu denken und eine nachhaltige Mobilität Wirklichkeit werden lassen.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest das Freeflow-Portfolio: die ANPR-Kamera, die Info-Displays Focus und Signature, die LED-Anzeigen und Leitsysteme, den Parkautomaten und unsere zentrale Kundensoftware ParkAgent.

  • Du baust die Roadmap und priorisierst nach Kundennutzen, Umsatz und Aufwand. Dabei bringst du die langen Zyklen der Hardware mit den kurzen Release-Zyklen der Software zusammen.

  • Du holst dir regelmäßig vom Vertrieb ab, wo Deals am Produkt scheitern und was Kunden nach dem Start vermissen, und machst daraus Entscheidungen für die Roadmap.

  • Du gehst zu Kunden, auf Parkflächen und unterstützt bei Supportfällen. Beim Flächenbesitzer mit zehn Dauerparkern genauso wie am Flughafen mit unterschiedlichen Kontingenten.

  • Du schreibst Anforderungen, mit denen unsere Hardware-, Firmware- und Softwareentwicklung arbeiten kann, und wägst mit ihr Funktion, Kosten und Zeit gegeneinander ab.

  • Du steuerst den Lebenszyklus der Geräte: neue Generationen, Komponentenwechsel, Firmware-Updates im Feld und Abkündigungen.

  • Du verantwortest die Integrationen mit Handyparken-Apps wie EasyPark und Parkster, mit Automatenanbietern, Enforcement und Halternachverfolgung und entscheidest, welche Partner wir als Nächstes anbinden.

  • Du erarbeitest mit dem Go-to-Market Lead Preise und Pakete, unterstützt den Vertrieb bei Ausschreibungen und bereitest Produkteinführungen mit Marketing und Customer Success vor.

Du berichtest an unseren Go-to-Market Lead Freeflow, der den Bereich mit Vertrieb, Projekt- und Produktmanagement führt. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr dafür, dass unser Produkt bestmöglich zu Flächenbesitzern und Parkraumbewirtschaftern passt. Bei der Umsetzung arbeitest du eng mit unserem Head of TechDev und der Entwicklung zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, davon einen guten Teil mit vernetzter Hardware im Feld plus Software. Wenn du bisher nur Apps oder reine SaaS-Produkte verantwortet hast, passt diese Stelle nicht.

  • Ein technisches Studium, etwa Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder einen vergleichbaren Werdegang.

  • Genug Software-Verständnis, um mit Entwickler:innen über APIs, Datenmodelle und Architektur zu diskutieren und Aufwände realistisch einzuschätzen.

  • Erfahrung damit, was Hardware anders macht: Stücklisten, Lieferzeiten, Komponentenabkündigungen und ein Gerät an einem Standort, das man nicht einfach neu ausrollt.

  • Die Bereitschaft, Prioritäten zu setzen und sie gegenüber Vertrieb, Kunden und Geschäftsführung zu vertreten, auch wenn nicht alle zufrieden sind.

  • Ideal ist Erfahrung mit Kennzeichenerfassung (ANPR/LPR), Videoanalyse oder Parktechnologie. Fehlt dir das, der Rest passt aber, bewirb dich trotzdem. Das Fachwissen bekommst du bei uns.

Benefits

  • Wir sind zwar kein Start-up mehr, sondern können uns stolz als KMU bezeichnen, den ursprünglichen Spirit haben wir aber längst nicht verloren. Du machst bei uns den Unterschied und hast die Möglichkeit dich in deiner Kreativität voll zu entfalten und deine Eigeninitiative aufleben zu lassen.

  • Eine hybride Arbeitswelt mit mobilem Arbeiten und zugleich kreativem Austausch im Office. Du entscheidest was zu dir am besten passt. Zudem kannst du dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel einteilen.

  • Ob Halloween Party, Stadt Rallye oder Schafe hüten, bei unseren zahlreichen Teamevents ist für jeden etwas dabei. Ohne unser Team funktioniert nichts.

  • Mit unseren Corporate-Benefits hast du die Möglichkeit bei vielen Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Branchen Rabatte zu erhalten.

  • Um dich im Alter zu unterstützen bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

  • Ob Windows oder Mac, du entscheidest mit welchem Equipment du ausgestattet werden möchtest.

  • Mit Probonio hast du die Wahl: das Deutschlandticket oder ein monatliches Budget von 50 Euro, das du flexibel einsetzt, sei es für Gutscheine oder für den Urban Sports Club.

  • Du liebst Hunde? Wir auch! Deshalb kannst du deinen 4-Beiner gerne mit ins Office nehmen.

  • It's Time for Yoga! Einmal pro Woche kannst du bei unserer Office-Yoga-Session abschalten, durchatmen und neue Energie tanken - direkt im Büro und gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • Produkte, die du anfassen kannst: Kameras, Displays und Automaten aus eigener Entwicklung und über 3.000 Geräte im Feld, deren Daten zeigen, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Du hast bei (fast) allen Punkten ein Häkchen gesetzt? Prima!

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Propulsion Functional Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


Description

We are seeking a talented Propulsion Functional Engineer to join the Storm engine project. As a key member of our System Team, you will play a central role in defining the functional architecture of the Storm engine, ensuring seamless integration and correct interaction between subsystems to meet overall mission requirements.


Key Responsibilities

As a Propulsion Functional Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Functional Engineering

    • Contribute to architecture trade-off studies, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments, as well as component selection and make-or-buy decisions

    • Contribute to the evaluation and optimization of the engine architecture and operating conditions

    • Develop and maintain functional performance models of the propulsion system using simulation frameworks such as EcosimPro and Python

  • Systems Engineering

    • Contribute to the definition and allocation of functional requirements for the engine and its subsystems

    • Contribute to FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) to ensure that the system architecture meets reliability and safety targets

  • Testing & Model Validation

    • Contribute to the definition of demonstrator architectures and operating conditions

    • Analyse test data and use test results to validate and anchor system models


What we would love to see from you

  • Master's Degree or higher (or NZ and AUS "Bachelor with honors") in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related and applicable technical discipline. Alternatively, a bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience

  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience working with cryogenic propulsion systems

  • Strong knowledge of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics

  • Fluency in English; proficiency in German or French are an asset

  • Basic knowledge of aerospace standards (e.g. ECSS, NASA guidelines)

  • Experience with modelling and simulation tools (e.g. EcosimPro) and/or experience writing scripts in Python

  • (Optional) Hands-on experience developing hardware from concept to working prototypes is an asset

Skills and Behaviors

  • Strong ability to work in close collaboration with others

  • Strong oral and written communication skills

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills

  • Strong research skills and ability to infer useful information from partial or even contradictory sources

  • Drive towards excellence coupled with ability to work within time constraints

  • Proficiency in organization and prioritization of tasks

  • Behavior consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork

  • Enthusiasm for space exploration: be ready to have an impact on the future global space industry.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. title: QA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams.

What you'll do

  • Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building;

  • Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why;

  • Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable;

  • Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses;

  • Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority;

  • Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release;

  • Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing;

  • Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features.

What you bring

  • A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;

  • At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer;

  • Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans;

  • Experience with test automation and test frameworks;

  • You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests;

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira.

  • You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not;

  • You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code;

  • You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support.

  • Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests;

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better;

  • Experience testing mobile apps.

We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it, Say it, Make it.

What we offer

  • A gross salary between €3,400 and €4,800 based on full-time employment;

  • 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance;

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

  • Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, bi-weekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months and much more;

title: Quantitative Trader | Crypto Options
descriptionHtml:
BlockTech is hiring a Quantitative Trader to join its options trading team in Amsterdam. In this role, you'll take ownership of our trading systems and bring new direction to the desk.

We trade crypto derivatives and spot markets across global venues, 24/7. Our traders don't just watch the systems. They own them end-to-end.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

Our traders work side by side with quantitative researchers and engineers. Research, engineering, and trading happen a few meters apart, so the path from a market read to live PnL is short.

What will you do?

You'll own the systems that trade our capital, from day-to-day operation to the strategies that come next. As a senior trader, you'll also use what you've learned elsewhere to shape where the desk goes.

You will:

  • Own the systems. Monitor, operate, and tune our automated trading systems in live markets.

  • Manage the risk. Manage positions and risk, adjusting pricing and parameters as market behaviour shifts.

  • Set new directions. Bring new ideas to the desk, drawing on your previous experience.

  • Build new strategies. Develop and deploy new strategies together with quantitative researchers and engineers.

  • Spot what’s next. Identify and research new business opportunities as markets change.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, statistics, or computer science.

  • 3+ years of quantitative trading experience.

  • Proficiency in Python, with excellent numerical and algorithmic skills.

  • Focus and sound judgment behind the screen when markets get busy.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience at a proprietary trading firm or hedge fund, particularly with mid-frequency strategies, prediction markets or DeFi.

You don't need: crypto experience. If you've successfully traded derivatives on other asset classes and want to bring that experience to BlockTech, we want to hear from you.

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a very attractive performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: strong performers get the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site on our trading floor in Amsterdam

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from concept to production and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Our culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

title: Recruitment Manager
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij op operationeel niveau bouwen aan de mensen die het onderwijs van duizenden leerlingen versterken? Als Resource Manager bij Lyceo in Leiden krijg je een sleutelpositie binnen een landelijke marktleider die volop groeit. Een baan met directe impact, veel verantwoordelijkheid en volop ruimte om recruitment en capaciteitsmanagement verder te professionaliseren.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Recruitment Manager

Als Resource Manager zorg je ervoor dat Lyceo nu en in de toekomst beschikt over de juiste begeleiders om scholen en leerlingen tijdig te ondersteunen. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor hun beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en inzetbaarheid. Je maakt deel uit van het MT en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie van Lyceo. Met ondersteuning van het datateam bepaal je welke begeleiders waar en wanneer nodig zijn. Op basis daarvan laat je gerichte recruitmentacties uitvoeren en geef je richting aan selectie, matching en onboarding. Met KPI’s bewaak je de instroom, retentie, vervulling en doorlooptijden en stuur je gericht bij. Daarnaast optimaliseer je processen en geef je leiding aan een team met onder andere een Recruiter en een Coördinator Matching en Onboarding. Samen met de Operationeel Manager zorg je voor voldoende geschikte mensen en een succesvolle uitvoering van alle onderwijsprojecten. Bij afwezigheid kunnen jullie elkaars verantwoordelijkheden overnemen.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

• realiseren van voldoende gerichte instroom en een kwalitatief sterke recruitment, selectie en onboarding;

• verbinden van vraag en aanbod op basis van regio, vakgebied, onderwijstype, beschikbaarheid en reisbereidheid;

• voorspellen, bewaken en bijsturen van de capaciteitsbehoefte met data en KPI’s;

• optimaliseren van recruitment en instroomprocessen en adviseren over selectiecriteria, retentie en capaciteit;

• aansturen van het team en bewaken van het recruitmentbudget.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je vertaalt recruitmentdoelstellingen naar concrete acties en stuurt met data op kwaliteit, instroom en capaciteit. Historische resultaten combineer je met verwachtingen en ontwikkelingen in de markt. Ook wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat, kijk je vooruit, maak je keuzes en stuur je tijdig bij. Als leidinggevende sta je dicht bij je team, geef je richting en neem je mensen met positieve energie mee. Ervaring binnen recruitment, arbeidsbemiddeling, detachering of vergelijkbare dienstverlening helpt je om wisselende capaciteitsvragen snel te doorgronden.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

• minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• ervaring met recruitment, werving en selectie;

• leidinggevende ervaring binnen recruitment, capaciteitsmanagement of een vergelijkbare dienstverlenende omgeving;

• ervaring met het sturen op data en KPI’s binnen recruitment of capaciteitsplanning;

• ervaring met het optimaliseren van recruitment- of instroomprocessen.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich in Leiden, vlak bij Leiden Centraal. Vanuit het kantoor werk je nauw samen met de verschillende afdelingen van Lyceo. Dankzij de ligging nabij het centraal station is de werkplek goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

Benefits

Als Recruitment Manager kun jij rekenen op:

Een verantwoordelijke functie bij een groeiende onderwijsorganisatie waar ontwikkeling niet alleen voor leerlingen centraal staat. Lyceo biedt je ruimte voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Via de Lyceo Academie blijf je bovendien zelf leren en krijg je volop mogelijkheden om binnen de organisatie door te groeien.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• een verantwoordelijke functie van 32 tot 40 uur per week, waarbij je tijdens de drukke periodes in het schooljaar flexibel beschikbaar bent;

• 25 vakantiedagen, waarvan je naar rato 10 vakantiedagen opneemt in de zomervakantie;

• de mogelijkheid om 5 extra verlofdagen bij te kopen;

• 8% vakantiegeld, uitbetaald in mei;

• reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten;

• een pensioenregeling waarbij Lyceo 6% premie betaalt;

• een laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• toegang tot exclusieve kortingen via Benefits at Work;

• deelname aan de Lyceo Academie met diverse online en fysieke trainingen;

• volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien binnen Lyceo;

• leuke activiteiten via onze personeelsvereniging Nablijven.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen met onder andere huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen. Scholen beoordelen de dienstverlening van Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger.

Als marktleider is Lyceo volop in beweging en heeft de organisatie duidelijke groeiambities. Je werkt in een betrokken en energieke omgeving waarin samenwerking centraal staat en ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Samen werkt Lyceo aan de beste verbinding tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs, zodat ieder kind tot zijn recht kan komen.

Rejoignez GROUPE M SERVICE, une entreprise dévouée au transport de personnes à mobilité réduite, en tant que référent (e) de proximité. Située à Aulnay-sous-Bois, notre société opère dans l'industrie du transport terrestre de passagers et compte entre 201 et 500 employés engagés. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés par l'assistance aux personnes vulnérables, capables de gérer les défis quotidiens avec compétence et bienveillance. title: Regional Operations Director-Based in Munich/Berlin
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travellers from 170 countries and delivered over one million nights on the road. We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our vehicles.

We are a fast-growing, technology-driven company, and our challenges are both exciting and demanding. We are looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel.

The Role

As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President.

You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model.

You will sit on the regional management team alongside peers from Revenue & Growth, People and Finance, and you will be accountable for your region's operational targets and for the operational cost of the service delivered to our customers.

What You Will Work On

Leadership and performance

  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations
  • Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability
  • Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements
  • Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots
  • Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law.

Customer first

  • Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close

P&L and cost ownership

  • Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control
  • Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives
  • Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality
  • Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region

Collaboration and growth

  • Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region
  • Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region
  • Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time)

Who We Are Looking For

Must have

  • Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education)
  • 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country.
  • You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one.
  • You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere.
  • You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate.
  • You have worked inside more than one employment-law regime and know where local practice genuinely constrains a standard and where it is being used as an excuse.
  • You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies.
  • You handle capital decisions with finance, and can flex a cost base seasonally across several labour markets without letting service or safety slip.
  • You get results through functions that do not report to you. In this structure that is not a nice-to-have: fleet, revenue, customer experience, people and finance all hold things you need and none of them are yours.
  • You treat safety and compliance as yours, at the same standard at your smallest depot as at your largest.
  • You protect the integrity of what gets reported, and would rather receive a bad number that is true than a good one that is not.
  • You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters.
  • Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction.

Nice to have

  • Multi-country general management in rental, logistics, hospitality or retail, rather than single-market experience repeated.
  • A strongly seasonal business, or one where the asset is the product.
  • Experience of a structure where the functions you depend on report elsewhere.
  • Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one.
  • A third language used in your region

The Indie Commitment

  • A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact
  • Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila
  • Continuous training and coaching
  • Free road trips across Europe, North America and Oceania

Are you ready to Go Indie?

title: Director of Global Training
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

As Director of Global Training, you’ll shape UFORCE’s global training capability, enabling customers to operate our uncrewed systems safely, legally and effectively.

Reporting to the VP Military Exercises, you’ll set a consistent standard across markets, working through training schools, regional and technical teams while local delivery and commercial ownership remain with the regions.

What You Will Do

  • Own global operator and maintainer syllabi, assessment and certification, with controlled materials, consistent thresholds and appropriate local adaptation.

  • Develop training for new products and command-and-control systems, including individual and group operation, communications and configuration.

  • Turn validated field experience, including lessons from Ukraine and exercises, into practical instruction within security and sharing restrictions.

  • Assure standards through school visits, authorisation and certification records, near-miss reporting and corrective actions, feeding findings into training improvements and VP-led safety investigations.

  • Lead the UK-first route to training-authority recognition with Legal and country leads, distinguishing operating permissions from authority to train and certify and using third-party provision where needed.

  • Set common course pricing and align instructors and assets with confirmed demand. Coordinate customer-site training with clear responsibilities for safety, equipment and field engineer support.

  • Build a sustainable in-house instructor capability, supported by external providers for specialist needs and peak demand.

  • Deliver cost-effective simulation and blended learning, building on existing capability, managing the allocated budget and retaining hands-on training where essential.

What We're Looking For

  • Multi-site training leadership in defence, military or a comparable safety-critical technical environment, with hands-on experience in course design, assessment and instructor standardisation.

  • Credibility with experienced operators and instructors, sound security judgement and a track record of improving training through operational feedback.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership, with the ability to secure commitments and resolve resource conflicts without direct line authority.

  • Experience contributing to regulatory approvals or audits, alongside training pricing and capacity planning.

  • Experience delivering simulation or blended-learning programmes, with sound budget and learning-outcome decisions.

  • An inclusive, accountable leadership style that encourages honest reporting and protects safety and standards under pressure.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to training bases, customer sites and exercises.

Nice to Have

  • Operational experience with uncrewed systems, including frontline or conflict-environment experience, or training experience in command and control.

  • Experience with training-authority processes and international operating permissions.

  • Experience delivering training in multiple languages and adapting it for different cultures.

  • Experience building an internal instructor pipeline.

  • Familiarity with security clearance constraints that affect who can deliver training.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

title: Financemanagement Specialist - Fintech (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren
