About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We build AI-powered engines that make, localize, launch and learn from creative, using ElevenLabs’ full audio and video stack. Enterprise customers are already working with us. While our product teams focus on self-serve, these roles seed a dedicated enterprise engineering team: the people who make ElevenCreative work for our biggest customers and unblock enterprise deals. You sit between the customer and the product. You’ll talk to enterprise customers, understand their requirements, and decide whether to build a bespoke integration for them or a product improvement for everyone. Making that call well is the job.

  • Has worked directly with customers as a forward-deployed engineer, solutions engineer or founding engineer at a B2B startup, including presenting to enterprise clients.

  • Turns a customer’s ask into the real requirement: builds bespoke when it unblocks a deal, and generalizes when several customers want the same thing.

  • Ships end-to-end with little direction. There’s no PM to define everything first.

Bonus: experience with localization or TMS integrations, brand or marketing tooling, or adtech.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and Europe, with the ability to operate in European timezones required and flexibility for customer timezones when deals need it. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw

descriptionHtml:
You’ve built data teams from the ground up and know how to turn raw information into better product decisions. You care deeply about how AI is changing software development, and you want to shape the data foundations that make it happen.

JetBrains Air is an AI-native software development platform that connects developer workflows, collaboration, and control into a single system. Because this is a major strategic focus for us, we need a strong data function to help guide it. By building a high-performing team, you’ll help us use data to navigate product direction, optimize product and go-to-market decisions, and accelerate growth.   • Partner with engineering teams to design robust, compliant data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Guide the development of machine learning capabilities that enhance marketing acquisition, product personalization, and operational efficiency.

  • Define the business unit's data strategy to support product and engineering priorities.

What you’ll bring

  • A strategic mindset paired with a willingness to dive hands-on into the details when necessary.

What you’ll need

You will have transformed JetBrains Air into a truly data-informed, experimentation-driven product offering. By establishing strong data foundations, you’ll empower teams to deeply understand our customers, accurately measure product impact, and confidently make strategic decisions. As a People Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll sit at the intersection of leadership coaching, organisational design, performance, and day-to-day people guidance.

Requirements

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Upsun

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.

  • Customer and data authority: Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.

  • Influence across teams: Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.

  • Go-to-market: Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.

What you bring

  • Product management experience: Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Technical depth: Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

  • AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

  • Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

  • Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

Bonus points for

  • Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.

  • Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Germany, Canada, Spain, France, and the UK. We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.

You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, Product)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (IC's)
  4. 60 Minutes with Product Leaders
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CTO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

🛜 Internet reimbursement

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. Responsibilities:

  • Ensure TM1 remains the single source of truth vs. NetSuite actuals. Drive reporting automation, refine Google Sheets dashboards, and streamline close/budget cycles.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills. Hands-on experience with corporate planning tools (TM1/Cognos is a strong plus; Anaplan/Adaptive) and ERP systems (NetSuite preferred). Strong grasp of core accounting concepts (accruals, prepayments, opex vs. capex).

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Deepdesk
descriptionHtml:
About Deepdesk

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.


What You’ll Be Doing

• Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.

• Keep our databases fast and reliable.

• Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

• Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.

• Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required.

• Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics.

• Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code.

• Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering.

• Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed.

Our Stack

• Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go.

• Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API.

• Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.

• Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.

• Front end: TypeScript and React.

• Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.

• Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.

• Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.

• Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength.

• A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.

• Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.

• Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.

• A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

Why Join Us?

• Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details]

• A small team working with major enterprise clients.

• Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale.

• Full autonomy and full ownership of your work.

• High standards, trust and plenty of humour.

• The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres.

• Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

• Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

• Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

• Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

• Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

  • Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
  • Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
  • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.
  • Clear writing and comfort working async: we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English.

The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises.
  • Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity.
  • Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own the adoption metrics: you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it.
  • Lots of room to improve: we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far.
  • Your own engineering team: you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Small numbers: we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating.
  • No playbook: this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.

descriptionHtml:

At Luminovo, we’re building the infrastructure that turns the electronics supply chain into something software can read and act on. Our customers use it to quote PCBAs faster, find cost savings and act on risks in their supply chain.

We serve 300+ customers, from Europe’s largest EMS to category-leading OEMs, with around 100 Luminerds across Munich, Berlin, New York and Austin. With data centers and robotics driving demand for electronics, someone needs to manage that supply chain, and they’ll need good software to do it. (Here’s why we care so much about electronics.)

🚀 Your role

Team Core is our platform team. Its job is to make all our other engineering teams more productive and to improve our codebase and infrastructure as a whole. You’ll:

  • Keep our DevOps setup and CI/CD pipelines fast and reliable

  • Act as an in-house Rust expert: our backend is a Rust monolith, and Team Core helps the other teams use good Rust patterns and architecture

  • Help our engineers use agents more productively

Other details

  • Location: remote-first, within two hours of CET. We prefer Munich > Berlin > Germany > Europe.

We always try to use the best tools available for the job. Don't worry, we don't need you to be familiar with all of these:

  • Main monolith is written in Rust (using actix-web as our web framework), deployed on Kubernetes

  • React and Typescript for frontend

  • PostgreSQL for persisting our data

  • Redis for caching and queues

  • Flux for GitOps

  • Honeycomb, Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring and observability

  • garden-io for developing on Kubernetes

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

title: Remote Sr. Product Manager - Revenue Management - 1 year contract (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.

You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.

What you'll do

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

  • Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

  • Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

  • Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

Discovery & Delivery

  • Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

  • Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

  • Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

Impact & Influence

  • Define and own KPIs for your area, be clear about what moved them and why, and be honest about correlation vs. causation.

  • Influence across teams without authority, especially where your area depends on other RM teams, Reporting and Integrations.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years as a Senior Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS, with clear ownership of outcomes, not just outputs.

  • A track record of making complex systems radically simple

  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information.

  • Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build.

  • Plus: Experience in hospitality tech, revenue management systems or pricing.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

  • You're a curious, structured thinker with strong product intuition.

  • You can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship intact.

  • You ask "why" until it's clear, and explain "how" until it clicks.

  • You reflect honestly on what didn't work.

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

title: Technical Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

You'll co-own the roadmap with the Product Manager and you'll specifically own delivery health and technical outcomes. The role combines people leadership with hands-on technical accountability.

  • Reports to - Head of Engineering / Director of Engineering

  • Team span - 1 Engineering Team

  • Works closely with - Product Manager (equal counterpart on the team)

  • Role type - Full-time, people leadership with hands-on technical accountability

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Co-own the roadmap with your Product Manager, balancing delivery, quality and technical health as genuine equals.

  • Own delivery health for your team - predictability, throughput and the quality of what ships.

  • Hold technical accountability by default. Ownership of technical quality of the teams work, including architecture and SLOs

  • Stay close to the codebase so you can make informed calls on technical trade-offs, risk and quality.

  • Read code, review PRs and pair-programme regularly, both to maintain technical quality and to mentor engineers.

  • Manage, coach and develop the engineers on your team, and own hiring from sourcing through to close.

  • Set and track team-level goals in partnership with your direct reports.

  • Own your team's budget, including software spend and headcount planning.

  • Own SLOs and operational health for the systems your team is responsible for.

  • Drive adoption of AI tooling and practices within your team.

 

REQUIREMENTS - TECHNICAL BAR

  • Read and understand code across the team's primary stack.

title: Threat Research Engineer, Security Factory: Threat Research
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.

What you’ll do

  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.
  • Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.
  • Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.

You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

About the team

The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog.

descriptionHtml:

L’Institut Mines-Télécom est le 1ᵉʳ groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. L’Institut Mines-Télécom est placé sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Economie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique. Il emploie 3 500 personnes (fonctionnaires, contractuels en CDI et CDD) et accueille sur les différents campus 15 000 étudiants pour des formations de niveau bachelor, master et doctorat.

La Direction Générale (DG) de l’Institut est chargée du pilotage de cet ensemble de 3500 agents et de la coordination des actions inter-écoles.

La Direction des Ressources Humaines est chargée d’adosser la politique de gestion des ressources humaines harmonisée et cohérente avec la stratégie de développement de l’IMT et ses enjeux. Pour cela, elle anime la construction et la mise en œuvre de la doctrine collective en matière de GRH, pilote l’efficience générale et anime le partage d’expériences et l’innovation collaborative sur les sujets de GRH. Elle est composée de 14 agents.

L’IMT s’est doté en 2023 d’un SIRH commun à l’ensemble de ses entités avec HR Access et 4YOU de Sopra et a mis en place une « paie sans ordonnancement préalable (PSOP) » en partenariat avec la DRFiP.

Un projet a été initié en vue d’optimiser l’organisation de la fonction paie à l’IMT et les outils SIRH associés.

QUELLES MISSIONS VOUS ATTENDENT AU SEIN DE L’IMT ? :

Sous la responsabilité de la Directrice des ressources humaines de l’IMT, en qualité de Responsable du pôle SIRH et paie vous êtes en charge des missions suivantes :

  • Assurer la conduite du changement sur les évolutions : rédaction de modes opératoires et formation des utilisateurs ;

  • Suivre le pilotage global du SIRH avec la DSI et SOPRA ;

  • Gérer les référentiels : éléments de paie, mise à jour des unités organisationnelles, mise à jour des constantes, etc.

2. Coordonner la fonction paie :

  • Animer le réseau des responsables et gestionnaires de paie des entités de l’IMT ;

  • Déterminer le calendrier global des opérations de paie ;

  • Assurer le lien fonctionnel avec l’agence comptable principale ;

  • Analyser les conséquences en paie des nouvelles réglementations et diffuser les modes opératoires correspondants ;

  • Assurer certaines opérations de paie centralisées : augmentations annuelles, bonus variables, etc. ;

  • Gérer la relation avec le Centre des paies de l’Etat (CPE) ;

  • Assurer le lien avec les organismes extérieurs (GMF, Alan, Ircantec, Caisse des dépôts et consignations, URSSAF, France Travail, etc.) ;

  • Superviser et développer le dispositif de contrôle de paie a posteriori afin de garantir la qualité des opérations de paie.

3. Encadrer l’équipe du pôle :

  • Organiser les activités du pôle ;

  • Assurer l’encadrement fonctionnel et hiérarchique de l’équipe.

4. Participer à des missions transverses :

  • Participer à la réunion bi-mensuelle des DRH de l’ensemble des entités de l’IMT et, le cas échéant, intervenir sur les sujets concernant le pôle ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des organismes de contrôle sur les sujets relevant du pôle : URSSAF, commissaires aux comptes, etc.

  • Apporter votre concours au projet de réorganisation de la fonction paie.

Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de paie des entités de l’IMT, le Responsable d’applicatifs SIRH de la DSI et les autres pôles de la DRH de la direction générale de l’IMT.

title: Robot Learning Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About EASE

EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.

The role

Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to turn that data into skills our humanoid can actually perform, so that human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.

What you'll do

  • Map human motion onto humanoid kinematics and close the embodiment gap

  • Train manipulation and whole-body policies with imitation and reinforcement learning

  • Evaluate in Isaac Lab or MuJoCo and on our in-house humanoid, and measure the value of our data

  • Define what data training needs and help build our training setup, including GPU compute

  • Turn new research on robot foundation models and VLAs into prototypes

What you bring

  • Master's or PhD in robotics, CS, ML or similar, with hands-on experience from industry or research

  • Imitation or reinforcement learning on real robots (e.g. Diffusion Policy, ACT, PPO)

  • Strong Python and PyTorch; C++ is a plus

  • Physics simulation and sim-to-real transfer

  • Solid kinematics, dynamics and control

Nice to have

  • Learning from human data (egocentric video, motion capture, retargeting)

  • Humanoids, legged robots or exoskeletons; publications at CoRL, RSS, ICRA or NeurIPS

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match.

What we offer

  • Data almost nobody else has, from a product in series deployment

  • Our own humanoid and the chance to build Physical AI at EASE from the ground up

  • Competitive salary plus virtual stock options (VSOP)

  • Flexible hours, hybrid in Munich, mobility benefit

  • Budget for conferences and further training

How to apply

Send your CV with links to GitHub, papers or robot videos.

Martin Fleischer, CEO & Co-Founder

title: Robotics Integration Engineer (Launchpad)
descriptionHtml:
At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent.

Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance.

 

‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

 

Your Team:

Launchpad is where autonomy meets the real world: covering integration, commissioning, testing, and initial deployments. We love flexible engineers who enjoy stepping out from behind a single domain to tackle every layer of the problem—whether that’s tweaking code, troubleshooting hardware in the field, or getting a vehicle running smoothly on-site.

Your Role:

As a member of Launchpad you will acquire a comprehensive understanding of the system’s components and interactions, identifying the areas for improvement and acting as an initial customer to drive our technical capabilities forwards. We are a team of problem solvers and keen roboticists who enjoy looking at the big picture and tackling challenges, and we are devoted to perfecting our software both in the real and the virtual worlds to deliver the best possible version of our vision for Universal Autonomy™️.

What makes this role unique?

  • Full-Lifecycle Engineering: Bridge the gap between software development, hardware integration, and real-world execution. You’ll own problems end-to-end, moving fluidly between systems engineering, software diagnostics, and physical setup.

  • Real-World Application: Get hands-on with cutting-edge field robotics deployed alongside major global partners in airports, ports, and industrial yard operations.

  • Global Exposure: Based in the UK, with exciting secondment opportunities to work on-site with our partners in the UAE.

  • You'll build the tools, not file tickets for them. The software our field engineers depend on is written by the people who need it — a viewer for every sensor and subsystem, a commissioning GUI, log-snipping and replay tooling, and automatic code change management. There's no separate tooling team to hand problems to. When a capability falls between two teams and nobody owns it, it becomes ours to write.

  • We built our own factory to develop robots in. A mock industrial site on our own test estate — real vehicles, real workflows — where autonomy runs daily, unsupervised and where every new feature gets proven first.

  • Bare metal to driverless. Bringing up a new vehicle tests every assumption in the stack at once — network, sensors, controllers, calibration — and the real work is diagnosing why it doesn't come up. You'll be the person who traces a fault across the hardware–software boundary, finds the actual cause rather than a workaround, and then makes sure the next vehicle never hits it: fewer manual steps, better checks, days instead of weeks.

  • AI is in our workflow, not our pitch deck. LLM coding assistants are standard issue here, and every merge request can get an automated review before a human sees it. We point models at the product too — automatic code change generation from release diffs, ML-based scenario recognition, telemetry-first triage of field issues. Some of our most interesting open threads are agent loops that take an operator's report of an autonomy issue and iterate towards a fix.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Work as part of a cross-functional team in the field to operate, test, and debug our autonomy systems in the real world.

  • Build, upgrade and maintain maps for testing our vehicles in the real world.

  • Investigate and analyse data to enable issues to be identified and resolved.

  • Work collaboratively with multi-disciplinary (and multicultural) teams, communicating technical requirements and working together to find solutions.

  • Identify functionality gaps, contributing to the development of hotfixes and new features.

  • This is a hybrid role which will require working hands-on with autonomous vehicles.

  • This role will require extensive travel to the UAE for seconded periods of time. Candidates must have no restrictions on their passport preventing entry into the UAE and no criminal record.

     

Requirements:

  • Strong problem-solving skills, particularly working with hardware and across the hardware-software boundary.

  • Process development, with a focus on creating reliable, streamlined workflows that others can easily scale and follow.

  • Able to manage workload and adapt quickly in the face of physical build and schedule challenges.

  • Able to work flexibly with shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Able to capture software and process requirements, translating them into reliable tooling and workflows.

  • Able to plan and coordinate the delivery of projects with multiple stakeholders across different teams.

  • Familiarity with the software development process, particularly in scripting, automation, and building internal tooling (e.g., Python/Bash).

  • Working knowledge of C++, ROS or equivalent middleware, Linux, and git/CI — enough to navigate and debug an unfamiliar robotics codebase rather than waiting for its author.

  • Ability to work in multi-disciplinary teams, communicating technical requirements effectively with software, hardware etc.

  • This role requires regular presence in our Oxford workshops and test sites to capture requirements and develop a hands-on understanding of the gaps in the process and tools.

     

Your Interview Experience:

Our interview process is designed to give you every chance to get the measure of us, and us of you. You will join three stages which will give you every opportunity to show your strengths and qualities, via scenario based questions and technical exercises.

 

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary benchmarked against the market

  • Participation in a great company equity scheme

  • Enhanced pension contributions

  • Annual holiday allowance of 25 days per year

  • Overseas working policy for up to 8 weeks per year

  • Flexible, hybrid and remote working arrangements

  • Comprehensive Private Health cover with the option to add family members,

  • Enhanced health and wellbeing benefits including health cash plan, critical illness cover, life assurance and group income protection

  • Enhanced paid maternity and paternity policy

 

If you're excited by deep technical problems, real-world AI, and the opportunity to build technology that will reshape global industry, you'll find both the challenge and the impact you're looking for at Oxa.

title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President's Club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passionate about transformational technology in the world operations
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways

Total Rewards

title: Senior Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

  • Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel.   • Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, AI Platform (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer on our AI Platform team, you take AI at bunch from working to relied upon. We already run AI in production — a document extraction pipeline live in fund operations, agent workflows on Mastra, evaluations, and multi-provider fallback inside EU data residency. Fund operations run on documents, deadlines and numbers that have to be right — subscription documents to parse, capital calls to chase, portfolio data to reconcile. You build on that foundation: more agents taking that work off people's hands, the evaluations that prove they can be trusted with it, and the platform that lets every other team at bunch ship the same way. This is end-to-end product engineering, not research: you own architecture, evaluation, integration, and deployment.

Top Priorities

  • Build and ship agents. Design agents that automate real fund-operations workflows, and own them from prototype through production and after. They integrate with our services, data model, and authorization system — they don't sit beside the product as standalone prototypes.

  • Evaluate and improve agent performance. Build the evaluation layer: test cases built from real documents with the output we expect, regression suites in CI, human review where correctness is non-negotiable, and clear success criteria for an agent completing a complex task end to end. Then move the numbers that matter — accuracy, latency, cost.

  • Own the AI application architecture. Orchestration and multi-agent design, tool contracts, memory, and context engineering (RAG, MCP) with clear domain boundaries — plus the guardrails, approvals, and human-in-the-loop controls that anything touching investor money requires.

  • Run it in production. Versioned, feature-flagged rollout of agent versions; rate limits, provider fallback, and regional failover within EU data residency; and the observability to trace a failure across services and turn it into a fix rather than a theory.

  • Make it a platform, not a project. Document parsing and extraction consolidates into this team, and shared evaluation and observability become something other teams consume rather than rebuild. You set the patterns other engineers inherit, partner closely with DevX, and mentor engineers across teams on agent and LLM practice.

Your First 90 Days

  • Review our MCP offering end to end and ship it to the first customers, with the access boundaries, evaluation and observability a customer-facing surface needs.

  • Stand up shared observability for our AI workloads — token usage, estimated cost, latency, failures and retries per provider — on a dashboard people actually open during an incident.

  • Publish v1 of our agent patterns (domain boundaries, tool contracts, prompt and eval conventions), reviewed with DevX and adopted by at least one team outside AI Platform.

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years building production software, including at least one agent or LLM-powered capability you took end to end and still owned once it was live

  • Agents: real depth in orchestration and context engineering — tool contracts, memory, RAG, multi-agent design — with Mastra, ai-sdk, LangGraph or similar. You've integrated agents into a real product and its authorization model, not built prototypes for someone else to productionise

  • Evaluation: you know how to make a non-deterministic system measurable, from test cases built on real data to regression suites and human review, and you can tell the difference between a model that improved and a benchmark that got easier

  • Production: you own what you ship. Reading traces, diagnosing failure modes, tuning cost and latency, handling provider rate limits and fallback without drama

  • Backend: You have experience with TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Platform mindset: you build for other engineers as much as for end users, and the standards you set get adopted because people trust you, not because they are written down

  • Pragmatic: you start from the business outcome, choose the deterministic solution when it's the right one, and know when good enough is good enough

  • Experience in fintech, private markets, or another regulated, document-heavy domain is a plus, as is working under EU data-residency constraints

Our Tech Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, Svelte and React

At Atlantic, we back founders in AI, compute, spacetech, and deep tech, often when it's still just a few people and a big idea. What happens next depends less on the idea and more on who joins them: the first engineer who can actually build it, the CTO who scales it, the commercial lead who gets it into the world.

That's why talent sits at the heart of our Venture Development work. We go out and find those people ourselves, and we help our companies build the organizations around them: how teams are structured, how people are paid, and how they grow.

The breakthroughs we're most excited about will come from people who aren't on anyone's radar yet. We want to find them first and put them where they can have the biggest impact. title: Senior Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs. 

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design, develop and deliver enterprise-scale automation solutions using UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python. This is a genuinely hands-on, multi-platform role: you will actively build solutions in all three technologies, not simply oversee delivery. 

You will own technical delivery from design and development through testing, deployment and optimisation, working with clients and distributed delivery teams. This is a UK-based remote position with occasional travel for client engagements, project workshops and team activities. 

As an L3 engineer, you will tackle complex technical problems independently, contribute to code quality and engineering standards, and support less experienced colleagues without being expected to act as a dedicated people manager. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Design, develop, test and deploy robust automation solutions using UiPath, Automation Anywhere A360 and Python. 
  • Own technical delivery across the automation lifecycle, including solution design, documentation, release and post-deployment optimisation. 
  • Build integrations with REST APIs, databases and enterprise applications; create maintainable Python applications and components beyond basic scripting. 
  • Develop reusable components and frameworks, applying secure coding, exception handling, logging and operational monitoring practices. 
  • Diagnose and resolve complex automation failures, integration issues and performance bottlenecks in development and production. 
  • Apply engineering standards across Git, peer review, automated testing and CI/CD; contribute to reliable deployments. 
  • Collaborate with architects, technical leads, analysts and clients to translate business needs into practical technical solutions. 
  • Support effort estimation, technical documentation, knowledge sharing and mentoring for junior and mid-level engineers. 
  • Keep current with automation technologies and identify practical opportunities to improve delivery and client outcomes. 

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES 

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing and delivering RPA or intelligent automation solutions; this does not mean four years in each individual technology. 
  • Strong hands-on UiPath development experience, including Studio, Orchestrator and REFramework. 
  • Strong hands-on Automation Anywhere development experience, particularly Automation 360 (A360) and Control Room. 
  • Strong practical Python development capability beyond basic scripting, including maintainable code, applications, integrations or reusable components. 
  • Demonstrable experience actively developing solutions across UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python. 
  • Experience owning solutions from technical design and development through testing, deployment and support. 
  • Solid software engineering foundations, including debugging, exception handling, reusable code and testing. 
  • Experience with REST APIs, SQL/databases, JSON, Git and enterprise-system integration. 
  • Ability to investigate complex problems, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and work independently in distributed teams. 
  • Based in the UK and willing to travel occasionally for client engagements, project workshops and internal collaboration. 

NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES 

  • UiPath Advanced RPA Developer or equivalent certification; Automation Anywhere Advanced or Master RPA Professional certification. 
  • Experience with Power Automate, Power Platform or other automation technologies. 
  • Experience integrating with SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or similar enterprise applications. 
  • Familiarity with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud and CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. 
  • Experience with intelligent document processing, such as UiPath Document Understanding or Azure Document Intelligence. 
  • Exposure to generative AI, Agentic AI or AI-enabled automation use cases. 
  • Experience in consultancy, client-facing delivery or Agile teams. 

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 

You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who enjoys building reliable solutions and solving difficult problems. You can move confidently between UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python, take ownership with limited supervision, work directly with clients, write clear and maintainable code, and share knowledge with colleagues. You value delivery quality and practical outcomes over technology for its own sake. 

WHAT WE OFFER 

  • A UK-based remote role, with opportunities to collaborate with international delivery teams and clients. 
  • The opportunity to work across multiple leading automation platforms rather than being restricted to one technology. 
  • Exposure to emerging AI and Agentic Automation capabilities as our offering evolves. 
  • A collaborative specialist consultancy environment that values initiative, technical expertise and practical problem-solving. 
  • Opportunities to broaden your technical skills and contribute to the development of our automation practice.
