title: Senior Backend & AI Engineer (Remote)
descriptionHtml:
This role is open only to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations.

If you've built something before, start here

The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day.

What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day.

What you'll do

You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with.

  • Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket.

  • Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved.

  • Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on.

  • Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate.

  • Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix.

  • Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version

  • You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations

  • At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need

  • You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users

  • You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both

  • You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data

  • You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls

  • You make things simpler over time, not more clever

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement

title: Senior Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or UK Remote | 💰 Senior Engineer (L50) £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Engineering  

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blogis a good place to learn even more about what we do!

Your day-to-day   

This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! 

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! 

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

How we work 💻

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

You should apply if:

  • you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
  • you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework - we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! 

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll be working on: 

We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: 

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
  • Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services 
  • Envoy Proxy for RPC
  • AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure
  • React for our public web apps and internal tools
  • We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

  1. Initial Call 
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise 
  3. Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview 

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

What’s in it for you:

💰 £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅We can sponsor visas.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.

At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. title: Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
descriptionHtml:
Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

title: Senior Business Controller (Operations)
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to work closely with the business as a Senior Business Controller and use your financial expertise to make a real impact on decisions? You will bring financial structure and insight, while keeping a forward-looking perspective: where can we improve, which decisions will make a financial difference, and what will they mean for our results?

HG is a compact, international organisation. This means considerable responsibility, direct contact with decision-makers and room to drive change yourself. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, works pragmatically and is not afraid to challenge existing ways of working.

You will be based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working opportunities are limited: regular office attendance is important in this role because of the close collaboration with Finance, Operations and other stakeholders. You will also travel to the United Kingdom or Germany several times a year.

About the role

As Senior Business Controller, you will be responsible for business control within Operations and will also support our subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Germany. You have a clear vision of what the best operational business control model looks like and have proven experience in realizing this. The Senior Business Controller plays a key role in strengthening financial control, transparency and decision-making across Operations. The scope covers procurement and product costing, as well as warehouse and transport operations. Working closely with Finance, Procurement and Operations, the Senior Business Controller translates operational developments and improvement initiatives into clear financial insights and P&L impact

Our business is undergoing significant change. HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making.

What you will do

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and. act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights;

  • Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs.

  • Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases.

  • Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances.

  • Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances.

  • Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact.

  • Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes.

  • Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments.

  • Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives.

  • Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L.

  • Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting.

  • Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure.

  • Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation.

  • Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled.

  • Establish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners.

  • Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board.

  • Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency.

You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers.

This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for a financially strong, hands-on and improvement-oriented controller who combines analytical capability with a practical understanding of Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Finance, Procurement and Operations and is able to turn complex cost drivers into clear insights and concrete actions.

You bring a proactive mindset, strong stakeholder-management skills and a natural drive to simplify and improve processes. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, creating structure in a changing environment and taking ownership from analysis through implementation.

You will also have:

  • A completed university master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. A Registered Controller (RC) qualification is a strong advantage.

  • Around 10 years of relevant experience in business control, operations control or a comparable financial role.

  • Experience in a manufacturing environment is important, including knowledge of production processes, procurement and cost calculations.

  • A sound understanding of business control, financial controls and treasury.

  • Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how financial data and accounting flows are structured.

  • Good knowledge of Power BI. You do not need to build everything from scratch, but you can independently investigate, improve and develop analyses.

  • Experience working with consolidation tools.

  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • A proactive, hands-on and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to create structure in a changing environment.

  • Fluency in English. Knowledge of Dutch is desirable, and German is an advantage.

  • Experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

  • Willingness to travel to the United Kingdom and Germany several times a year.

Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What do we offer

At HG, you will not be stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone. Changes in our logistics operations, systems and reporting create opportunities to further professionalize financial control and implement improvements yourself.

You can expect:

  • a senior role with broad responsibility and direct influence on financial and operational decision-making;

  • a salary appropriate to the seniority of the role, with an indicative range of €85,000 to €100,000 gross per year;

  • an annual on-target bonus of 25% of your gross annual salary;

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave;

  • a pension scheme;

  • a commuting allowance;

  • a full-time role based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working is possible on a limited basis, with office attendance being an important part of the role;

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at .

Would you like to apply for the senior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

title: Senior Computational Physicist, Stellarator Optimization
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

TEAM AND ROLE

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Computational Physicist - Stellarator Optimization, you will design the magnetic fields and coils at the core of our stellarators. You will balance plasma performance with engineering requirements, prioritizing simple, practical designs that can be built. Your work will directly shape Stellaris, our first commercial fusion power plant.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will shape the “heart” of the stellarator: the magnetic field that confines the plasma and the coils that create it.

  • Release optimized plasma and coil geometries that engineering teams use to design magnets, supporting structures, and surrounding sub-systems.

  • Resolve design trade-offs between physics, engineering and assembly requirements.

  • Own research projects that overcome technical challenges. Choose questions by their impact to the stellarator and carry the answers through to engineering decisions.

  • Deliver results in time for design milestones, with clear recommendations, checked assumptions, and uncertainties that engineers can work with.

    WHO YOU ARE

  • You have strong mathematical reasoning and experience solving difficult computational problems. You can work from first principles and choose methods that fit the question.

  • You have independently driven research to useful outcomes, in academia or industry. You can frame an ambiguous problem, set priorities, and deliver without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • You understand that designs need to meet requirements and deadlines. You know when to investigate further and when to commit to a validated solution.

  • You write clear, reliable scientific code. You are comfortable with Python, or can become productive in it quickly, and use testing, version control, and code review.

  • You have a master’s degree in a STEM field, or equivalent experience. We welcome physicists, mathematicians, engineers, computer scientists, and researchers from other quantitative backgrounds. A PhD is not required.

  • Prior fusion, tokamak, or stellarator experience is not required. You bring the computational attitude and willingness to learn the physics.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle.

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers.

  • Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators.

  • System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses.

  • Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.

  • Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time.


What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems.

  • Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement).

  • System Identification & Allocation: Demonstrated experience utilizing system identification methods or empirical frequency response estimation to characterize raw plant dynamics, alongside data-driven control allocation techniques.

  • Nonlinear Control Theory: Strong theoretical and practical foundation in Differential Geometry as applied to nonlinear systems, specifically utilizing Feedback Linearization and Differential Flatness for exact state transformation.

  • State Estimation: Proficiency in Kalman Filtering for state estimation under non-holonomic constraints.

  • Implementation & Tooling: High proficiency in either the MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or Python. The core requirement is your ability to translate complex control logic into clean, deterministic execution ready for real-time environments.

Your Benefits:

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles.

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life.

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget.

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Experimentation
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you'll enable high-quality human-led decision-making to maximise impact.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Deliveroo, your goal is to maximise business impact within one of our product areas. A core part of the role is designing, running and interpreting experiments, and using causal inference to guide product decisions in complex, real-world settings.

You will go beyond simply answering "did this feature work?" and instead focus on understanding what the true impact is, why it worked or did not work, and how results generalise across users, markets and time.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Driving Strategy/insights through Experimentation: Leading the design of both simple and complex experiments and proactively translating findings into strategic direction.

  • Master Causal Inference: Apply advanced techniques to estimate long-term and heterogeneous treatment effects.

  • Drawing reliable conclusions in settings with selection bias or imperfect randomisation.

  • Drive Deep Product Insights: Uncover the fundamental drivers of experiment performance, determining why features succeed and how results generalise across different users, markets, and timeframes.

  • Using insights from past experiments to improve future decision-making.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Strong experience designing, running and interpreting A/B experiments in production environments

  • Solid understanding of causal inference concepts

  • Ability to apply statistical thinking to messy, real-world product problems, not just ideal experimental setups

  • Great communication skills in person, in writing and in code, with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

  • Familiarity with SQL

  • Excellent people skills as you will be meeting with stakeholders to translate business needs into data science problems

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

descriptionHtml:

⭐Our Tax team

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on and enthusiastic Senior Director of Global Tax to lead the Global Tax team at Monzo, and our wider finance team.

You’ll be leading our growing Tax team of 10+ individuals, and will be reporting into the Group Financial Controller (with a close partnership with the MBL Chief Financial Officer and wider Executive team).

A large part of the role involves advising on the tax implications of all new business developments, ensuring we’re both set up for compliance and optimised wherever possible and appropriate. Given the stage Monzo is currently at in its growth journey, these will be many and wide ranging, from customer products to treasury strategies, group reorgs to mobility proposals, systems implementations to international expansion.

🔑 Key responsibilities of the role...

  • Global tax strategy: Defining how Monzo approaches tax across the UK, Europe, and future markets. You will set our tax risk appetite and prepare reporting for our Audit and Risk Committee.
  • International expansion: Structuring cross-border expansion across Europe and future regions, advising on market-entry structures, permanent establishment risks, and local compliance.
  • Transfer pricing: Establishing, documenting, and defending our global transfer pricing strategy and intragroup financing arrangements.
  • Total tax ownership: Overseeing group Direct Tax, Indirect Tax (VAT), Employment Tax, Transfer Pricing, and Operational Customer Taxes across all locations.
  • Tax authority relationships: Acting as the primary liaison with HMRC and international tax authorities, proactively managing tax audits, and overseeing statutory regimes including Senior Accounting Officer compliance.
  • Product and commercial advisory: Working directly with product managers, engineers, and treasury to understand what they want to build (from savings pots to complex lending products) and ensuring the tax treatment is clear from day one.
  • Leading the team: Mentoring and leading our tax team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, autonomy, and commercial focus.
  • AI and automation: Designing a tech-enabled tax operating model that embeds AI, workflow tools, and automation across our compliance, reconciliations, and contract reviews; scaling our output as volumes grow while keeping the team focused on high-judgement strategic work.

🤩We’d love to hear from you if...

title: Senior Director, Player/Manager  - UK Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future.

At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 50+ nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all. We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to lead and accelerate growth within the UK Public Sector for the leading British Sovereign AI champion?

Quantexa is embarking on a significant expansion of its EMEA Public Sector Go-To-Market (GTM) team. Following landmark wins—including our historic 10-year partnership with HMRC —we are looking for a highly motivated leader to direct our UK Public Sector sales activity.

As a Senior Director and Player/Manager for the UK Public Sector, you will spearhead our continued growth in the UK. You will lead, mentor, and expand a high-performing team of Sales Directors while simultaneously acting as an active "player" managing a high-value pipeline, farming existing landmark accounts, and hunting for new strategic opportunities across the UK Government, Security, and Defence sectors.

What you’ll be doing

Your role will be a dynamic blend of team leadership, strategic direction, and active enterprise selling (Player/Manager).

  • Strategic GTM Leadership: Work closely with our VP for Public Sector Sales, EMEA, Regional Vice-President, and Solution Owners to define and execute the UK go-to-market plan and sales strategy.

  • Deal Execution (“Player”): Personally lead complex, strategic, high-value opportunities across UK Central Government, National Security, and Defence.

  • Consultative Selling: Build and nurture a diverse, multi-stage pipeline of opportunities through a consultative, land-and-expand approach.

  • Performance and Accountability: Set a high bar for the team and hold people to it, measuring performance through leading indicators and field observation as well as quota attainment.

  • Coaching and Talent Development: Coach the team hands-on through live deals, spend time in the field giving meaningful feedback, and build a diverse, high-performing team. Help the team learn from both wins and losses.

  • Operating Rhythm: Run a disciplined cadence of forecast calls, pipeline reviews, 1:1s and QBRs, each with a clear purpose. Quickly diagnose and fix forecast accuracy and pipeline coverage gaps.

  • Culture and Leadership: Define high performance in terms of both results and behaviours, create momentum while protecting trust and morale, and act on feedback about your own leadership style.

  • Collaboration and Alignment: Partner closely with Field Engineering, Marketing, Commercial, Product, and Delivery to ensure seamless customer alignment.

  • Ecosystem Expansion: Cultivate relationships and drive joint pipeline with key System Integrators, Cloud platform providers, and Consulting organisations.

  • In office collaboration: In-office collaboration is a core part of how we build and solve problems together, so there will be an expectation to be in the London office or on client site 2-3 days per week.

What you’ll bring

  • UK Public Sector Domain Expertise: Deep, practical knowledge of UK Central Government operational structures, procurement frameworks, and buying processes.

  • Established Networks: Genuine, active, and trusted relationships at senior levels within UK Central Government departments. Security and Defence connections are highly desirable.

  • Proven Player/Manager Track Record: Extensive experience as both an individual enterprise software sales contributor and a leader who has grown, motivated, and managed high-performing sales professionals.

  • Consultative Enterprise Selling: A strong background in complex, high-value solution selling to government stakeholders, such as AI, Big Data, Entity Resolution (connecting and resolving data to reveal relationships and risk), Fraud, or FinCrime solutions.

  • Pipeline Champion: A relentless drive to create and manage an active, multi-stage pipeline, using a storytelling-led approach.

  • Executive Presence: The credibility to challenge targets or decisions respectfully, and the discipline to commit fully once a decision is made.

  • Leadership Self-Awareness: You actively seek out feedback and act on it.

  • Security Clearance: You must either hold current SC clearance or be willing and able to achieve it.

  • Commercial Drive and Resilience: An entrepreneurial spirit with strong commercial and interpersonal skills, comfortable delivering results in complex, fast-paced environments.

Our perks and quirks

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits. We offer:

  • Competitive salary 💰 and performance-driven company bonus.

  • Flexible working hours in a hybrid workplace, with free access to global WeWork locations & events.

  • Pension Scheme with a company contribution of 6% (if you contribute 3%).

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option to buy up to 5 days) + birthday off!

  • Work from Anywhere Scheme: Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period.

  • Family Support: Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Private Healthcare, EAP, Well-being Days, Calm App, and Gym Discounts.

  • Socials: Team's Social Budget & Company-wide Summer & Winter Parties.

  • Tech & Cycle-to-Work Schemes + Volunteer Day off.

  • Dog-friendly Offices.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits 

About the Role 

This role is for a Senior Engineering Manager where you’ll be a manager of managers. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.

Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.

Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.

You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our Progression Framework.

Is this role right for you?

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: 

  • Delivery and Execution: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
  • Engineering and Operational Excellence: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
  • People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
  • Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
  • Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.
  • Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)

  2. Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).

The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:

- Team and Org Management (1 hour)An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

- System Design (1 hour)You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. 

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. 

What’s in it for you:

💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits 

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

  • 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

  • Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. 

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

At Cresta, the AI Agent team is on a mission to create state-of-the-art AI Agents that solve practical problems for our customers. We are focused on leveraging the latest technologies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent systems, while ensuring that the solutions we develop are cost-effective, secure, and reliable. 

As an AI Agent Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of deploying AI agents that address real-world challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers as well as our software and machine learning engineers, ensuring high-impact AI Agent deployments and contributing to the continuous improvement of our core AI platform. You’ll develop intelligent AI agents, integrate them seamlessly with external systems and offer hands-on technical expertise to ensure successful deployments.. This position requires strong engineering skills, adaptability, and customer engagement. If you are self-driven, analytical, and eager to leverage AI in practical applications, this role is for you.

  • System Integration: Build AI agent integrations with external systems (APIs, databases, CRMs, etc.) to ensure seamless workflow integration.

Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through real-world deployment learnings.

What We're Looking For:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience of full time working experience in software development/ consulting, AI/ML engineering, or system integration, or as FDE
  • Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python and Golang, with the ability to write clean, efficient code.
  • AI/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.
  • AI Agent Frameworks: Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Hands-on experience of building such a system is strongly preferred.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
  • Integration Expertise: Hands-on experience with integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and project management skills.

title: Senior FP&A Expert - Financial Task Design and Evaluation
descriptionHtml:
Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection.

We’re looking for experienced Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) professionals with strong financial modeling and analytical backgrounds to support an advanced AI evaluation project. You'll design realistic financial planning and business decision-making tasks, develop reference solutions, and evaluate AI-generated financial outputs for accuracy, completeness, and practical business relevance.

This is a remote, project-based contractor opportunity with flexible working hours.

Compensation: $400 USD per accepted task. Each task is estimated to take approximately 5–6 hours to complete, equivalent to an indicative hourly rate of $67–$80/hour. Actual earnings per hour will vary depending on the time spent completing each task. Compensation is based on successfully completed and accepted tasks, not on hours worked.

Tasks

What you'll be doing

  • Design realistic FP&A tasks and business scenarios that reflect complex, real-world financial planning, forecasting, and decision-making workflows

  • Develop financial models and reference solutions using Excel, including traceable formulas, documented assumptions, scenario analysis, and consistency checks

  • Create tasks involving core FP&A processes, such as annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, headcount planning, and investment decisions

  • Build and evaluate integrated financial analyses, incorporating income statements, balance sheets, cash flow forecasts, working capital, and liquidity considerations

  • Develop scenarios involving multiple sources of financial and business information, including spreadsheets, contracts, emails, and management presentations

  • Evaluate AI-generated financial models, analyses, and recommendations for technical accuracy, financial consistency, completeness, and sound business judgment

  • Identify material errors, unsupported assumptions, inconsistencies, and weaknesses in financial models or conclusions

  • Define clear evaluation criteria and acceptable outcomes, accounting for valid alternative financial approaches and reasonable assumptions

  • Write precise task instructions, reference answers, and concise executive-level explanations that accurately reflect the underlying financial analysis

  • Apply structured evaluation guidelines consistently, providing clear, evidence-based rationales for your assessments

The project focuses on developing and evaluating realistic financial tasks to assess how effectively advanced AI systems can perform complex FP&A workflows. Your role is to bring practical financial expertise to the design of challenging business scenarios and the evaluation of AI-generated outputs against professional standards.

Requirements

You're a strong candidate if you:

  • Have 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), corporate finance, finance business partnering, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated expertise

  • Have advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, including building, reviewing, and auditing complex financial models with transparent formulas and well-documented assumptions

  • Have hands-on experience owning or supporting financial planning processes, including operating budgets, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, headcount planning, and investment evaluations

  • Have a strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles, including the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, liquidity, and debt covenants

  • Are comfortable building scenario-based financial models, evaluating different business assumptions, and assessing their impact on financial performance

  • Can independently reconcile complex or conflicting financial information across spreadsheets, contracts, business documents, and management reports

  • Have strong analytical judgment and can identify material financial errors, flawed assumptions, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions

  • Can assess the quality and correctness of financial analyses, including recognizing valid alternative methodologies and defining clear acceptance criteria

  • Have excellent written English communication skills and can produce precise instructions, structured financial explanations, and concise executive memos

  • Have strong attention to detail and can consistently apply detailed evaluation guidelines while exercising independent professional judgment

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in software, technology, or SaaS businesses, including ARR, retention, gross margin analysis, and subscription-based financial planning

  • Experience with financial model auditing, quality assurance, or reviewing financial deliverables prepared by others

  • Previous exposure to AI evaluation, benchmark development, or designing structured analytical assessments

  • Experience presenting financial analyses and recommendations to senior management or executive stakeholders

Benefits and Compensation

  • $400 USD per accepted task, with an estimated completion time of 5–6 hours

  • Fully remote and flexible — work from anywhere

  • Part-time contractor role with flexible hours

  • Work on the evaluation of cutting-edge AI systems tackling complex financial and business decision-making tasks

Send us your CV along with a brief note about your FP&A background, financial modeling experience, and areas of expertise. Please highlight your experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and any relevant software or SaaS industry exposure.

If applicable, we'd also love to know about your experience building complex financial models, reviewing financial deliverables, or designing financial assessments and business cases.

We look forward to hearing from you!

  • Authorised faster payment fraud

Your day to day; 

Senior Fraud Investigators in our Prevent pillar support the quality of performance and knowledge across the pillar by answering escalations, supporting operational changes, and speaking to our customers who are at potential risk of the most complex scams. We’re looking for investigators with in-depth knowledge of cryptocurrency and understanding of how this can be used by fraudsters across a range of typologies as we continue to develop and optimise our controls. This means you can complete a complex investigation from start to finish for our customers and provide clear feedback to our teams as we work together to become the most trusted bank in the UK.

Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals, and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. We're hiring across multiple domains, so you'll own a real piece of the product and see your impact firsthand.

We're building an AI-native engineering culture where engineers take ownership of problems, not just implementation. We expect you to question assumptions, challenge decisions, contribute to product direction, and find better ways to solve customer problems.

You'll use AI throughout the development process to move faster without compromising quality. Your responsibility doesn't end when code reaches production. You'll care about whether what we built actually works, delivers value, and solves the problem we set out to address.

You Will

  • Own problems end to end, from discovery and design to production and iteration. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told.
  • Build, test, and maintain features across the stack, with clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
  • Build modern applications with React, TanStack Router, and modular-react on the frontend, and Node.js, Fastify, Drizzle on the backend.
  • Work in a Dockerized TypeScript environment with Vitest and Playwright for testing.
  • Partner with Product and Design to shape what we build, focusing on outcomes for customers rather than sheer output.
  • Champion AI-native engineering across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and help the team raise the bar on speed and quality.
  • Run what you build by taking part in the on-duty rotation for the services you're responsible for and leading the improvements that keep them reliable.
  • Mentor other engineers and champion engineering excellence.

You Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience building and maintaining production software, with strong hands-on experience in Node.js, TypeScript, and React, and the ability to work across different systems and technologies.
  • Strong full-stack fundamentals: modern frontend architecture (component design, state management, performance), API design, message queues (SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or similar), relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), and cloud (AWS or similar).
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar). You've developed effective ways of working with AI to move faster, solve complex problems, and deliver high-quality software.
  • A strong product engineering mindset. You build with the customer in mind and measure success by the impact you deliver, not the tasks you close.
  • A strong sense of ownership. You're self-driven, proactive, and accountable for results well beyond the merge.
  • Strong collaboration skills. You work effectively with engineers, Product, Design, and other stakeholders to solve problems together. You share knowledge, give and receive constructive feedback, challenge ideas respectfully, and help others succeed.
  • A track record of leading complex projects end to end, from technical design to production rollout.
  • Strong quality and testing habits (unit, integration, and beyond) that let you ship fast without breaking things.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication skills, attention to detail, and a genuine drive to keep learning in a fast-paced, remote setting.

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience working in an open-source community as a maintainer or a contributor.
  • Familiarity with the localization industry and software localization.

Our Benefits
