title: Senior Pricing Analyst
descriptionHtml:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

title: Senior/Principal DFT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and define the DFT architecture for a large AI accelerator SoC (scan, compression, MBIST, LBIST, boundary scan)

title: (Senior) Product Engineer – AI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Product Engineer verantwortest du Features von Anfang bis Ende: vom Gespräch mit Kunden über das Konzept bis zur Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung in Produktion.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Kunden und Markt verstehen. Du sprichst mit Nutzerinnen und Nutzern, begleitest Kundentermine und wertest Nutzungsdaten aus. So findest du heraus, wo MAIA im Arbeitsalltag am meisten helfen kann. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Produktmanagement und Customer Success zusammen.

  • Vom Problem zum Konzept. Du schreibst Konzepte, baust Prototypen, um Ideen schnell zu testen, und schneidest Features so, dass sie früh bei Nutzerinnen und Nutzern ankommen.

  • Umsetzen über den ganzen Stack. Du schreibst den Implementierungsplan, lässt Coding Agents umsetzen und verantwortest Architektur und Qualität, vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche.

  • KI, die man versteht. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen mit MAIA arbeiten: Fragen stellen, Kontext mitgeben, Agenten mehrstufige Aufgaben erledigen lassen und Ergebnisse nachvollziehen.

  • Messen und weiterentwickeln. Nach dem Release prüfst du, ob ein Feature genutzt wird und hilft, und entwickelst es anhand von Feedback, Nutzungsdaten und Evals weiter.

Was wir suchen

  • Solides Software Engineering. Du hast Produkte gebaut und in Produktion betrieben, mit denen Menschen täglich arbeiten, über Backend und Frontend hinweg. Schwache Architektur erkennst du auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Produkterfahrung. Du hast mit Kundinnen und Kunden gesprochen, Anforderungen hinterfragt und Features von der ersten Idee bis zur täglichen Nutzung begleitet. Du hörst genau hin und erkennst, welches Problem hinter einem Wunsch steckt.

  • Gespür für gute Bedienung. Du merkst, wenn eine Oberfläche Menschen überfordert, und baust lieber eine einfache Lösung, die verstanden wird, als eine mächtige, die niemand findet.

  • Zu Hause im LLM-Ökosystem. Du hast Anwendungen mit LLMs gebaut, beruflich oder in komplexen eigenen Projekten, und kennst ihre Eigenheiten: Antworten schwanken, brauchen Zeit, und Agenten scheitern an unerwarteten Stellen. Du baust Produkte, die damit ehrlich umgehen.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Ob ein Feature wirkt, prüfst du mit Nutzungsdaten, Feedback und Evals. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du schreibst Pläne, die andere prüfen und auf denen Coding Agents aufbauen können, prüfst die Ergebnisse kritisch und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Deine Konzepte versteht man beim ersten Lesen. Mit Kundinnen und Kunden redest du ebenso gern wie mit Engineers. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle umfasst keine Personalverantwortung. Ob du als Product Engineer oder Senior Product Engineer einsteigst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview offen mit dir.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 75.000 bis 95.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, hängt von deinem Level ab. Darüber sprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview, in dem es auch um Produktentscheidungen geht, und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)
descriptionHtml:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here.

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €105k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences. 

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

title: Senior Product Manager (Consumer App)
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value

    • Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

  • Design & Engineering Partnership:

    • Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts

    • Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided consumer products

  • Familiarity with habit loops and engagement design in a consumer app: push, onboarding, personalisation

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

  • Experience taking new products to market, including GTM planning and launch

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call (25 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (30 min)

  • Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.

Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.

You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. The exact scope depends on your profile and the team's needs. The role is technical: you need to discuss data structures, APIs, performance and configuration models as easily as user workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Own one or more platform components end to end. Depending on the team's needs, this can be the data model and how customer data maps into it, the computation engines, the configuration layer, configurable UI building blocks (tables, detail views, dashboards), the action library and write-back to customer systems, or platform services such as access control and notifications.

  • Treat internal teams as your customers. Understand what solution PMs, forward deployed engineers and the agent team need, and turn repeated requests into reusable components instead of one-off builds.

  • Make components configurable, not custom. Decide what is configured, at which level (common, solution, customer), and where custom code is still acceptable. Cut the time it takes to deliver a new use case.

  • Design for agents as well as people. Give components clear interfaces so workflows and AI agents can call them as tools, with audit, limits and approvals.

  • Hold the bar on scale, reliability and trust. Enterprise data volumes, near real-time updates, on-prem and sovereign deployments, security reviews. Performance, correctness and explainability are product requirements.

  • Stay close to customers. Spend time with users and deployment teams at strategic accounts to see where the platform helps them and where it gets in the way.

  • Keep the platform coherent. Work with the other platform PMs and with design on shared vocabulary, data contracts and dependencies, so components fit together.

  • Run the roadmap. Write specs, set priorities with the tech lead, ship on the release train, and measure how other teams adopt your components and what it changes for customers.

About You

  • Product management: 5+ years as a PM in B2B software, including time owning a platform, infrastructure or developer-facing product used by other teams.

  • Technical fluency: comfortable with data models, APIs, configuration systems and performance trade-offs. You can read a technical design, challenge it and write acceptance criteria engineers can test.

  • Platform judgment: you know when to generalize and when not to, and you can turn down a one-off request while keeping the requester on your side.

  • Data rigor: you can query data, trace an odd output back to its source and size the impact of a change across customers.

  • Enterprise B2B experience: you know what large customers require on security, deployment and change management.

  • Domain curiosity: interest in manufacturing, supply chain or industrial operations, and the will to learn how a plant runs.

  • Cross-functional leadership: you lead engineers, designers and other PMs through decisions without formal authority.

  • Clear writing: specs, decision memos and release notes that engineers, customers and executives understand.

  • Education: a degree in engineering, computer science or a related field.

  • Experience with AI agents, LLM tool use or human-in-the-loop workflows

Nice to have

  • Experience on a platform whose components other teams combine: low-code or configuration platforms, data platforms, workflow engines, developer tools

  • Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, ERP or planning software

  • Background in data modeling, ontologies or large-scale data processing

  • Experience with on-prem or sovereign deployments at enterprise customers

  • Aerospace, defense or industrial customers

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

  • Meal allowance: €10/day worked, 50% covered via Swile

  • Transport: 50% public transit coverage or equivalent sustainable mobility package

  • ClassPass partnership — fitness, wellness, and wellbeing at a discount

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

title: Senior Product Manager, Retail
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions.

Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us define and build purpose-built, highly differentiated shopping experiences across our growing portfolio of Retail categories.


What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Retail Categories team. Retail only wins category by category; a single, generic shopping experience cannot do justice to the unique ways people buy apparel, auto parts, or home improvement goods. This role owns the end-to-end category shopping experience for a defined portfolio, transforming broad customer promises into shipped surfaces and distinct emotional hooks that drive habitual buying behavior.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define Category Strategy: Formulate the category experience strategy and decide which categories and bets to invest in first, sequencing for maximum growth and impact.

  • Execute Signature Product Bets: Translate each category's promise into concrete, testable product bets—such as personal-shopper features using doorstep returns for Apparel or fitment-accurate part lookup for Auto Parts—and ship them end to end.

  • Optimise Category Surfaces: Own the category merchandising and storefront surfaces that differentiate one vertical from another while maintaining a cohesive and intuitive Retail experience.

  • Leverage Platform Capabilities: Partner with shared platform infrastructure (such as doorstep returns or fulfillment) to build bespoke category experiences without rebuilding core infrastructure.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply with BD, Sales, Catalog, and Search teams to ensure category surfaces are powered by accurate data and align cleanly with merchant relationships.

  • Measure Impact: Use data, customer insight, and experimentation to prioritise initiatives, define success metrics, and directly move the needle on conversion and repeat purchases.


What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Proven Consumer Product Experience: Demonstrated success in product management on consumer-facing products, ideally within e-commerce, marketplaces, or multi-sided platforms.

  • Track Record of 0-to-1 Innovation: Proven ability to ship brand-new or highly differentiated shopping experiences, navigating ambiguity to break broad opportunities into focused, testable bets.

  • Strong Analytical Capabilities: Comfort driving data-informed prioritisation, establishing robust success metrics, and utilising experimentation to measure category-level impact.

  • Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Experience partnering closely with cross-functional product teams (Engineering, Design, Analytics) as well as commercial teams like BD and Sales to align business needs with product strategy.

  • Customer-Obsessed Product Instinct: A natural intuition for customer behaviour, understanding what makes a shopping experience feel right and how to design the emotional hook that drives retention.

Nice to Have

  • Specialised Retail Domain Knowledge: Prior experience working with merchandising, category management, product detail pages (PDP), or specialised shopping flows.

  • Data Structure Familiarity: Experience working alongside Catalog or Search product areas to power front-end surfaces with complex item data.


Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

    Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

    Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

    High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Senior Quality & Knowledge Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

As Quandela delivers quantum computers to industrial, public and sovereign customers, structured quality processes and well-governed knowledge have become strategic. We are creating a Quality & Knowledge Specialist role to help build these foundations.

Reporting to the COO, you will work on two complementary topics. First, you will help design and deploy the processes and methodology needed to achieve our target certifications. Second, you will structure, organize and bring to life the company's knowledge, so that information is reliable, easy to find, and securely shared. You will work with all teams: R&D, engineering, manufacturing, software, operations, business functions...

Your Key Responsibilities

Quality management & certification

  • Contribute to building and deploying the quality management framework required for certification (ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001 or equivalent frameworks)
  • Map, formalize and document key processes with the teams, and help make them practical and adopted
  • Drive the certification project with your manager: gap analysis, action plan follow-up, internal audits, and preparation of external audits
  • Monitor quality KPIs, non-conformities and corrective actions, and contribute to continuous improvement

Knowledge management

  • Help define and implement the knowledge management approach: information architecture, taxonomy, naming conventions and documentation standard
  • Structure and organize data and documentation across teams so that knowledge is reliable, up to date and easy to find
  • Animate the knowledge community: train and support teams, share good practices and encourage knowledge sharing

Tools & access governance

  • Administer the knowledge and documentation tools (e.g. Confluence, Notion, SharePoint), and benchmark new solutions when relevant
  • Implement and maintain access rights governance: roles, permissions and regular reviews, in line with security and confidentiality requirements
  • Work with IT and Security teams to ensure tools and practices meet certification and customer requirements

Requirements

  • Master's degree in engineering, quality management, information management or equivalent
  • 5 + years of experience in quality management, process improvement or knowledge management
  • Hands-on involvement in at least one certification project (ISO 9001, ISO 27001 or similar)
  • Good knowledge of ISO standards and quality management systems
  • Process mapping and documentation skills
  • Hands-on experience with collaborative or knowledge management tools (Confluence, Sharepoint...)
  • Structured and rigorous, with a pragmatic approach: processes must help teams, not slow them down
  • Strong pedagogy and ability to work with scientific and technical profiles
  • Autonomous and proactive, eager to take on ownership in a fast-growing scale-up

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a talented Senior Sales Engineer to join our Commercial sales team. As a Commercial Sales Engineer, you will work closely with our sales team to understand our Commercial customers’ complex business needs and showcase how Fivetran’s data replication solutions can help them achieve their desired business outcomes. You will be responsible for providing technical expertise, identifying technical requirements, and ensuring a successful proof-of value throughout the sales cycle.

This is a full-time position based out of our Dublin office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You’ll Use

descriptionHtml:

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und gute technische Ausstattung.

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte und Vergünstigungen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Vertragsabschlüsse erzielen: Du erklärst Angebote verständlich, beantwortest Fragen und führst Interessierte verbindlich bis zum Abschluss.

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You've successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

title: Senior SecOps Team Lead
descriptionHtml:

Equativ is building its ISMS toward ISO 27001 certification target by the end of 2027. The SecOps team secures that platform and works with every team across Equativ.


The role

You manage the SecOps team and own the day-to-day security operations of a full-cloud company. You build the team, grow its people and deliver the SecOps roadmap, which you define with the IT & Security lead.

You stay close to the technology: roughly 30% of your time is spent on people management and stakeholders, 70% on technical leadership and hands-on work during incidents and key projects.


Responsibilities

People and team

  • Manage the SecOps engineers: 1:1s, objectives, annual reviews, CPF level assessments and career growth.

    • Security operations

Nice to have

  • Experience in ad tech or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive platforms.

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits from the operations side.

  • Identity and endpoint stack: Okta, Google Workspace, CrowdStrike.

  • Certifications: GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, GCIH.

title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds. 

We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. You own our secure access and network security controls, our endpoint and identity security stack, and our detection content, and you operate them yourself rather than directing from the sidelines. You wear two hats: the Builder who implements and runs the controls that keep us safe, and the Adversary who keeps testing whether those controls and detections actually fire. 

This is a senior engineering role with the spirit of an architect. You are expected to design what you operate, not just configure it: pick the pattern, write it down, and make it hold at fleet scale. A versatile engineer with real depth, comfortable switching from a firewall rule set to a detection query to a directory hardening sprint in the same week, and a technical anchor others lean on. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission 

SASE and Network Security 

  • Own and operate our SASE platform, including revamping Internet Security policies and redefining Private Access policies. 
  • Drive firewall security with the network team: own network security engineering and segmentation strategy, analyze rule sets, identify gaps, and see remediation through together with network engineering, who own the devices. 
  • Coordinate firewall-adjacent controls: IPS, AV, sandboxing and DDoS protection. 
  • Manage our DNS security and WAF solutions, including our edge and CDN-based protection services. 

Security Posture and Hardening 

  • Apply CIS Benchmarks to raise posture across firewalls, endpoints, our cloud identity platform and our cloud productivity suite. 
  • Lead the clean-up and hardening of our on-premises and cloud identity directories together with the infrastructure team, then keep both hardened on an ongoing basis. 
  • Drive our phishing-resistant MFA and privileged access programme, including just-in-time elevation and the remediation of the attack paths we find. 
  • Own certificate lifecycle and PKI operations: key ceremonies, automated renewal, and input to our post-quantum migration plan. 

Detection and Visibility 

  • Manage and tune our IPS/IDS platforms; write and maintain custom IDS signatures, and operate network sensors for NTA appliances. 
  • Build and maintain detections in our SIEM and apply MITRE ATT&CK to detection engineering and use-case design in support of the SOC. 
  • Extend visibility into OT with purpose-built OT monitoring tooling. 
  • Act as an L3 incident responder for escalated security events, and turn every finding into a fix, a new detection or a hardened configuration. 

Security Stack and Automation 

  • Own our endpoint detection and response, data protection and CASB platforms as their technical owner. 
  • Script and build internal tooling in PowerShell and Python, so controls and checks run themselves. 

Design and Engineering Partnership 

  • Design what you operate: run threat modeling and attack-path analysis on the systems you own, choose the pattern, and document standards others can execute against. 
  • Evaluate tooling and support vendor selection and renewal decisions in your domain, with a clear view of what each control costs us and what it buys. 
  • Embed security with engineering: partner with IT, infrastructure, manufacturing and mission teams to implement and validate controls in their environments across both IT and OT, respecting launch-window and change-freeze constraints and producing the evidence our audits depend on. 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Experience: 10+ years in security engineering, with real ownership of production security tooling, not policy or advisory work. 
  • Architect Spirit: you can step back from the console, design the target state, write the pattern down, and then go build it yourself. 
  • SASE: hands-on experience administering an enterprise SASE platform end to end, not just consuming it. 
  • Hardening: experience applying CIS Benchmarks to firewalls, endpoints, cloud identity and cloud productivity platforms in production, plus experience rolling out phishing-resistant MFA or privileged access management. 
  • Networking and Firewalls: solid fundamentals, enough to own segmentation strategy and to drive rule set analysis and gap remediation with a network team that owns the devices. Experience with CDN-based WAF and edge protection services. 
  • Security Stack Depth: strong background across endpoint detection and response, data protection, SIEM and detection query languages, cloud identity and on-premises directory hardening, certificate lifecycle and PKI operations, ideally including a large-scale directory clean-up or remediation effort. 
  • Detection Engineering: practical MITRE ATT&CK-driven detection work, and experience writing custom IDS/IPS signatures. 
  • Operational Depth: strong capability in detection, incident response and vulnerability management, with time spent on escalated incidents. 
  • Automation: scripting ability in PowerShell and Python, plus infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code experience. 
  • IT and OT: comfortable working across both. Working knowledge of OT protocols such as EtherNet/IP, OPC UA and Modbus, and familiarity with OT network monitoring, is a strong plus. 
  • Autonomy: operates with very high autonomy as an internal expert, taking full ownership of their work and guiding others. 
  • Mentoring: mentors engineers and analysts on the team, and acts as technical lead in cross-functional projects. 
  • Communication: clear communication and collaboration skills, able to translate technical risk for a range of audiences and to work controls through other teams. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or the equivalent through relevant certifications and hands-on experience. 

Bonus Skills 

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, energy, manufacturing or other OT-heavy, safety-critical environments. 
  • Prior SOC or incident response team experience. 
  • Cloud security depth in a major public cloud and its native security services. 
  • Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST. 
  • Relevant certifications, defensive or engineering (e.g., Security+, GCIA) and offensive (e.g., OSCP or equivalent), are both valued. 

What We Offer 

  • Real Ownership: the security tooling that protects a premier European space company is yours to run, rebuild and prove. 
  • Impact: the opportunity to directly protect the future of spaceflight as we approach our first orbital launch. 
  • Collaboration: work hand-in-hand with brilliant engineers and IT professionals on genuinely hard problems. 

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 6 weeks of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Relocation support: Benefit from our relocation bonus with deductible expenses up to an agreed amount
  • Wellness allowance: Stay healthy and fit with our yearly allowance for wellness activities (e.g., Gym, Massages)
  • Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period
  • Physical and mental well-being: Access via OpenUp the online support from certified psychologists and lifestyle experts at no cost to you and your family
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.  

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

Want to find out more about us?

Visit www.isaraerospace.com

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you will do

descriptionHtml:

Token Factory is a part of  Nebius Cloud, one of the world’s largest GPU clouds, running tens of thousands of GPUs. We are building an inference platform that makes every kind of foundation model — text, vision, audio, and emerging multimodal architectures — fast, reliable, and effortless to deploy at massive scale. To deliver on that promise, we need an engineer who can make the platform behave flawlessly under extreme load and recover gracefully when the unexpected happens.

In this role you will own the reliability, performance, and observability of the entire inference stack. Your day starts with designing and refining telemetry pipelines — metrics, logs, and traces that turn hundreds of terabytes of signal into clear, actionable insight. From there you might tune Kubernetes autoscalers to squeeze more efficiency out of GPUs, craft Terraform modules that bake resilience into every new cluster, or harden our request-routing and retry logic so even transient failures go unnoticed by users. When incidents do arise, you’ll rely on the automation and runbooks you helped create to detect, isolate, and remediate problems in minutes, then drive the post-mortem culture that prevents recurrence. All of this effort points toward a single goal: scaling the platform smoothly while hitting aggressive cost and reliability targets.

Success in the role calls for deep fluency with Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Terraform, and the craft of infrastructure-as-code. You script comfortably in Python or Bash, understand the nuances of alert design and SLOs for high-throughput APIs, and have spent enough time in production to know how distributed back-ends fail in the real world. Experience shepherding GPU-heavy workloads — whether with vLLM, Triton, Ray, or another accelerator stack — will serve you well, as will a background in MLOps or model-hosting platforms. Above all, you care about building self-healing systems, thrive on debugging performance from kernel to application layer, and enjoy collaborating with software engineers to turn reliability into a feature users never have to think about.

title: Senior Social Commerce Manager
descriptionHtml:
About THG Ingenuity 

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: 

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. 
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.  
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel 

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. 

 About the Role 

The Senior Social Commerce Manager is a senior, client-facing role within THG Ingenuity’s Partnership Marketing team, responsible for the strategy and delivery of TikTok Shop across our client portfolio. 

Reporting into the Head of Partnership Marketing, you’ll own what we recommend to our TikTok Shop clients and make sure we deliver it brilliantly - setting the strategy for each account, monitoring performance and driving it forward, building strong client relationships, and holding a high bar on the quality of every service we deliver. 

This is a role for someone who combines deep TikTok Shop expertise with commercial judgement and confident client management. You’ll be the senior point of contact for your clients, the person the delivery team looks to for direction, and a key partner to the Head of Partnership Marketing in growing our Social Commerce offering. 

Reporting Line & Team Structure 

  • Reports into: Head of Partnership Marketing. 
  • Team leadership: Social Commerce Executives within the Partnership Marketing team, with day-to-day leadership of TikTok Shop delivery across your client accounts. 
  • Key internal relationships: Ecommerce, Customer Success, Creative, Studios, Content, Paid Social, Trading and Operations teams. 
  • Key external relationships: Client brand, ecommerce and marketing teams, TikTok platform partners, and creator and affiliate partners. 

Key Responsibilities 

TikTok Shop Strategy 

  • Own the TikTok Shop strategy for each client account - setting clear objectives, growth plans and trading priorities aligned to the client’s wider commercial goals. 
  • Build and present strategic plans covering shop set-up, product and catalogue strategy, pricing and promotions, content, live shopping, creator and affiliate activity, and paid amplification. 
  • Align TikTok Shop activity with each client’s trading calendar, key retail moments and wider THG Ingenuity services to maximise commercial impact. 
  • Translate platform updates, new formats and social commerce trends into clear, actionable recommendations for clients. 

Delivery & Service Quality 

  • Take accountability for the end-to-end delivery of TikTok Shop services across your clients, ensuring work is delivered on time, on brief and to a consistently high standard. 
  • Direct and support the Social Commerce Executives and wider delivery teams day to day - prioritising workload, reviewing outputs and stepping in early where delivery starts to drift. 
  • Establish and maintain best-practice frameworks, processes and playbooks for TikTok Shop set-up, optimisation and campaign delivery. 
  • Set quality standards and QA processes across listings, content, creator activity and reporting, so every client receives the same high level of service. 
  • Coordinate effectively with creative, content, studio, paid social, ecommerce and operations teams so TikTok Shop activity is joined up and commercially aligned. 

Performance Monitoring & Optimisation 

  • Monitor TikTok Shop performance across your client portfolio, tracking GMV, conversion rate, AOV, traffic, content and creator performance, and return on spend. 
  • Own performance against agreed client KPIs and targets - identifying risks and opportunities early and leading the optimisation plan to close any gaps. 
  • Turn data into insight, delivering clear, commercially focused reporting and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. 
  • Use testing and learning to continuously improve shop performance, content effectiveness and creator ROI. 

Client Relationships 

  • Act as the senior day-to-day contact for your TikTok Shop clients, building trusted, long-term relationships at senior and working levels. 
  • Lead regular client meetings, performance reviews and QBRs, presenting results, insight and forward plans with confidence. 
  • Manage client expectations, feedback and escalations professionally, resolving issues quickly and protecting the relationship. 
  • Drive client satisfaction and retention, and identify opportunities to grow accounts - from expanded TikTok Shop scope into wider THG Ingenuity services - working with Customer Success and Business Development. 

Team & Business Development 

  • Coach and develop Social Commerce Executives, sharing expertise and building capability across the team. 
  • Support the Head of Partnership Marketing in shaping the TikTok Shop and Social Commerce proposition, including pitches, case studies, new client onboarding and process improvement. 
  • Contribute platform and client insight to THG Ingenuity’s TikTok partnership, and share knowledge across the wider business. 

What We’re Looking For 

  • Proven experience managing TikTok Shop at a senior level, ideally across multiple brands or client accounts in an agency, ecommerce or brand-side environment. 
  • A track record of setting social commerce strategy and delivering measurable commercial growth (GMV, conversion, ROI). 
  • Strong client management experience - confident building senior relationships, presenting strategy and performance, and handling challenging conversations. 
  • Deep understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem, including Seller Center, affiliate and creator programmes, shoppable content, LIVE shopping and GMV Max / paid amplification. 
  • Highly data-literate, with the ability to analyse performance, draw out insight and turn it into clear actions. 
  • Experience leading or mentoring others, and directing cross-functional teams to deliver to a high standard. 
  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple clients and priorities at pace. 
  • Commercially minded, proactive and solutions-focused, with a genuine passion for social commerce and creator culture.
