title: Social & Community Director, Esquire
descriptionHtml:
We are the UK's leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men's & Women's Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper's Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don't just create content – we shape culture.

Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that's brought us here. We believe in each other's potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people's lives.

We're proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history.

Hearst UK operates an in-office policy with flexible Fridays. Our office is based at House of Hearst, 30 Panton Street, St James's, London, SW1Y 4AJ, where teams collaborate in person and connect across brands and functions.

Salary – £50,000–£60,000
Salary is dependent on experience and will be assessed in line with the candidate's skills, knowledge and relevant expertise.

The Role...

As Social & Community Director, you will own the success and growth of Esquire’s social platforms, with a particular focus on Instagram and TikTok. You will set the social strategy and editorial direction, translating Esquire’s wider editorial priorities into distinctive, high-performing, platform-native content that grows, engages and builds a lasting relationship with its audience.

Working closely with editors, contributors and creative talent, you will bring Esquire’s editorial pillars to life across social, developing compelling formats and franchises that give audiences a reason to return. You will also play a key role in growing the commercial value of Esquire’s social channels, strengthening their place within the wider brand ecosystem.

This is a highly visible editorial role. You will be a host and voice for Esquire, fronting social formats and video content and representing the brand with audiences, partners and at key cultural, brand and membership events.

You will also help shape and grow Esquire’s new membership communities, hosting events, contributing to newsletters and working closely with the audience team to engage, nurture and build an active and connected community.

Main Duties...

  • Set Esquire’s social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, in line with the brand and wider editorial plans. Define clear audience priorities, content pillars and measures of success, adapting the approach as platforms, behaviours and audience habits evolve.
  • Grow Esquire’s following and engagement in ways that build meaningful, lasting audience relationships. Use analytics, social listening and audience feedback to understand what is working, decide what to make next and continually improve performance.
  • Develop distinctive social formats and franchises that give audiences a reason to return, including video fronted by Esquire’s editorial team. Host and present interviews, cultural coverage and original content, while helping other Esquire talent develop a natural and engaging voice on camera.
  • Work closely with editors, writers, photographers, filmmakers, producers and contributors to commission and deliver distinctive, platform-native work. Set clear creative briefs and maintain high editorial and visual standards.
  • Be hands-on in the filming and editing of social video content created by the editorial team, overseeing production and helping to develop regular, recognisable social franchises.
  • Work closely with the commercial team to turn Esquire’s social reach, influence and expertise into valuable commercial opportunities. Develop partnership ideas that feel right for the brand and its audience, and contribute to pitches and presentations.
  • Make Esquire’s social channels a valuable part of the wider brand ecosystem, strengthening the connections between social, editorial, partnerships, events and membership and increasing the commercial value of the channels.
  • Work across editorial, digital and commercial teams to coordinate coverage, maximise major cultural and brand moments and ensure social is embedded within Esquire’s wider plans.
  • Conceive, host and support events that bring Esquire’s audience together. Work with editorial and commercial colleagues to shape the right experiences, host or moderate conversations and extend their value through social coverage.
  • Represent Esquire at selected partner, industry and audience events, acting as a highly visible ambassador for the brand and protecting the trust audiences place in Esquire by upholding its editorial and brand standards.
  • Set direction and priorities for colleagues and contributors working across social. Coach on-camera talent, build a strong and reliable network of contributors and work with the hubbed Social Media Executive to support Facebook targets.
  • Oversee social publishing, including captions, accessibility, permissions and rights. Manage time, production resources and delegated budgets against agreed priorities, escalating significant financial, legal, reputational or brand issues early.

What We Are Looking For...

Essential

  • Significant proven experience setting and delivering social strategy, with a strong track record of growing audiences, increasing engagement and improving performance.
  • Expert knowledge of Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, including how platform behaviour and audience habits evolve, with strong experience using analytics and insight to shape content and community strategy.
  • Proven experience creating social content for luxury, lifestyle or media brands, with experience working with luxury brands on commercial activity.
  • Strong editorial judgement and a natural instinct for turning culture, fashion, film, music, art and the wider cultural conversation into distinctive, engaging social content.
  • Experience developing social-first formats and franchises, with the ability to identify what audiences want and turn ideas into high-performing content.
  • The confidence and ability to lead work across multiple teams, set clear creative and editorial standards, influence senior stakeholders and help on-camera contributors develop their confidence and skills.
  • Proven experience developing commercial partnership ideas and growing the commercial value of social channels, while protecting editorial independence, audience trust and clear disclosure.
  • Experience directing social-first production and working closely with editorial, video and creative teams.
  • Confidence and credibility as a presenter, with experience hosting interviews, video formats, live conversations or other audience-facing content.
  • Excellent writing, communication and presentation skills, with strong judgement when handling sensitive editorial, audience or reputational issues.

Desirable

  • Filming and editing skills, including Adobe Premiere Pro.

Benefits

Your benefits at Hearst UK are more than just extras – they are tools to help you thrive in every part of life.

Hearst Exclusives – Only for You!

  • Get adventurous with Good Housekeeping Taste and Beauty Testing Panels – yes, you could be trying the next big thing in beauty, food and drink.
  • Snag luxe beauty steals at our legendary office sample sales – score big on top brands without breaking the bank!

Inclusion, Health & Wellbeing – Feel Your Best

  • Stay healthy with Specsavers eye care, a company-funded Health Cash Plan and access to mental health support.
  • Get active and stress-free with discounted gym memberships and the Cycle to Work scheme.
  • Embrace flexibility with Location Flex and Holiday Exchange to take time when you need it.
  • Take time to give back with a Charity Day and access wellbeing resources whenever you need them.
  • Join one of our Hearst ERG groups.

Financial Wellness – Boost Your Budget

  • Plan ahead with a generous Workplace Pension, Income Protection, Life Assurance and Season Ticket Loan for easier commuting.
  • Make smarter money moves using Salary Finance tools, Financial Wellbeing sessions and Home Tech benefits to spread costs.
  • Treat yourself with major discounts across London plus everyday savings via the HAPI at Hearst app.

Inclusion & Belonging

Hearst UK is deeply committed to using our influential brands to reflect the world we want to live in – one that respects, protects, represents and uplifts the voices and opinions of all people. As a business, we recognise the significant benefits of creativity, collaboration and innovation that come with diverse teams. Not only is diversifying the voices in our organisation the right thing to do, but it also helps us create powerful and exciting content that can be enjoyed by many more people. This is why we're working to build a sense of true belonging within our business and foster a culture in which everyone feels heard.

title: Software Engineer, Agent (New Grad 2027)
descriptionHtml:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

  • Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

  • Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups in Silicon Valley, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

  • Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

Example projects

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

  • Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn

  • Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalizing product recommendations

  • Create generalizable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog!

  • Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

  • Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

  • A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

  • Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems

  • Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

  • Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

  • Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

  • Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at massive scale. The Roku TV organization builds technology used on millions of TVs globally, and the team is already applying AI to demanding TV problems in resource-constrained environments where quality, performance, and reliability matter.
As part of this team, you will help define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated for Roku TV use cases. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who treats AI agent design as an engineering discipline: architecting durable systems, grounding them in the right context, integrating them with tools and services, and making them reliable in production.

What is the role?

We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented Agentic AI Engineer of roughl7 2-5yrs experience to design, build, and maintain intelligent agents and copilots that drive automation, accelerate workflows, and unlock new product and platform capabilities for Roku TV. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development—from prototyping and architecture through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.
You will contribute directly to Roku’s AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring strong real-world performance in production environments.

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.
  • Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.
  • Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.
  • Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.
  • Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.
  • Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.
  • Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.
  • Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.
  • Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.
  • Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.

What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku? 

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.
  • Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.
  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.

Nice to have

  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.
  • Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.
#LI-NM1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

title: Software Engineer - Database
descriptionHtml:
About MotherDuck

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do

The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.

  • Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.

  • Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.

  • Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.

  • Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.

  • Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most.

  • Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems.

  • Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team.

  • Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next.

What you bring

  • You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like.

  • You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.)

  • A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques.

  • Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at.

  • You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems.

  • You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies.

  • You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs.

  • You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment.

  • You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs.

What we provide

  • The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases.

  • Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.

  • Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.

  • A good pension plan

  • Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong.

  • Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. We have to warn you though, most of us like the office so much we come anyway. It’s on the river Ij, with a great lunch every day.



Please Apply

Does this role sound appealing to you, but you’re missing some of the requirements or don’t quite think you’re qualified?  Please apply anyway. Research has shown that underrepresented groups in technology often shy away from roles which aren’t a 100% match. We aim to build a diverse team and will strongly consider applicants who bring many of the requirements plus have other experiences which round out their qualifications.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: Solution Architect Microsoft Dynamics
descriptionHtml:
Rol introductie

Jij hebt het! Dat waar wij niet zonder kunnen en onze klanten beter van worden. Jij bent in staat om in wisselende projectteams het beste uit elk team te halen en onmogelijke problemen om te zetten in mogelijkheden.


Als Solution Architect ben je functioneel verantwoordelijk voor een optimale implementatie van de integrale Dynamics 365 oplossing. Je bent het inhoudelijke geweten van de Project Manager en sparringpartner voor het management van onze klant. De best practices die wij en Microsoft hebben opgebouwd laat je hierbij leidend zijn. Op basis hiervan ben je voorstellend en adviserend naar je klanten. Daarnaast weet je de bedachte applicatie landschap ook overtuigend te presenteren aan de klant.

Wat ga je doen?

Je stelt de roadmap op om de integrale oplossing te implementeren. Je kunt denken vanuit integrale processen waarbij meerdere Microsoft oplossingen betrokken zijn:

  • Vaak ben je ook betrokken en ook verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie /implementatie van de oplossing;
  • Daarnaast geef je input voor de doorontwikkeling van branche oplossingen van HSO;
  • Je signaleert proactief optimalisatiemogelijkheden en adviseer je klanten over nieuwe functies en diensten binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem die hun bedrijfsresultaten verbeteren;
  • Vaak ben je ook betrokken en ook verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie /implementatie van de oplossing;
  • Je bent de spin in het web tussen klant, je technische en functionele collega’s en de project managers.

Over het team

Je bent onderdeel van de Service Line Unified Operations, een onderdeel van HSO Nederland. Unified Operations is een geoliede projectservices organisatie met een uitstekende reputatie op het gebied van ERP. Samen met de andere Servicelines binnen HSO kunnen we de complete Microsoft Stack aanbieden (Modern Workplace, Analytics, CE, Azure Integrations,  e.d.). Het totale team van onze Service Line bestaat momenteel uit ruim 80 professionals, onder leiding van de Service Line Director Roy Daniels.

Kwalificaties

  • Je hebt een HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur afgestudeerd) in bedrijfskunde, informatica, engineering (Industrial of logistics), supply chain management of een vergelijkbare opleiding;
  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het ontwerpen van applicatie landschappen over verschillende functionele domeinen;
  • Je hebt liefst affiniteit en ervaring met het inhoudelijk aansturen van een team AX/D365 professionals;
  • Je hebt minimaal 6 jaar implementatie en consultancy ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics AX tot aan de laatste D365 versie;
  • Jarenlange ervaring opgedaan in 1 of 2 van de branches Retail, Distribution, Project/Services of Manufacturing. Mede op basis hiervan kun jij klanten overtuigen van onze adviezen en voorstellen. Methodologische affiniteit. Zowel op het gebied van het architectuur (TOGAF kennis) als project implementatie.

Wat bieden we jou?    

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; 
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   

Waarom HSO   

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  
  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.  

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden.

Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands.   • Support technical customer discussions with data, demonstrations and practical insight.
  • Explain how device-level capabilities, limitations and trade-offs affect the wider system.

  • Experience with PCB design, schematic capture or rapid prototyping.
  • Experience using some common laboratory equipment, such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, signal generators or power-measurement tools.
  • Ability to collect, interpret and explain technical data clearly, in writing and in conversation.

  • Ability to take a structured approach to open-ended problems and decide what to investigate next.

  • Experience programming embedded systems and/or FPGAs, including developing, debugging, and integrating hardware–software solutions.
  • Breaking complex problems into clear, actionable questions.

You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic.

  • Execute End-of-Line (EoL) software validation and functional testing to ensure production readiness and reliability
  • Conduct payload and camera load-seat testing, validating integration stability and operational performance under real-world conditions
  • Troubleshoot embedded system issues spanning firmware, communication interfaces, sensors, and hardware-software interactions
  • Work independently to diagnose integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating closely with engineering and manufacturing teams

  • Interface with external vendors and equipment providers to support testing infrastructure, hardware integration, and operational readiness

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. in Aviation Technology, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or related field (M.Sc. optional)

title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning.

  • Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

  • Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval)

  • Lead experimentation on modern retrieval approaches (embedding research, sparse and hybrid retrieval, reranking, context compression) and bring them into production

  • Develop methods for grounding LLMs in real-time web data at scale, using trust, quality and freshness signals to surface reliable sources

  • Partner with the evaluation team to define new metrics for agentic systems, where correctness is not reducible to clicks

  • Analyze trade-offs across relevance, latency, and cost, and work closely with engineering to deploy systems that operate at web scale

  • Mentor researchers and engineers and help raise the technical bar of the team

Must haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in applied AI, ML, or software engineering

  • Proven track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production at scale

  • Deep experience with search, retrieval, ranking or building RAG-based assistants

  • Strong understanding of modern deep learning, especially transformers and embeddings

  • Experience with LLM-integrated or knowledge-intensive systems

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks and metrics for ML systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python

  • Top-tier publications (ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, ACL)

  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, product-driven environment with high ownership and autonomy

Nice to haves

  • Background in agentic AI systems (agents, tool use, autonomous workflows)

  • Experience with RL post-training of LLMs or VLMs

title: Staff Pricing Analyst, B2B
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

Sales Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

  • What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

  • Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

  • The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Pricing Analyst, B2B at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

  • Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Staff Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days)

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

  • Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

  • Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

  • Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

  • Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

  • Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

  • Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

  • Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

  • Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

  • Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

  • Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

The Role

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

  • Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons un stagiaire développeur logciel (F/H) pour une durée de 6 mois à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 au sein de la division Land & Sea sur le site d’Angoulême.

Missions :

Nous développons un logiciel superviseur en C++/Qt permettant le contrôle à distance de différents équipements. Dans le cadre de l'amélioration de notre environnement de développement, nous souhaitons automatiser et accélérer la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités.

L'objectif du stage sera de concevoir et de développer un outil permettant de générer automatiquement du code à partir d'interfaces graphiques préalablement conçues avec Qt Designer.

  • Concevoir et développer un outil capable de générer automatiquement :

    • Les classes associées à la partie graphique du logiciel superviseur.

    • Les classes d'interface assurant la communication entre la partie graphique et le cœur du logiciel.

    • Les classes d'implémentation de ces interfaces dans le cœur du logiciel.

  • Tester et valider la solution développée, puis évaluer son intégration dans l'environnement de développement existant.

Le stagiaire disposera également d'une certaine liberté dans ses propositions techniques et pourra explorer d'autres approches permettant d'atteindre cet objectif.

title: Stage Master 2 : Elaboration de panneaux biosourcés à base de pailles
descriptionHtml:
L'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants.

Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr

Contexte :

Le stage à pourvoir s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet européen Best-Crop impliquant 18 partenaires à l’échelle européenne : https://www.bestcrop.eu/ dont le but est de contribuer à développer l’économie circulaire en offrant de nouvelles variétés d’orge à rendement amélioré (article de perspective – projet Best-Crop). ). L’un des volets du projet consiste à fournir des pailles d’orge de composition et/ou structure optimisées pour différentes applications, dont, entre autres, le secteur de la construction (fabrication de panneaux de particules et de biocomposites).

Dans le cadre de ce projet, l’équipe PCH a pour tâche d’étudier l’influence de la sélection et du fractionnement des pailles issues de différentes variétés d’orge, ainsi que d’étudier la microstructure et le comportement mécanique de panneaux biosourcés élaborés par pressage à chaud.

Objectifs :

Le stage consiste à mettre en œuvre des panneaux de pailles, d’optimiser le procédé de fabrication, et d’évaluer la variabilité des comportements mécaniques et d’isolation observés en regard de la composition et de la morphologie des pailles pour développer des panneaux performants. Le travail contribuera également à compléter la large base de données sur les panneaux à renforts lignocellulosiques développés au laboratoire.

Vous trouverez davantage d’informations sur le stage ici : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/nRzezN9XJz7gYLS


Compétences et connaissances :

  • Élève de formation BAC+5 (Master 2) en science et génie des matériaux polymères et composites

  • Connaissances dans le domaine des biocomposites à fibres végétales

  • Production scientifique (rédaction de publications, de posters, présentations orales ...)

Conditions :

Le stage est prévu pour une durée de 6 mois à partir de février 2027

Date limite de candidature : 20/11/2026

Un entretien d’environ 45 minutes (possible en visioconférence) pour discuter de votre parcours, de votre motivation, de vos compétences et de votre projet professionnel.

title: Stage Software Engineer - Paris - H/F/X
descriptionHtml:

Processus d'onboarding : 

L'intégration comprend une formation sur des compétences transversales critiques telles que la gestion du temps, la communication orale et écrite. Un counsellor te sera également attribué qui te guidera dans ta familiarisation avec la culture et les méthodes de travail de l'entreprise. De plus, tu auras la possibilité d'obtenir des certifications sur les fournisseurs cloud avant de travailler sur des missions clients. Ce processus d'intégration est conçu pour te doter des connaissances et des compétences nécessaires pour devenir un ingénieur logiciel performant chez Artefact.

Ce que nous offrons

Prêt à rejoindre l'aventure ?

Si tu te reconnais dans cette description et que tu souhaites mettre tes compétences au service de projets concrets et impactants, envoie-nous ta candidature !

title: Stage: Technische bedrijfskunde/Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Bij de afdeling Engineering/Technische Bedrijfskunde hebben we twee uitdagende stageopdrachten openstaan. Je gaat aan de slag met één van onze nieuwe geautomatiseerde processen en onderzoekt hoe we deze verder kunnen optimaliseren. Daarbij combineer je techniek, data en procesverbetering en krijg je de kans om jouw verbeteringen ook daadwerkelijk in de praktijk te implementeren.

Mogelijke werkzaamheden en stageopdrachten zijn:

  • Je onderzoekt en optimaliseert het nieuwe geautomatiseerde badgoedvouwproces van Nedlin Hospitality. Met behulp van procesdata en de DMAIC-methodiek breng je prestaties en knelpunten in kaart, voer je verbeteringen door en borg je deze voor een hogere productiviteit, kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid.

  • Je onderzoekt het nieuwe geautomatiseerde sorteerproces voor vuil linnengoed bij Nedlin Healthcare. Je analyseert de prestaties en efficiëntie van de installatie, brengt knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden in kaart en werkt passende optimalisaties uit. Vervolgens help je deze verbeteringen te implementeren en evalueer je het resultaat.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe Nedlin een digitale kennisbank kan opzetten om de Technische Dienst beter te ondersteunen. Je verzamelt en structureert bestaande technische kennis, zoals handleidingen, onderhoudsinstructies en logboeken, en richt de kennisbank zo in dat deze geschikt is voor zowel de werkvoorbereider als een toekomstige Copilot-agent. Vervolgens implementeer en test je de kennisbank in de praktijk.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.

title: Strategic Account Executive - Consumer Goods Industry
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ327R397

Do you want to help solve the world's toughest problems with big data and AI? This is what we do everyday at Databricks.

We are looking for an Strategic Account Executive to join the team in the UK to maximise the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks within the Consumer Goods industry.  Your mission will be to grow one of our most strategic CPG customers. Experience selling to this sector is essential, as is experience in running large complex multi-national accounts.  

Reporting to the Director, Sales, as a Strategic Account Executive at Databricks you will come with an informed and compelling point of view on the Big Data, Advanced Analytics and AI space which will guide your successful strategy and together with both our teams and partners, allow you to provide exceptional value to our customers.

The impact you will have:

  • You will co-develop a business plan, with your team and ecosystem partners, that accelerates customer success to exceed quarterly/annual usage and booking goals
  • You will lead your team, customer and partners to identify impactful big data and AI use cases whilst proving out their value on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform
  • You will implement the big data and AI transformation goals of your customer through a combination of strategic partnerships, well-scoped professional services, training and targeted Executive Engagement
  • You will develop an understanding of technical product details and roadmap to build trust with executives and business and technical champions

What we look for:

  • Experience leading and running large, extended virtual teams is essential.
  • Experience building and running relationships, co-selling and scaling your business with Cloud Vendors (AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams) and Global Solution Integrators (GSI).
  • Experience developing strong relationships with large (global) Enterprise accounts and leading complex sales campaigns in major CPG accounts. This includes experience co-developing business cases, gaining support from C-level Executives, value-based selling, and driving usage and commit-based engagement models working with professional services and training teams.
  • You will have experience working in Big Data, Cloud, or relevent SaaS industries.
  • Proof of exceeding sales quotas in high-growth Enterprise software companies.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

title: Strategic Account Executive (French and English speaking)
descriptionHtml:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to join our sales team in Paris. As a Strategic Account Executive focused on new business, you will be at the forefront of our company's growth in France, driving revenue by identifying, pursuing, and closing strategic deals with high-value new clients in the Hospitality industry. This role demands a proactive and results-oriented professional, with a demonstrated ability to consistently exceed sales targets within a direct sales environment. You will act as a trusted advisor, understanding potential clients' complex business needs and delivering tailored solutions that resonate and close


** Please note this role is based in Paris, France. **

What you’ll be doing:

New business development

  • Proactively identify and qualify high-potential new clients within the hospitality sector, demonstrating how Lightspeed's platform can optimise their operations and enhance guest satisfaction.

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to acquire key hospitality accounts, highlighting the benefits of our integrated POS, online ordering, and inventory management solutions.

  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified leads, showcasing the future-proof capabilities of Lightspeed K platform for restaurants, bars, and hotels.

Direct Sales and Closing

  • Conduct demonstrations illustrating how Lightspeed's product empowers hospitality businesses to streamline operations and elevate guest experiences.

  • Lead complex sales cycles, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, focusing on the value of Lightspeed's integrated payments and operational efficiency.

  • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets for new customer acquisition, driving the adoption of Lightspeed's transformative technology within the hospitality industry.

Client Relationship Building :

  • Establish strong relationships with owners, managers, and key decision-makers at prospective hospitality clients, understanding their specific needs and presenting Lightspeed as the ideal solution.

  • Understand potential clients' business objectives and challenges, and align our solutions to address their needs, emphasising the benefits of Lightspeed's robust reporting and analytics.

  • Smoothly transition new customers to the implementation and launch teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience with the Lightspeed hospitality platform.

And a little bit of....

  • Work on other sales/marketing campaigns designed to improve the customer experience as well as grow Lightspeed MRR in the process.

  • Maintain accurate records of sales activities and prospect interactions within the CRM system

  • Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

What you need to bring:

  • 3-5 years relevant work experience in a 360 selling environment 

  • Relevant work experience in an industry like IT solutions, software sales, e-commerce, cloud applications, SaaS, POS, retail/hospitality or technology.

  • Experience working in a hospitality environment would be great, but isn’t necessary.

  • Experience in an outbound sales environment.

What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

  • Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

  • Exposure to modern and proven technology;

  • Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment;

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Transit benefit if you travel by public transport to the office 

  • Lunch reimbursement on the days you work from our Paris office 

  • Healthy snacks and after work organised by the company

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

title: Strategic Account Executive

About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue. This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges.

  • 8+ years of SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals.

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, legal, IT, operations, supply chain, or manufacturing teams.

  • Proven success acquiring net-new logos in organizations with 10,000+ employees.

  • Skilled in complex sales cycles: Managing multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and driving consensus at the executive level.

  • Self-motivated and proactive: You take ownership of your success and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
