title: Technical Recruiter, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The R&D team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

Talent Acquisition at Chainalysis is a small, close-knit team that partners with leaders across the business to hire the people who will carry our mission forward. We share sourcing wins, market learnings, and process improvements openly, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for both results and candidate experience.

We are hiring a Technical Recruiter to own and drive hiring for Engineering & Product roles in our EMEA locations. This is a high-volume, outbound-heavy role: you'll spend a meaningful portion of your time building pipeline through direct sourcing, identifying and engaging top engineering talent across AI, Crypto, and Fintech. You'll manage a full requisition load, move fast, and close strong candidates in a competitive market, with Software Engineering roles among your key hires. You'll work closely with hiring managers across our R&D teams as a talent partner who understands the business and delivers results.

In this role, you'll:

  • Build pipeline through proactive outbound sourcing, mapping the AI, crypto, and fintech landscape to find where strong Software Engineers work today

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies that go beyond LinkedIn InMails, including referral generation, community engagement, and direct outreach campaigns

  • Own the full recruiting lifecycle for R&D roles, from intake and sourcing through offer negotiation and close, across a high-volume requisition load

  • Deliver a thoughtful, personalised, and transparent candidate experience at every step while moving candidates through the process efficiently

  • Partner with R&D leaders to calibrate expectations, share market insights on talent availability and compensation, and flag risks early so hiring plans stay on schedule

  • Use data on pipeline health, conversion rates, and channel effectiveness to guide decisions, and champion diversity and inclusion in every search

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a strong track record of hiring technical talent, such as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Researchers, and Product Managers

  • Demonstrated outbound sourcing ability: you build your own pipeline through direct outreach and do not rely on inbound applications to fill roles

  • High AI proficiency, using it for building pipeline proactively, workflows, processes, and documentation

  • Proven experience recruiting technical talent within the SaaS, AI, Blockchain, and Cybersecurity sectors, with a focus on candidates who have worked in fast-paced companies building technically complex products

  • Consistently utilised data to inform decision making and advise hiring managers through the hiring process

  • Strong organisational skills, sharp attention to detail, and consistent follow-through on every candidate and requisition

  • The ability to build credibility with hiring managers quickly, communicate market realities clearly, and guide decisions with data, in a collaborative, low-ego way

You might also have:

  • Experience recruiting for Blockchain companies with a focus on Engineering roles

  • A background at a high-growth scale up technology company

  • A track record of hiring for technical roles in Denmark, Israel, UK, and the USA

Tools we use:

  • Ashby ATS

  • Sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Nova AI, GitHub)

  • Coderpad

  • Google suite, Slack, Chain AI

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

descriptionHtml:

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

When voize works, nurses get 39 minutes of their shift back. When something breaks, a firewall silently blocking sync, an interface mismatch with a facility's care software or a regression after a release; documentation stops and care teams feel it immediately. As Technical Support Manager, you own our technically hardest customer cases end-to-end. title: UI/UX Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer

Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field

About the Role

As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work.

What You’ll Work On

  • Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability.

  • UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life.

  • Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices.

  • 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources.

  • Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way.

  • Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously.

  • Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand.

Your Profile

  • You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices.

  • You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes.

  • You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures.

  • You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation.

  • You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware.

  • You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions.

  • You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface.

  • You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design.

  • You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies.

  • Performance on Constrained Hardware: Experience optimising front-end applications for low-compute devices, limited resources or demanding real-time requirements.

  • Complex Operational Interfaces: Experience designing interfaces for complex systems where users need to interpret spatial information, symbols or multiple sources of information quickly.

  • Gaming or Real-Time Visualisation: Experience in 3D gaming, motorsport, simulation or other fields where responsive interfaces and real-time visual feedback are important.

  • Building from Scratch: Experience establishing a front-end architecture, reusable component system or coherent design language for a new product or platform.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 minutes): An initial conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and interest in SE3 Labs, alongside an introduction to the role and our working environment.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes): Discuss your experience, approach to software development and UX/UI design, and how you would contribute to the team.

  3. Technical Deep Dive (90 minutes): Explore your technical capabilities in more detail, including front-end architecture, interface design and implementation, responsive development and problem-solving.

  4. Team Lunch or Dinner: Meet members of the team, get a feel for how we work together and learn more about life at SE3 Labs.

Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung 

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt befindet sich an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt – und Du digitalisierst ihn, Praxis für Praxis. Als Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Außendienst (x/f/m) in Göttingen führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und bringst mit unserer KI-gestützten All-in-One Lösung echten Mehrwert direkt in den Praxisalltag. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben. 

 

Deine Aufgaben

Dein Profil

Falls du dich sprachlich noch weiterentwickeln möchtest, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit entsprechenden Lernangeboten. Perfektes Englisch ist keine Voraussetzung. Deine Kundentermine finden auf Deutsch statt.

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 %

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

 

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team, das gewinnen will. Du auch? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil der Doctolib-Erfolgsgeschichte! Weitere Informationen zum Arbeitsalltag im Sales bei Doctolib findest Du hier. 

 

Der Interview-Prozess  

  1. Interview mit unserem Talent Team (remote - 30')

  2. Interview mit der/dem Regional Manager:in (Teamlead) (remote - 60')

  3. DoctoDay: Verbringe einige Stunden mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen ersten Einblick in den Job als Account Executive

  4. Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

 

Job Details

  • Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit

  • Göttingen

  • Startdatum: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

 

Unsere Philosophie

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung. 

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

title: Visual Designer (Events, Print & Campaign)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

About the role

We're looking for a Visual Designer to own how Omnea shows up in the physical world and across marketing campaigns. You'll lead design for events, print and traditional media, and presentations, and support Marketing with graphic design for campaigns, content and paid ads.

Omnea now runs roughly one event every three days, across London, New York and beyond. You'll bring it in-house, raise the quality bar and build the foundations (templates, asset libraries, print specs) so every event doesn't start from scratch.

You'll work alongside our Founding Visual Designer, who owns digital (website, animations, product assets), building on a brand direction that's already set. Together you'll keep the brand consistent everywhere, from a product launch page to a booth at an industry summit, and help it evolve as we grow, pushing it into new formats, spaces and campaigns.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll take briefs from Marketing and Events, shape them, push back where needed, and see them through to production.

What you'll do

Events

  • Design event assets end to end: booths, roll-ups, signage, badges, invites, menus, stage visuals and merchandise.

  • Partner with the Events team on our own events (like our Annual Summit in New York), industry conferences and customer dinners.

  • Build and maintain an event asset library and templates, including a self-serve starter kit so colleagues running smaller events stay on brand without a designer.

Print and traditional media

  • Design print collateral and out-of-home or traditional media placements.

  • Prepare print-ready files and work with printers and suppliers on production, quality and deadlines.

Marketing and campaign design

  • Create graphic design for campaigns, paid ads, social and content, working closely with Marketing and Product Marketing.

  • Support product launches with campaign assets, in partnership with the digital Visual Designer.

  • Help Marketing self-serve by growing our brand asset bank and templates.

Presentations

  • Design high-impact decks for events, keynotes, webinars, sales and leadership.

  • Maintain and evolve our slide templates so teams can build on-brand decks themselves.

  • Turn rough content into clear, well-structured presentations.

Brand

  • Apply and extend our new brand system across print and physical formats.

  • Raise the quality bar on customer-facing content, including guidelines for photography and filming at events.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you know the brand system inside out, you've shipped your first event assets, and you've mapped what currently goes to contractors.

  • First 90 days: events and print run through you, not contractors. There's a working event template library and a print spec/supplier list the team trusts.

  • First 6 months: colleagues self-serve the basics (starter kit, slide templates), and you spend your time on the moments that matter most.

Who you'll work with

  • Events: our Events team in London and New York.

  • Marketing and Product Marketing: a growing PMM team plus content, customer advocacy and growth.

  • Design: our Founding Visual Designer and the Design Director.

  • Leadership: occasional high-visibility requests (keynotes, board and leadership decks).

What we're looking for

  • Around 5 years in graphic or visual design, ideally in a B2B or in-house brand team. If you're close to that and your work speaks for itself, apply anyway.

  • A portfolio with real, produced events, print and campaign work, not only screens.

  • Strong typography, layout and colour, and confidence working within a brand system while pushing it forward.

  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with printers and suppliers.

  • Comfortable juggling several briefs at once, pushing back on scope and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Confident in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).

  • Strong presentation design in Google Slides and Figma Slides.

Nice to have

  • Basic motion design for event screens and social.

  • Experience art directing photography or video.

How we hire

  1. Portfolio review by our design team.

  2. Intro call with Talent Team (about 30 mins).

  3. Design deep-dive: walk us through 2 to 3 produced projects.

  4. Meet the team: Marketing and Events stakeholders.

We keep it quick and tell you where you stand at each stage.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: [VO2 Force] - Product Owner Clienteling
descriptionHtml:
🌟 VO2 GROUP : Leader français indépendant en conseil Tech et Digital

Entre conseil stratégique et réalisation technologique, nous cultivons un esprit "boutique" : de l'excellence, de l'humain et une forte culture de l'innovation.

Nous sommes présents à Paris, Montréal, Shanghai, New York et Genève, avec plus de 800 consultants.

🌍 Leader mondial de l'expérience client et corporate

Nous collaborons avec les marques les plus emblématiques pour assurer leur succès :

✔️ De la stratégie et l'innovation

✔️ À l'exécution à grande échelle, grâce à notre expertise en business, tech, data et IA 🤖✨

🏆 Reconnaissances & Leadership

Leader en innovation et croissance 2025 (Les Echos Business Magazine)

Acteur multi-tech et partenaire Premium Salesforce

🌿 Champion d'une "Tech Responsable et Durable"

Créé avec la parité hommes-femmes, défendant l’égalité grâce à une équipe de direction engagée 🌟

45 % de femmes au sein de nos équipes

Campagne primée TopCom en 2024

📜 Certifications et Prix

Salesforce Impact Partner 2024

Cybervadis 2025

Entreprise à impact de l'année 2024 par Choose My Company

🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈

___________________________________________________________________

📋 Description du poste

En tant que Product Owner Clienteling, vous interviendrez auprès d'une grande Maison de luxe internationale sur l'évolution d'une application reposant sur l'écosystème Salesforce.

Véritable interface entre les équipes métier et techniques, vous accompagnerez la division dans la conception et l'amélioration de ses outils de clienteling, dans un environnement agile et international.

🎯 Responsabilités & Tâches clés

Votre quotidien s'articulera autour de quatre grands piliers :

1. Recueil des besoins & Recommandations Produit

  • Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins des équipes métier Retail et Digital.

  • Identifier les axes d'amélioration des parcours clients et des outils de clienteling.

  • Proposer des solutions fonctionnelles adaptées aux enjeux métier et aux usages en boutique.

2. Conception fonctionnelle & Gestion du Backlog

  • Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles, User Stories et critères d'acceptation.

  • Formaliser les parcours utilisateurs, règles de gestion et besoins d'intégration entre les outils.

  • Alimenter, prioriser et affiner le backlog en collaboration avec l'Application Manager.

  • Contribuer à la conception des maquettes et prototypes.

3. Suivi des développements & Méthodologie Agile

  • Assurer l'interface fonctionnelle entre les équipes métier et les développeurs iOS et Salesforce.

  • Participer aux cérémonies Agile (Daily, Sprint Planning, Refinement, Sprint Review).

  • Suivre l'avancement des développements et accompagner les arbitrages fonctionnels.

4. Recette, Déploiement & Accompagnement du changement

  • Préparer et participer aux phases de recette fonctionnelle et aux tests utilisateurs (UAT).

  • Suivre les anomalies et valider la conformité des fonctionnalités livrées.

  • Accompagner les déploiements internationaux et l'adoption des nouvelles fonctionnalités.

  • Produire les supports utilisateurs et assurer la communication auprès des équipes métier.

👤 Profil recherché

Pour réussir sur ce poste, nous recherchons un profil doté d'une forte expertise fonctionnelle, d'une bonne connaissance du luxe et du clienteling, ainsi que d'une excellente capacité à interagir avec les équipes métier.

  • Formation & Expérience : Vous justifiez idéalement de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Business Analyst, Proxy Product Owner ou Product Owner sur des projets digitaux.

  • Expertise Métier : Vous possédez une expérience dans le secteur du luxe et une bonne maîtrise des enjeux de clienteling, CRM, Retail et omnicanalité.

  • Compétences Fonctionnelles : Vous maîtrisez le recueil des besoins, la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles, les User Stories et la gestion de backlog. Une connaissance de Salesforce est appréciée.

  • Gestion de projet & Agilité : Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement Agile/Scrum et maîtrisez Jira. Une expérience sur des applications mobiles ou des projets internationaux constitue un atout.

  • Soft Skills : Autonome, diplomate et force de proposition, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité d'analyse, votre sens du service et votre aisance dans la communication avec des interlocuteurs métier exigeants.

  • Langues : Anglais courant indispensable, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, dans un environnement international.

Prêt(e) à relever le défi et à transformer l'expérience transactionnelle de nos clients ? 👉 Postulez dès maintenant ! 📩 Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, et notre programme de diversité et d’inclusion vise à faire de VO2 Group un lieu de travail idéal pour des talents variés.

title: VP of Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Get to know us

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

The role

title: VP Product & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Tout ce que nos clients voient et utilisent, c’est vous qui le concevez. Nous créons le poste de VP Product & Engineering pour faire de notre puissance GPU une gamme de services d’IA que les développeurs prennent en main en quelques minutes : inférence managée, déploiement de modèles, notebooks, API.

Qui sommes nous ?

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais, conçu pour l’IA et hébergé en Europe, avec des datacenters à Paris et à Lyon.

Notre propre infrastructure GPU permet à des startups, des chercheurs et des entreprises de déployer leurs modèles en quelques minutes, dans le respect du RGPD et jusqu’à 70 % moins cher qu’avec un hyperscaler.

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Arkane Cloud passe de 10 à 50 personnes d’ici fin 2027, et sa direction s’organise autour de deux rôles complémentaires, tous deux rattachés au CEO. Le VP Infrastructure fait tourner nos datacenters, nos serveurs GPU, le réseau et le stockage. Le VP Product & Engineering construit tout ce que nos clients voient et utilisent.

Vous dirigez deux pôles :


• Product : l’expérience de nos clients, de la console à l’onboarding, avec la documentation et l’analytics produit.
• Engineering : la plateforme elle-même : API publique, SDK et CLI, comptes et droits, facturation à l’usage, services d’IA managés.

Vos missions

• Bâtir nos services IA

• Porter la vision et la roadmap de la plateforme

• Structurer et faire grandir les pôles Product et Engineering.

• Solidifier les fondations

• Co-construire avec le VP Infrastructure les API de provisioning, les nouvelles offres GPU et leur pricing (avec le CSO), la gestion des incidents et la communication client.

Vos 6 premiers mois

• 1er mois : rencontre des clients et des équipes, état des lieux de la console, de l’API, des services d’inférence et de la facturation.

• 3 mois : roadmap produit et IA à 12 mois validée avec le CEO, organisation des pôles Product et Engineering posée, interfaces avec l’Infrastructure formalisées.

• 6 mois : un premier service IA managé lancé ou refondu, indicateurs produit suivis chaque mois, recrutements clés réalisés.

Votre expérience

• 10 ans ou plus en engineering avec une dimension produit, dont au moins 3 ans à la tête de pôles produit et techniques.

• Au moins une solution IA construite et mise en production à l’échelle : plateforme d’inférence, MLOps, API de modèles ou produit cloud pour développeurs.

Vos expertises

Indispensables :

• IA et inférence : moteurs de serving (vLLM, SGLang ou équivalent), déploiement et optimisation de modèles en production.

• Kubernetes : vous savez concevoir des services qui y tournent et dialoguer d’égal à égal avec l’équipe Infrastructure.

• Facturation à l’usage et IAM : mesure de la consommation, billing, authentification, gestion des droits.

• Management de pôles en croissance, anglais professionnel courant.

Un vrai plus :

  • Expérience chez un cloud provider, un neocloud GPU ou une plateforme MLOps ;

  • Connaissance des marketplaces de modèles.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

• Du poids dans les décisions, vous serez rattaché au CEO, vous définissez la stratégie produit avec le VP Infrastructure.
• Une équipe à bâtir. Deux pôles, Product et Engineering, à structurer pendant le passage de 10 à 50 personnes.
• Un produit qui porte votre signature : console, API, facturation, services d’IA managés : tout ce que nos clients utilisent, c’est vous qui le concevez.
• Un cloud IA européen à construire. Un cloud GPU souverain, pour des clients qui veulent garder la maîtrise de leurs modèles et de leurs données.

Package et avantages

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

title: Welding Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing the technologies and capabilities needed to make space exploration more accessible. We are looking for a Welding Specialist Engineer to support the industrialization and production readiness of our next-generation thruster hardware, including EBW activities, orbital welding and laser-welded components for a high-thrust engine.

This is an intermediate-level engineering role, working closely with and under the technical guidance of our Senior Welding Specialist Engineer. You will support electron beam welding (EBW) for our new thruster, laser-welding activities for a high-thrust engine and participate on the manufacturing of the orbital welding for the our Nyx capsule propulsion.

You will bring practical knowledge and you will work with design, manufacturing, quality and production teams to turn robust welding requirements into repeatable, well-documented manufacturing processes.


What you will do

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of EBW processes for the new thruster and laser-welding processes for our high-thrust engine.

  • Support orbital welding activities (being a qualified welder and support non conformance management).

  • Draft, review and maintain Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and related welding documentation; support procedure qualification and qualification records in accordance with applicable NASA requirements and program flow-downs.

  • Support the assessment of weldability, joint design and manufacturing risks, working with design and manufacturing engineering colleagues.

  • Prepare and maintain clear welding documentation, including process records, qualification evidence and traceability information.

  • Help investigate welding non-conformities and manufacturing issues, support root-cause analysis, and follow corrective actions through to closure.

  • Coordinate with qualified welding operators and production teams to ensure that approved procedures are understood and followed; this role focuses on engineering support and does not replace operator qualification or authorization.

  • Apply and develop your knowledge of TIG and plasma welding, including their process capabilities, limitations and quality considerations.

  • Work under the direction of the Senior Welding Specialist Engineer, progressively taking ownership of defined work packages and contributing to technical reviews.

  • Promote safe, disciplined and quality-focused manufacturing practices.


What you bring

  • A degree or equivalent practical experience in welding engineering, materials or manufacturing engineering, metallurgy, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Professional experience in welding or manufacturing engineering, with the ability to contribute independently to defined tasks while seeking guidance on complex or novel issues.

  • Practical knowledge of TIG and plasma welding, with experience or familiarity in laser welding or other precision joining processes.

  • A strong interest in electron beam welding and the ability to support process development, qualification and production-readiness activities.

  • Working knowledge of WPS preparation and control, welding procedure qualification, inspection and traceability; familiarity with NASA qualification requirements applicable to the program is an advantage.

  • The ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications and to produce accurate, structured engineering documentation.

  • A methodical, safety-conscious approach and strong collaboration skills across engineering, quality and production teams.

  • Professional working proficiency in English.


Especially valuable

  • Direct experience with EBW, including process development, qualification or production support.

  • Experience with laser-welding process development, qualification or production support, especially for propulsion hardware; experience with automated TIG or other precision joining processes is also valuable.

  • Experience supporting propulsion hardware, pressure-containing components or other demanding aerospace manufacturing applications.

  • Familiarity with quality-management systems and configuration-controlled manufacturing documentation.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

descriptionHtml:

  • Deine Formate, dein Impact: Du verantwortest von Anfang an eigene Formate und siehst die Ergebnisse direkt auf unseren Kanälen.

title: Workplace Experience - Healthcare Sites Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Healthcare Sites Development Manager

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  • Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  • Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally.

  • Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches.

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  • Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time.

  • Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality.

💡 The Missions

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in Île-de-France, built to rethink occupational health with Alan's technology, for the benefit of employees and of healthcare professionals (HPs).

Its first medical centre opened at Valmy (Paris 10th) in April 2026, and 4 sites are already running.

Prévenir is about to scale fast: the ambition is to open several new small centres around Paris in 2027 (Seine-et-Marne, Val-d'Oise), first inside ready-to-operate sites, then in premises of its own (rented or bought), including a flagship centre in Paris. The exact plan is still being shaped, and you will help shape it.

We are looking for someone senior and visionary enough to carry the vision and strategy of Prévenir's sites from day one, while being happy (and excited) to be hands-on as much as needed, with a start-up mindset. Health, member experience and innovation are at the heart of the role.

You would join Alan as a full-time Alaner in the Workplace team: you work for Alan, not only for Prévenir. At first, most of your time goes to Prévenir: opening new sites, making them compliant and ready for patients with a real Prevenir's spirit, running the centres day to day with the center managers, and building the vendors, budgets and playbook that will let it grow from 4 to many more sites.

Prévenir is a separate entity from Alan: it signs its own leases and contracts, and you prepare, negotiate and advise on its behalf.

You will work alongside the Facility Manager in charge of Alan's offices at Valmy, and turn what you learn into playbooks, checklists and templates (openings, fit-out, vendors, compliance) that serve Prévenir's centres as much as Alan's own offices.

The position is based in Paris, with regular field visits across Île-de-France (Paris, Seine-et-Marne, Hauts-de-Seine, Val-d'Oise), and requires an onsite or field presence at least 4 days per week.

👀 More specificities on the profile we're looking for (level range targeted on our level grid: C1-D)

Detailed missions

Set the vision

  • Define and carry the vision and strategy for Prévenir's sites from day one: site model, technical and experience standards, and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap, alongship Prévenir's and Alan's leadership and kept up to date as the plan evolves

  • Bring innovation: test new centre formats (shared, modular or temporary sites), and have a smart use of AI to make each opening faster, cheaper and better for HPs and patients

Open and build new sites

  • Find and technically qualify new sites: define search criteria with the Occupational Health team, visit candidate sites, and give a clear go / no-go recommendation with an estimated cost

  • Open small centres inside ready-to-operate sites: check that the host site works for medical use, agree the terms with the host operator (services, charges, service levels, who does what), do the light set-up and prepare the opening

  • Prepare and negotiate leases with Legal and Finance, and be the single operational point of contact for landlords, architects and vendors

  • When relevant, lead fit-out works end to end: brief and manage architects, project managers and contractors, plan backwards from the opening date, secure administrative and safety authorisations, manage acceptance and close snags

  • Contribute to the rent vs buy thinking by providing technical due diligence on any potential acquisition (condition of the building, works to expect, regulatory constraints, running costs)

Make every centre medical-ready, unique, safe and healthy

  • Make every site ready for patients: consultation rooms, patient flows, confidentiality (acoustics), hygiene and cleaning, medical waste, hand-washing points, IT / network and badge access set up with the IT team

  • Own the safety and security of every centre, for patients, HPs and visitors: access control, intrusion alarms and video surveillance where relevant (in line with GDPR), fire safety, evacuation procedures and drills, first-aid kits and defibrillators where required, and clear procedures for incidents and for HPs working alone

  • Put prevention at the heart of the run: identify the main risk areas of each centre (fire safety, HVAC and air quality, water, electrical, access control), build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep each site's safety register up to date

Run the centres day to day

  • Run the day-to-day for existing and new centres with the center managers (ASSTs): sort and diagnose requests, fix what can be fixed, send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until it is done and checked

  • Own the logistical run of the centres in partnership with the center managers: supplies, snacks, mail, printing, small furniture and IT equipment, access and badges, cleaning. Agree a clear split of who does what and give them simple routines, checklists and documentation so they become autonomous

  • Create and keep alive the Prévenir spirit in every centre, as the Workplace team does for Alan its own offices: a welcoming, consistent and on-brand place for HPs, ASSTs and patients, using their feedback to keep improving it

Manage vendors, budgets and playbooks

  • Build a standard vendor panel (maintenance, fire safety, cleaning, medical waste, access control, furniture) with SLAs, penalties and exit terms. Run tenders and invoice checks, and reuse contracts across sites

  • Own the budget with Finance and the Occupational Health team: capex (fit-out, equipment, furniture) and opex (rent, charges, maintenance) per site, monthly follow-up, and realistic figures to feed the medical centres business model

  • Track, improve and document: run a simple dashboard (open requests, intervention times, openings progress, budget), keep the equipment inventory and maintenance log, automate repetitive follow-ups with AI and tools, and write the opening playbook and technical checklist reused for each new site

Be a full member of the Workplace team

  • Take part in the team's rituals and priorities, work with Alan's Workplace scope and join the on-call rotation (daily Office Management tasks)

Key outcomes by 1 year

  • A vision and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap for Prévenir's sites are shared and approved by Prévenir's leadership and Alan within the first 3 months, and kept up to date

  • Existing centres are under control: contracts, leases, mandatory checks, equipment, open requests and risks are mapped and documented, with no missed regulatory check or expired contract

  • Preventive maintenance plans and safety registers are live on every centre, with at least 3 prevention areas identified, each with an action plan and KPIs

  • One single channel logs and tracks requests from the centres, each with an owner and a deadline; resolution time is measured and decreasing; a dashboard tracks requests, openings and budget; at least 3 recurring tasks are automated

  • The new centres planned for 2027 open on time, with safety, accessibility and authorisations validated before the first patient and a budget under control

  • A replicable opening playbook, a building technical checklist, a standard vendor panel and standard contract templates are in place and reused across sites

  • Every centre feels like Prévenir, is safe and secure (access control, alarms and emergency procedures in place and tested, drills done on time), and is healthy.

  • At least one innovation (new centre format, building tech or AI use case) has been tested in a centre, with clear results on cost, speed or HP and patient experience

You may be a great fit if you are:

  • A multi-site Facility / Technical Manager (6–10 years of experience) in a network of regulated, public-access sites: clinics, medical or radiology centres, labs, dental or health-centre networks, nurseries, fitness, retail networks

  • A real-estate project manager in charge of network expansion and site openings, with a real sensitivity to the run

  • A head of technical services of a clinic or private hospital who wants to move to a growth environment

  • A works / fit-out project manager (chef de projet travaux, maîtrise d'ouvrage) with strong ERP experience and some maintenance and run exposure

  • A site or contract manager at an FM service provider (healthcare accounts) who wants to move in-house, or a Workplace / Facility Manager in a scale-up who has led several office openings or moves

What we're looking for

  • Solid technical understanding of buildings: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems, doors and access control, and the ability to challenge a technician or an architect

  • Proven experience of opening or fitting out sites: works follow-up with architects, project managers and contractors, planning, acceptance, snags

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for public-access buildings (ERP classification, safety commission, works authorisation, accessibility, mandatory periodic checks, safety register)

  • Good knowledge of site safety and security: access control, intrusion alarms, video surveillance (and related GDPR rules), evacuation and emergency procedures, incident management

  • Lease and landlord management: you can read a lease, understand who pays and does what, and negotiate with landlords and agents

  • Proven vendor and contract management (SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control) and budget ownership (capex / opex per site, total cost of ownership)

  • Project management of several sites in parallel, with strong prioritisation, including urgent incidents

  • Ability to work with senior and varied stakeholders: HPs and doctors, directors, Legal, Finance, IT, landlords, architects

  • Senior enough to set a vision and a strategy, and to carry and defend it with Prévenir's leadership and Alan, with a start-up mindset: frugal, fast, comfortable building from scratch with changing priorities, and happy to be hands-on

  • Exceptional communication in French (fluent) and professional English

  • A member-first mindset: you think about the HP, patient and Alaner experience, not the process

  • Appetite for digital tools, AI and basic automation to reduce repetitive work, and the ability to document in a way the whole team and AI agents can leverage

  • Mobility across Île-de-France (Paris, 77, 92, 95 and more)

  • Visionary and hands-on, autonomous and proactive, at ease with ambiguity while the plan (number of sites, rent vs buy, timing) is still evolving, calm when things don't go as planned, and discreet and respectful of the medical environment

Nice to have

  • Experience of medical, paramedical or health-related sites (centres de santé, clinics, labs), including ERP type U requirements

  • A technical diploma or certification (BTS / DUT in building maintenance or energy, SSIAP) and electrical habilitation

  • Experience of a technical due diligence on a building purchase, or of a sale-and-leaseback / long-lease structure

  • Experience with indoor air quality or energy-efficiency projects

  • Experience using a CMMS / GMAO tool, or building one with no-code tools

  • Extensive experience leveraging AI to build scalable processes or automate recurring tasks

  • Prior experience in a high-growth company or scale-up, ideally in a network-expansion context

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.


We'll be thrilled to receive your application!


🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
